papers.title: Dual-Interest Sequential Product Recommendation With Multi-Granular SSM
institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology Clear Water Bay, Hong Kong shuiyingl@ust.hk
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology Clear Water Bay, Hong Kong tracy.mok@ust.hk
papers.primary_institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology Clear Water Bay, Hong Kong shuiyingl@ust.hk
papers.reason: 聚焦用户行为序列与下一步偏好建模，和序列推荐主线直接相关。
papers.abstract: Sequential recommendation aims to predict the next item a user will interact with based on their historical behavior. Advances in Transformers have significantly improved sequential recommendation but are still limited by cost efficiency. Although State Space Models (SSMs) have recently enabled efficient long-range modeling, most existing methods encode each item with a single static contextual role, overlooking the phenomenon of item polysemy. In fact, the same item often plays different semantic roles depending on user context, and existing methods are limited in capturing dynamic behavior across different temporal granularities. In this work, we propose DSRec, a novel dual-interest cross-SSM model that explicitly disentangles item roles across long-term and short-term semantic context. Sequential items are encoded into long-term interest embeddings that capture stable preferences via historical aggregation, and a short-term interest branch that emphasizes local session intent modulated by inter-click time intervals. These interest embeddings are processed through distinct SSM encoders: a full-sequence Mamba for long-term modeling, and a time-modulated SSM that dynamically adjusts state evolution based on temporal gaps. To enable effective cross-granularity alignment, we adopt a residual cross-fusion mechanism that exchanges contextual information between the two branches while preserving semantic independence. Experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that DSRec outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.
papers.article_theme: 双兴趣多粒度状态空间模型的序列商品推荐
papers.research_question: 现有基于状态空间模型（SSM）的序列推荐方法为每个物品编码单一静态语义角色，忽略了物品在不同用户情境下的多义性（如同一件商品可能体现长期偏好或短期兴趣），也难以在不同时间粒度上捕捉动态行为。论文试图显式解耦物品的长期与短期语义角色，实现高效的多粒度兴趣建模。
papers.main_contribution: 提出DSRec，一种基于多粒度交叉残差SSM的双兴趣序列推荐模型。每个物品被编码为长期兴趣嵌入（经用户历史聚合刻画稳定偏好）和短期兴趣嵌入（由点击间隔时间调制的会话意图），分别送入非对称的双SSM编码器（全局Mamba和时间调制SSM），并通过残差交叉融合机制在保持语义独立的前提下实现跨分支信息交换。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 长期兴趣建模：在基础物品嵌入上加入用户历史均值池化得到的上下文偏移量，抑制短期波动，再用标准全序列Mamba块（线性投影+1D卷积+SiLU门控+选择性SSM+残差连接）编码长程依赖。
🔸 短期兴趣建模：将物品嵌入与时间间隔嵌入拼接，时间间隔经对数缩放和分位数分桶离散化；短序列由时间感知SSM处理，用sigmoid门控按时间间隔调节状态更新——间隔小则注入新信息，间隔大则保留历史状态。
🔸 非对称双SSM设计：长期路径用全局Mamba，短期路径用时间调制SSM，避免两个相同Mamba编码器忽略不同粒度的时间模式。
🔸 残差交叉融合：每条分支以另一分支的detach输出作为辅助输入，实现双向信息共享又防止梯度纠缠，融合后经FFN和层叠SSM块，最终拼接双分支末位输出做softmax预测，用交叉熵损失优化。
🔸 动机源于物品多义性：同一物品（如《沙丘》）既可能出现在科幻片序列中体现长期偏好，也可能跟在漫画后体现短期兴趣。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在MovieLens-1M、Amazon-Beauty和Amazon-Video-Games三个数据集上，DSRec在HR@10、NDCG@10、MRR@10多数指标上超越SASRec、BERT4Rec、Mamba4Rec、SIGMA等基线，如MovieLens-1M上HR@10较最佳基线提升2.58%、MRR@10较Mamba4Rec提升5.67%。
🔸 消融实验显示移除残差交叉融合、双兴趣嵌入、短期SSM-S分支或融合编码器均导致性能下降；用两个相同Mamba的Dual Mamba变体在Amazon数据集上明显更差，验证非对称设计必要性。
🔸 超参分析：块数B在Beauty和Games上分别取3和2最佳，继续加深反而退化且训练时间与显存稳步上升；最大序列长度在T=50达到峰值，从T=50到T=200训练时间约增加四倍。
🔸 效率方面DSRec保持线性复杂度（因双分支在隐藏维度上成本翻倍），推理时间83ms、显存3.55G，接近Mamba4Rec（72ms、2.69G），远优于SASRec（123ms、7.58G）；训练收敛更快。
🔸 鲁棒性实验按历史长度0-5、5-20、20+分组，DSRec在各组（含冷启动用户）均优于Mamba4Rec；作者亦指出当前多义建模较基础，需引入外部知识、可学习融合门等改进。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，本文的创新点在于将物品多义性显式引入SSM序列推荐，通过长期/短期双嵌入与非对称双编码器实现语义解耦，这一视角区别于以往用户侧多兴趣建模，具有一定新意。残差交叉融合以detach方式防止梯度纠缠，设计简洁实用，且效率实验证明其保持了SSM的线性复杂度优势，工程落地价值较高。局限方面：双嵌入仍基于同一物品ID投影，语义解耦的深度有限；时间调制SSM的门控设计相对朴素；主要评测集中在三个公开数据集，缺少跨域或真实线上验证；论文在实验设置部分表述前后不完全一致（如数据集数量），部分提升幅度在稀疏数据集上仍有波动空间。

papers.title: Do We Care About Personalization and Explainability? An Interview Study with News Recommendation Engineers
institutions: University of Amsterdam, Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Jheronimus Academy of Data Science, ’s-Hertogenbosch, The Netherlands
Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani, Pilani, India
Eindhoven University of Technology, Eindhoven, The Netherlands
papers.primary_institution: University of Amsterdam, Amsterdam, The Netherlands
papers.reason: 强调规模、效率或线上部署，对工程落地和系统设计更有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Research on explainability in recommender systems largely centers on end users, overlooking the perspectives of those who build and maintain these systems and their potential use cases such as model debugging. In this study, we examine how news engineers and related technical stakeholders perceive and implement personalization and explainability in practice. We conducted 15 semi-structured interviews across nine news organizations, spanning diverse regions in both public and private sectors, to investigate the challenges and motivations shaping their approaches. Our findings reveal that personalization is not always a straightforward or desirable choice for news organizations, as concerns around user tracking, editorial control, and resource constraints often limit its adoption. Even among organizations implementing personalized news recommender systems in production, explainability is rarely prioritized, with day-to-day operational demands frequently taking precedence over longer-term transparency goals. Definitions of explainability vary widely across organizations, though some demonstrate promising internal practices and visualization tools that facilitate communication between engineering teams and newsrooms. Based on our analysis, we provide actionable and practical guidelines for news engineers and researchers on how to adopt explainability methods within a news personalization pipeline.
papers.article_theme: 新闻工程师如何看待个性化与可解释性的实践
papers.research_question: 论文探讨可解释性方法能否解决工程师在构建新闻推荐系统时面临的挑战，考察个性化与可解释性在不同新闻机构中的实际采纳状况。难点在于学界研究偏重算法性能与面向用户的解释，而真实机构中的工程约束、编辑控制与资源限制很少被定性研究刻画。
papers.main_contribution: 论文通过对九家新闻机构15位工程师与产品负责人的半结构化访谈和主题分析，刻画了个性化与可解释性采纳的跨组织图景。研究发现个性化并非普遍可行或可取，且没有组织显式使用算法可解释性工具，解释实践主要面向内部调试与编辑沟通。作者据此提出了面向研究者与实践者的可操作指南。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 采访对象覆盖公共广播、报刊、媒体集团与新闻聚合器四类机构，访谈按个性化现状、挑战、调试实践、可解释性需求四阶段展开，并进行双人编码的主题分析。
🔸 九家机构中七家采用某种个性化，但多为内容推荐、协同过滤与非个性化方法混合的形态，且普遍叠加由编辑价值驱动的业务规则。
🔸 挑战归纳为四类：数据/后端/基础设施（几乎所有组织都提及）、资源与人员、与编辑团队的沟通、推荐系统本身的问题（冷启动、多样性、跨产品规则冲突等）。
🔸 可解释性实践分为五类：面向新闻编辑室的内部分析看板、手动调试手段、无外部解释、对外部解释持怀疑态度、未来愿意尝试对外解释；无一家使用正式可解释性算法。
🔸 基于发现提出建议：优先做面向编辑沟通的内部看板、用更系统的调试取代临时手动检查、将解释需求与业务规则结合实现可追溯。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 跨组织对比显示公共广播机构个性化程度总体偏低，主要受用户数据获取和隐私理念限制，而私有机构内部差异反而较大。
🔸 组织普遍重视多样性，它既是挑战也是评估标准和业务规则，过度集中的负面新闻还可能导致用户新闻疲劳、访问下降。
🔸 工程师对算法级可解释工具（如特征归因）并不热衷，谈到解释时更多联想到Netflix、Facebook式的面向用户解释，说明工具研究与实际需求存在错位。
🔸 LLM采纳作为范围外发现：多家机构用LLM生成文章、元数据或作为内部工具，但也出现编辑价值对齐和岗位替代的担忧。
🔸 局限包括样本集中于欧美机构、主要捕捉技术视角，作者也承认基础设施、资金和人力等组织性障碍无法单靠可解释性解决。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，这篇访谈研究的价值在于把可解释性讨论从'面向最终用户'转向'面向构建与维护系统的工程师及编辑室'，并通过跨组织视角论证了BBC个案中的解释性落差是系统性的。研究方法规范，编码一致性较高，引用的从业者原话使结论有说服力。创新性主要体现在问题框架而非技术本身；实用性体现在为研究者指明应设计轻量、可嵌入生产流程的解释工具。局限在于样本地域与角色覆盖有限，访谈自报数据可能受社会期许影响，且定性结论难以量化各因素的实际权重。

papers.title: IntBMoE: Integrating Block-Level Conditioning into Expert Composition for Full-Participation Mixture-of-Experts
papers.reason: 关注生成式建模、语义标识或物品生成，适合跟踪端到端推荐新范式。
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales capacity, but existing designs cannot set three quantities independently. For a single token, participation is how many experts contribute knowledge to its output, execution is how many are actually computed (compute cost), and materialization is how many expert-sized parameter sets must be built and stored (memory cost). Sparse routing keeps execution and materialization low, but shrinks participation: for each token, only a few experts contribute. Dense output-mixing restores full participation, but its execution grows with the number of experts. Parameter-merging keeps execution at one expert, but its materialization grows with the number of routing decisions. We propose IntBMoE, a block-conditioned MoE that decouples all three by pairing dense expert composition with sparse block execution. Its blocks come from a small learned codebook, one per entry. At each internal layer, a lightweight hypernetwork merges all expert bases in that layer's pool into one composed expert. Participation is full, because every composed expert draws on the entire pool. Execution stays sparse, because a router sends each token to only a few blocks. Materialization is bounded, because the codebook, not the input, fixes how many blocks exist. Dual-Path Residual Gating (DPRG) further couples two independently composed paths through multiplicative gating. Experiments on image classification show consistent gains over representative sparse and dense MoE baselines. Additional experiments on language modeling and sequential recommendation validate its generalization beyond vision. IntBMoE is fully deployed in AMap's generative recommendation system, serving hundreds of millions of users under a 60ms latency budget, with a 2.4% relative UVCTR gain in online A/B testing. Our code is available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/DreamX-Rec/.
papers.article_theme: IntBMoE：块级条件化实现全参与稀疏执行MoE
papers.research_question: ::现有MoE设计无法同时独立控制专家的参与度、执行成本与参数物化成本：稀疏路由限制参与、稠密混合推高执行、参数合并导致物化膨胀。论文研究如何让每个token都受益于完整专家池，同时保持稀疏执行和有界的参数物化。
papers.main_contribution: ::提出IntBMoE，将专家变换的构造与执行解耦：由小型码本嵌入经共享超网络，将各层专家基底融合为K个可复用的多层块，路由器仅为每个token选择Top-k个块执行。引入双路径残差门控（DPRG）提升组合表达能力，并证明参数物化规模由码本而非路由决策数决定，可在推理时缓存组合块。
papers.key_ideas:
::🔸每模块维护K个可学习码本嵌入，超网络据此生成值路径与门路径的组合系数，将每层E个专家基底以方差保持因子1/√E线性融合为L层块，系数不受softmax约束，允许负值组合
::🔸token级路由器对每个token打分选Top-k块，块内先做块条件化特征过滤（token与码本嵌入拼接生成软掩码），再逐层通过DPRG：值路径与RMSNorm后的门路径相乘调制
::🔸被选块输出按路由概率加权聚合，并叠加始终激活的共享SwiGLU专家；组合成本O(KED)与token无关，执行成本O(TkD)
::🔸推理时所有组合块可预计算并缓存，请求时计算不随专家池规模E增长，适合低延迟服务
::🔸将Transformer的FFN子层替换为IntBMoE模块，保持与基线方法的总参数量对齐以公平比较
papers.analysis_summary:
::🔸ImageNet-1K上达到73.76% Top-1、91.48% Top-5，超过最强基线SMEAR 1.98个Top-1百分点；缓存后每图FLOPs从4.063G降至3.457G
::🔸消融显示移除门路径跌幅最大（Top-1降至68.04%），其次为单层块；固定λ、softmax归一化系数、去掉共享专家或特征过滤均带来一致下降
::🔸移除任意专家基底均降低准确率（最小0.26点），且块路由呈现类条件、深度依赖的分配模式，深层组合系数相似度趋近于零，说明码本学到了差异化的组合配方
::🔸泛化实验上MiniPile语言建模PPL降至14.5878（较最强基线降低2.9%），IntTravel序列推荐HR@1、HR@5、NDCG@5均为最优
::🔸在AMap生成式推荐系统中全量部署，平均延迟19ms、P99为38ms，满足60ms预算，一周在线A/B实现2.4%相对UVCTR提升
papers.personal_view: ::基于全文分析，这篇论文的核心创新在于用参与度、执行、物化三个维度解构已有MoE设计，并以码本条件化的超网络组合实现三者解耦，思路清晰且叙事完整。块参数与输入无关从而可缓存，是其能落地低延迟推荐服务的关键，工业部署与在线A/B结果为方法实用性提供了有力证据。局限方面：主要视觉实验基于较小规模DeiT-Tiny骨架，K、E扩大后收益边际递减，超大规模语言模型上的可扩展性尚未验证；方法激活参数较高（23.1M），显存占用依赖缓存策略；摘要中亦提及DPRG引入常数级额外开销。此外组合是线性的，表达能力依赖DPRG的非线性耦合，能否替代更深的专家结构仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: AutoRecLab: Describe the Experiment, Get the Code!
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: Empirical evaluation is central to recommender-systems (RecSys) research, but turning experimental designs into executable code remains a manual and error-prone task. We present AutoRecLab, a Python-based autonomous RecSys lab that automates RecSys experiments from natural-language prompts. Given a research idea, AutoRecLab derives explicit experiment requirements, builds and validates a prototype, and iteratively expands it into the requested full experiment. The workflow combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for documentation lookup, static type verification, and execution-steered tree search. In our demonstration, AutoRecLab autonomously implements an explicit-to-implicit feedback conversion study. In a baseline comparison across six algorithms and three datasets, 8 of 9 runs succeed at an average cost of approx- imately $1 per run with GPT-5.4-mini.
papers.article_theme: AutoRecLab：从自然语言描述自动生成推荐实验代码
papers.research_question: 推荐系统研究中将实验设计转化为可执行代码仍高度依赖人工且易错，通用LLM科学Agent又缺乏RecSys专用配置且常幻觉领域API调用。论文探讨如何将自然语言研究需求自动转化为符合预期评估协议的可执行RecSys实验。
papers.main_contribution: AutoRecLab是首个公开的开源RecSys专用研究Agent，以需求工程、原型构建、精化扩展三阶段工作流，将研究提示转为可机器检查的显式需求并迭代生成代码。系统结合MCP文档检索（RAG）、静态类型校验和执行引导的树搜索，基于OmniRec元框架执行实验。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 需求工程阶段把用户提示拆为两组需求：小规模快速运行的原型需求（单数据集、单算法、单指标切点）与保留完整实验设定的全量需求，使错误可在小实验中提前暴露。
🔸 原型阶段由LLM生成候选代码，静态类型检查发现的错误触发自动修正循环，并通过MCP检索OmniRec、LensKit、RecBole的索引文档以减少API幻觉。
🔸 每个候选在独立工作区执行，LLM按需求逐项判定满足情况并分类有bug/无bug，需求覆盖比例构成节点分数S∈[0,1]。
🔸 候选实现构成搜索树，先用有bug/无bug集合选择，再以ε-greedy策略选取最高分候选或随机候选进行改进调试，直至S=1或达到迭代上限。
🔸 精化阶段从可运行原型出发增量扩展至全量需求，最终输出Python代码、图表、日志与Markdown总结供人工检查。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 演示实验中，从单一提示自动推导出22条需求、生成169行Python代码及对比图，总API成本仅0.76美元（GPT-5.4-mini）。
🔸 六算法基线实验的九次运行中八次（约89%）生成无bug代码与图表，每次成本约1美元；部分运行耗时较长，主因是生成代码执行占主导。
🔸 数据集过滤与随机种子拆分两个场景的结果再现了已有人工研究的定性趋势，显示方法可支持经验性RecSys实验。
🔸 局限包括：仅覆盖较简单的离线任务、依赖OmniRec及索引文档覆盖、顺序树搜索导致长运行时间；八次无bug运行中仍有部分分析缺乏科学意义，说明需求覆盖加成功执行不能完全代表实验质量。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，本文的创新点在于把通用科学Agent思路落到RecSys领域：显式需求拆解、原型先行的阶段化流程，以及RecSys专用文档RAG与OmniRec执行层的结合，针对性缓解了通用Agent幻觉API和忽视评估协议的问题。约1美元/次、约89%无bug率展现了可观的成本效率和实用潜力。但作者也坦承这是早期概念验证：任务范围限于简单离线实验，需求覆盖分数只反映代码通过性而非实验设计的科学合理性，且长运行时间与对OmniRec的强依赖限制了适用面。自动化生成结果仍需研究者负责审查代码、设计与解释，短期内更宜定位为降低实验工程成本的辅助工具而非替代研究者的自主实验室。

papers.title: Reproducing Transparent and Scrutable Recommendations: Exploring Open-Weight Models via Natural-Language User Profiles
papers.reason: 关注知识迁移与稀疏反馈，适合研究新用户、新物品和跨场景泛化。
papers.abstract: In this reproducibility study, we investigate the transparency and scrutability of recommender systems enhanced by incorporating generated natural-language user profiles that represent user preferences. The original paper explores the synthesis of user profiles from raw user-generated review text across domains such as movies and accommodations (Amazon Movies & TV, TripAdvisor). Crucially, these natural-language user profiles enable direct user interaction and intervention, allowing users to customize recommendations by correcting misattributed preferences or addressing cold-start settings. We successfully reproduce the core findings of the original study. Additionally, we extend the evaluation by conducting systematic context ablation experiments, multi-seed stability across five distinct random seeds to establish statistical reliability, and a mechanistic interpretability analysis using the nnsight framework to probe internal model representations under counterfactual profile perturbations. Our findings verify the original paper's claim that User Profile Recommendation (UPR) achieves competitive performance under its test-set reranking protocol and makes recommendations more transparent. Perturbing the natural-language profiles does change predictions, but it shifts predicted ratings uniformly across genres with no detectable genre-selective effect, leaving rankings unchanged even under direct activation steering. We trace this back to the rating-regression objective rather than the profile interface, with ranking-objective models clearly exceeding in this task.
papers.article_theme: 自然语言用户画像推荐的复现与可审视性检验
papers.research_question: 论文试图复现Ramos等人提出的用户画像推荐（UPR）方法：用LLM把评论历史合成为可读、可编辑的自然语言用户画像，并验证其能否在保持透明性的同时达到与原始评论历史相当的预测性能。难点在于原代码库存在缺陷、评估协议不一致，且“用户可编辑画像以干预推荐”这一可审视性主张缺乏机制层面的证据。
papers.main_contribution: 作者成功复现了UPR的核心结果，修复原仓库多处问题并构建了端到端可复现的流水线（uv锁定依赖、标准化CLI、跨硬件执行），对齐了Cornac基线的评估协议。在此基础上进行三项扩展：上下文消融、五随机种子稳定性实验，以及基于nnsight的机制可解释性分析，揭示评分回归目标限制了画像编辑对排序的实际干预效果。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 复现UPR两阶段流程：LLM（Llama2/Mistral）将用户评论历史合成为自然语言画像，再由微调的序列分类模型基于画像与候选物品元数据预测评分，用户可直接查看和修改画像。
🔸 上下文消融：对比用户画像、原始评论历史、物品评论历史三种输入与物品标题、标题+描述两种输出配置，验证简洁画像能用更短上下文达到与完整评论历史相当的精度。
🔸 多种子稳定性：在Amazon数据集上以种子37–41加基线种子42训练，验证性能增益不依赖随机初始化。
🔸 机制可解释性：用nnsight提取末层归一化激活，UMAP可视化聚类，梯度归因分析画像token，并通过反事实画像扰动与残差流激活转向追踪表示变化。
🔸 关键诊断：画像编辑虽改变预测评分，但对各类型均匀生效、无类型选择性，排序几乎不变；原因是评分回归目标只学到用户偏移加物品偏移，缺少负采样的排序目标无法学习内容匹配规则。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 复现结果与原文定性一致：MF仍是评分精度最强基线，UPR在TripAdvisor上取得有竞争力的排序指标（nDCG@10 0.961、MAP 0.939）；消融中画像+标题+描述达到MAP 0.895、nDCG@10 0.934。
🔸 多种子实验方差极小（σMAP=0.0009、σnDCG=0.0007），结果统计稳健；单个模型在8×RTX 4090上约1小时训练完成。
🔸 个性化检验显示：WMF（排序目标）百分位达0.806，而UPR仅0.51–0.55，甚至低于MostPop，说明测试集重排协议下回归目标模型缺乏真正个性化信号。
🔸 激活转向使类型探针读数从0.064完全反转为1.000，但犯罪类物品评分与排名几乎不动，表示与行为脱耦。
🔸 局限：PETER+和PEPLER-MLP基线因无官方代码无法复现；分析限于两个数据集与Llama2-7B画像，作者建议未来改用带负采样的排序目标。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文的分析，这篇复现研究的价值远超简单验证：它不仅修复了原仓库的评估缺陷（如用测试集做验证、基线协议错配），还通过反事实扰动、激活转向和方差分解等机制分析，指出自然语言画像作为接口本身并不保证可审视性——干预能力被评分回归目标结构性地限制了。这一“负结果+诊断”对LLM推荐方向是有益的清醒剂：透明接口若缺乏内容匹配的排序信号，用户编辑只能改变评分幅度而非推荐内容。局限在于实验只覆盖一个数据集的深入分析、画像生成模型单一，且排序目标下画像是否真能实现有意义的干预仍是开放问题。其可复现流水线和对原仓库的改进建议也体现了良好的社区实践。

papers.title: Re2A: Situated Conversational Recommendation via Rubric-based Preference Reasoning and Alignment
institutions: Department of Computing, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
The Chinese University of Hong Kongdongding88.lin@connect.polyu.hk wangjian51@scu.edu.cnxzhao@se.cuhk.edu.hk cswjli@comp.polyu.edu.hk
College of Computer Science, Sichuan University
papers.primary_institution: Department of Computing, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.reason: 强调自然语言交互、偏好获取与可解释反馈，适合研究主动式推荐体验。
papers.abstract: Real-world recommendation scenarios are commonly grounded in shared physical environments during user-recommender interactions. This motivates situated conversational recommendation (SCR), a complex task requiring recommender assistants to jointly reason over dialogue history, co-observed scenes, and in-scene item attributes. However, current approaches struggle with this setting due to two intertwined challenges: accurately understanding situated user preferences throughout the conversation and generating responses that simultaneously satisfy user needs and grounded situations. To this end, we propose Re2A, a framework that formulates SCR as a structured reason-then-align process. We introduce rubric-based preference reasoning, which uses automated rubrics to guide the model toward producing explicit preference states. Based on these states, we propose a preference-conditioned optimization to align response generation with dual objectives: user preference satisfaction and situation consistency. Extensive experiments on two SCR datasets demonstrate that Re2A consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, delivering more precise, context-aware conversational recommendations. Our code is available at https://github.com/DongdingLin/Re2A.
papers.article_theme: 用规则化偏好推理与双重对齐实现情景对话推荐
papers.research_question: 情景对话推荐（SCR）要求系统同时基于对话历史、共观察场景和场景内物品属性进行推理，现有方法难以准确推断情景化用户偏好，并生成同时满足用户需求和场景约束的回复。难点在于偏好隐式、动态且与视觉场景紧耦合，回复需同时满足用户意图与物理场景的双重目标。
papers.main_contribution: 提出Re2A框架，将SCR形式化为结构化的先推理后对齐过程：通过自动化规则引导的策略优化生成显式结构化偏好状态，再基于该状态进行用户偏好条件化的DPO双重对齐。该框架利用自动规则归纳与合成负样本，避免昂贵的人工推理标注，在两个SCR数据集上持续超越最强基线。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 自动规则归纳：用MLLM从种子数据归纳四类规则（情景性、物品相关性、一致性、辅助），每条规则为可二值判定的谓词，由冻结MLLM裁判打分。
🔸 动态规则选择：由冻结MLLM根据当前对话意图筛选相关规则子集，提供更稠密、低噪声的监督信号。
🔸 偏好状态生成与GRPO：推理模型生成偏好思考与结构化偏好状态（意图、约束、视觉目标），通过组相对优势估计进行策略优化，无需人工标注推理链。
🔸 异构DPO：自动合成情景冲突（幻觉）与偏好冲突（场景内干扰项）两类负样本，配合教师强制锚点的两阶段对齐训练，实现用户意图与场景一致的双重对齐。
🔸 级联推理：推理时偏好状态作为检索约束解析出目标物品，再以其为条件生成扎根场景的对齐回复。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在SIMMC 2.1与SCREEN上，Re2A以两种骨干模型均在Hit@1等指标上领先最强基线ReGeS，如Qwen3-VL上SIMMC 2.1 Hit@1达48.12%（ReGeS为39.45%）。
🔸 双重对齐显著降低幻觉：VHR从25.4%降至5.2%，弱匹配率从22.6%降至7.4%；消融显示移除推理模块Hit@1骤降16.9个百分点。
🔸 推理延迟较高：每轮总延迟从ReGeS的1220.9ms增至2342.7ms，主要来自显式偏好推理；蒸馏4B推理器可将延迟降至1838.4ms且保留大部分收益。
🔸 鲁棒性验证较充分：更换裁判、用户模拟器、教师模型后结论保持，25%训练数据即可超越全量SFT基线。
🔸 局限包括级联误差传播、依赖强教师LLM构建监督、实验限于静态视觉场景。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，Re2A的核心创新在于把SCR拆解为可检验的偏好状态接口，将规则化奖励验证与异构负样本DPO有机结合，思路清晰且工程可复现，避免了昂贵的中间推理标注，实用价值明显，尤其是显式偏好状态带来的可解释性与幻觉抑制。但需注意：结构化偏好状态的收益部分来自合成监督数据，论文虽做了调用匹配诊断仍难完全剥离；级联推理带来约翻倍的延迟和误差传播风险，静态场景假设也限制了动态现实环境的适用性；此外对外部教师与裁判模型的依赖可能引入偏差。整体是一篇方法与评测都较为扎实的情景推荐工作。

papers.title: LIGE-GR: A Smooth Leap from Ranking to Generative Recommendation in the LLM Era
institutions: Meta Platforms, Inc., Menlo Park, CA, USA
papers.primary_institution: Meta Platforms, Inc., Menlo Park, CA, USA
papers.reason: 关注生成式建模、语义标识或物品生成，适合跟踪端到端推荐新范式。
papers.abstract: The remarkable success of large language models (LLMs) has provided important inspiration for the next generation of recommender systems. Structurally, recommendation and language generation share a similarity: both aim to produce an ordered sequence that optimizes the user's experience. However, how to precisely absorb the essence of the LLM paradigm into mature industrial recommender systems remains an open problem. There are two challenges. First, it is unclear how to incorporate sequence-level generation and optimization from the LLM paradigm into recommendation. Second, real-world recommender systems are mature systems that have been iteratively customized for years around specific products, business constraints, serving infrastructure, and organizational ownership. Replacing such systems wholesale is often technically risky and organizationally disruptive. In this paper, we propose LIGE-GR, a listwise generation and evaluation recommendation framework that upgrades from a traditional ranking system based on itemwise recommendation toward a generative recommendation paradigm. Instead of rebuilding the entire recommendation stack from scratch, LIGE-GR generalizes the existing pointwise recommendation system into a listwise generation system. This allows mature recommender systems to benefit from listwise optimization while preserving compatibility with existing models, value functions, and serving infrastructure. We validate LIGE-GR in short-video recommendation on Instagram Reels and Facebook Video. On these recommendation surfaces, LIGE-GR improves time spent by 1.14 percent on Instagram Reels and 0.72 percent on Facebook Video, while requiring only modest additional inference resources.
papers.article_theme: LIGE-GR：从排序到生成式推荐的平滑升级框架
papers.research_question: 如何在不推翻成熟工业推荐系统的前提下，将LLM式的序列级生成与优化范式引入推荐，实现从逐项打分到列表级联合优化的平滑升级？难点在于技术栈迁移风险高、组织归属复杂，且需满足低资源与低延迟约束。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出LIGE-GR框架，通过三个组件升级将现有逐项推荐系统严格泛化为列表级生成系统：上下文感知排序模型、列表级价值模型和基于RL的Palette序列解码器。该框架可加性、可回滚、资源需求低，在Instagram Reels和Facebook Video上线验证有效。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸在现有无上下文排序模型之上叠加轻量上下文模块：四头四层的GPT式因果Transformer，复用中间表示v′t，条件于已选列表前缀重新预测参与度信号。
🔸将价值模型从逐项求和升级为列表级：引入继续观看概率pcontinue递归估计用户到达每个位置的概率，对各项贡献加权（ListVMgolden），同时保留控制层多样性调整CL。
🔸Palette解码器以束搜索+价值RL形式逐位置扩展子序列，Q值由已实现列表价值加未来价值估计F̂组成；F̂用基于平均分数与继续概率的闭式近似，并做时长感知修正以避免偏好短视频的偏差。
🔸服务路径两阶段：先按原有流程计算并缓存无上下文表示，再仅对约三分之一头部候选做自回归重打分；束扩展批量执行，超时或失败时逐请求回退到原逐项解码。
🔸框架严格泛化原系统：切换回CF、b=1、pcontinue≡1、F̂=0即可完整恢复现有系统，实现配置级回滚与独立迭代。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸线上A/B显示基础配置使Instagram Reels时长+1.14%、Facebook Video时长+0.72%（p<0.001），b=6时长感知配置在Reels上相对b=1再提升时长+0.69%、点赞+2.93%。
🔸上下文感知预测在全部展示任务族上改善NE，如Reels的Continue任务提升1.57%；Facebook Video 17项任务中15项改善、最差回退不超过0.07%。
🔸成本可控：基础配置额外推理资源约等于CF组件的10%，b=6约20%，Reels端到端延迟约增加7%，Facebook Video平均服务延迟约增加2.2%。
🔸生态诊断显示主题熵、创作者多样性、探索性提升，但72小时内新视频占比下降0.66%，存在新鲜度回退。
🔸局限：候选池规模限于数百量级，未来需结合Semantic ID等技术支持更大候选空间。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，这篇论文最突出的创新不在单一算法，而在升级路径设计：把生成式列表优化做成对成熟排序系统的严格泛化，兼顾技术可回滚与组织可接受性，这在工业界极具实用价值。三项组件可独立启用、渐进演进，配合缓存表示与裁剪候选池实现约10%额外推理资源的高性价比。局限方面，上下文模块架构较轻（仅四层），捕获长程列表依赖的能力有限；未来价值估计采用闭式近似而非学习型模型；候选池仅在数百量级，距离真正的端到端生成推荐仍有距离；且收益数字来自特定流量与延迟口径，跨产品不可直接比较。整体是一个务实且有前瞻空间的过渡框架。

papers.title: SURF: Subtractive Updates for Recommender Forgetting
institutions: Sapienza University of Rome, Rome, Italy
papers.primary_institution: Sapienza University of Rome, Rome, Italy
papers.reason: 聚焦用户行为序列与下一步偏好建模，和序列推荐主线直接相关。
papers.abstract: The increasing demand for user privacy and compliance with regulations such as GDPR has made machine unlearning a fundamental requirement for modern recommender systems. However, Sequential Recommender Systems (SRS) pose unique challenges for unlearning due to their reliance on temporal interaction patterns. Existing approaches either require computationally prohibitive full retraining or fail to account for the sequential nature of user behavior. We propose SURF (Subtractive Updates for Recommender Forgetting), a lightweight framework for approximate machine unlearning in SRS. SURF operates in three stages: (i) identifying the neighborhood of the item to forget in the embedding space, (ii) training an auxiliary model on this compact local subset, and (iii) subtracting the auxiliary model's scores from the original model at inference time. Experiments against five baselines on 7 datasets show that SURF achieves unlearning effectiveness comparable to full retraining while substantially reducing computational cost, yielding up to a 32% improvement in NDCG@20 while requiring just 2% of the original retraining baseline time budget. We share our code at https://github.com/FilippoBetello/SURF.
papers.article_theme: SURF：以减法更新实现序列推荐高效遗忘
papers.research_question: 序列推荐系统在收到“被遗忘权”请求时，如何在不进行昂贵全量重训练的前提下，有效移除特定物品对模型预测的影响？现有分片方法在高度关联的用户-物品数据上失效，影响函数方法则依赖脆弱的数学假设且开销高。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出SURF，一个轻量、模型无关的近似机器遗忘框架，首次在推荐系统中引入模型减法机制。它在被遗忘物品的嵌入邻域上训练一个辅助模型，并在推理时从原模型分数中减去辅助模型的输出，从而在表示层面削弱目标物品影响；理论分析给出排序稳定性、局部扰动上界与影响移除三方面保证。原模型参数保持不变，遗忘天然可逆。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 邻域识别：在原模型嵌入空间中检索被遗忘物品的k个最近邻，构造最能刻画其局部影响区域的物品集合；无用户嵌入的架构通过对物品嵌入取平均来表示用户。
🔸 构建遗忘数据集：选取包含邻域物品的用户序列组成小规模unlearn数据集，仅用待遗忘区域的数据。
🔸 辅助模型训练：在与原模型相同架构和目标上训练轻量辅助模型，使其学习目标物品对预测的局部贡献。
🔸 影响减法：推理时计算˜y=f_M(S)−α·f_M'(S)，通过缩放超参数α控制遗忘强度，取分数最高物品作为推荐结果。
🔸 理论保证：证明当物品分数差超过2α‖f_M'‖∞时排序保持；邻域内扰动上界为α(L·diam(N)+C)；α=1时目标物品贡献被移除至辅助模型近似误差ε以内。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在7个数据集、3种骨干（GRU4Rec、SASRec、BERT4Rec）上对比5个基线，SURF的遗忘指标（UnlearnRecall/UnlearnMRR）普遍达到最优或次优，NDCG接近甚至超越全量重训练（最高提升32%）。
🔸 效率上，SURF仅需原重训练基线约2%的时间预算，在Yelp上推理时间为竞品的0.11×，而分片方法有最高17×的开销；IFRU训练快但NDCG严重崩塌。
🔸 消融显示k=1为最优权衡（k增大显著损害推荐质量），α调节遗忘强度与效用保持之间的平衡。
🔸 实证验证理论：邻域内分数扰动有界且平滑，残差f_i*−f_M'紧致集中于零附近，辅助模型确实近似了目标物品贡献。
🔸 局限：方法依赖嵌入邻域近似隔离物品影响的假设；遗忘效果依赖辅助模型的近似质量，且实验仅覆盖三种骨干架构。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，SURF的核心创新在于将“减法”从权重空间（如任务算术）移到推理时的分数空间，既避免分片重训练的结构性缺陷，又规避影响函数的二阶优化不稳定性，同时保留原模型使遗忘可逆，这在生产环境中极具实用价值。理论上三大性质的证明和实证验证增强了可信度，而不仅是启发式方法。局限方面：其有效性依赖“辅助模型能近似目标物品局部影响”这一较强假设，对嵌入空间中与其他物品高度纠缠的流行物品可能失效；α与k的选取依赖经验网格搜索；理论界为最坏情形且需Lipschitz等假设；此外目前仅针对物品级遗忘，用户级请求或联合删除场景尚未覆盖。

papers.title: Understanding AI Provider Recommendations in Local Service Markets
institutions: New York University Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
papers.primary_institution: New York University Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: When someone asks an AI assistant which doctor to see or which firm to trust with their savings, the answer is a referral. We audit AI provider recommendations in four registry-backed service domains across the 100 largest U.S. metropolitan areas, matching every recommendation against the official registry for its domain (Medicare clinician and facility records, and SEC adviser disclosures), under three conditions: an open-weight model, a proprietary model without web search, and the same proprietary model with search. Without search, both models largely fabricate recommendations in the domains the web covers thinly. Only 4% of the open-weight model's recommended doctors and 11% of the proprietary model's match a clinician in the queried city, and the open-weight matches are name coincidences: its matched clinicians are no likelier to be primary-care doctors than names drawn at random from the registry. With search, 64-71% of recommendations in the same domains match a real provider. Search also changes who is recommended. Without it, recommended advisory firms carry SEC misconduct disclosures at 3.6 times the registry base rate, even after adjusting for firm size; with search, significantly below it. Restaurants, where quality and visibility are separately measurable, show a 3-5x review-count premium but a rating premium of at most a tenth of a star. Finally, search largely removes the metro-size penalty: without it, real recommendations concentrate in the largest metros; with it, match rates are similar across metro-size terciles. Whether an AI referral is trustworthy depends strongly on its retrieval configuration rather than on the underlying model alone, yet an answer produced without retrieval often carries no sign that its recommendations were never verified.
papers.article_theme: 审计AI本地服务推荐的真实性与公平性
papers.research_question: AI助手在医疗、养老、金融等本地服务领域给出的具体推荐是否真实、是否指向高质量提供者？论文要回答：推荐的可信性究竟取决于模型本身，还是取决于是否启用了网络搜索这一部署配置。
papers.main_contribution: 论文首次将AI提供者推荐与政府官方质量与违规登记册（Medicare、SEC）进行匹配审计，在开权重模型、无搜索专有模型、带搜索同一模型三种条件下对比。核心机制是同模型内的搜索开关对照（2,010个相同提示），识别检索配置对匹配率、质量选择与违规构成的影响，并发布可复现的全流程。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 覆盖美国100个最大都市圈的医生、医院、养老院、金融顾问和餐厅五个领域，用“姓名+城市+州”的透明匹配键将每条推荐对应到官方登记册。
🔸 无搜索时编造集中于网络覆盖稀薄的领域：开源模型推荐医生仅4%匹配本地登记册，且经专科检验证实为姓名巧合；专有模型为11%；开启搜索后升至64%—71%。
🔸 违规反转发现：无搜索时被推荐顾问公司SEC不当行为披露率最高达基准3.6倍（控制公司规模后仍成立），开启搜索后降至基准以下。
🔸 引用来源分析显示搜索仅在监管登记册主导搜索结果时改善质量：养老院引用35.8%指向政府网站，医生仅0.3%，依赖营销页面。
🔸 餐厅领域将可见性（评论数）与质量（星级）分离测量，推荐集带有3—5倍的评论数溢价，而评分溢价最多约0.1星。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 搜索几乎消除都市圈规模惩罚：无搜索时匹配率从最大都市圈到最小显著下降，开启搜索后四个领域中三个持平。
🔸 医院推荐在各条件下均接近登记册平均星级（真实但平庸）；养老院推荐搜索后从3.40星升至4.44星，远高于2.88星的名单均值。
🔸 稳健性检验包括更小的开源模型复现、仅用无拒绝措辞的子集、城市聚类bootstrap、每公司计一次、扩展郊区匹配，主要结论方向均保持。
🔸 成本差异显著：无搜索API费用20美元，带搜索163美元，约8倍。
🔸 局限包括质量指标本身有争议、专有模型仅一家一时点、匹配率低估真实推荐数、结论限于美国和英语环境。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，这项审计的核心创新在于把推荐可信性从“模型能力”问题重构为“部署配置”问题：同模型开关搜索的对照设计干净地分离了检索的作用，且与官方登记册的匹配使审计能回答“推荐的是否是好提供者”而不仅是“是否存在”。可观测性缺口的提出尤具监管价值——无检索的流畅回答不带任何未验证信号。局限在于审计时点与商业网络状态绑定，生成式引擎优化可能改变结论；开权重臂与专有臂提示网格不同，跨臂比较需谨慎；此外机制解释（可见性驱动）只能间接推断，未观测训练语料。

papers.title: Whom Do AI Agents Work For? Role Assignment Induces Sponsorship Bias in LLM Recommenders
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now serve as conversational shopping assistants on platforms that also sell advertising. These AI agents face a conflict of duty. They advise consumers who rely on their judgment, yet are deployed by platforms that benefit when sponsored listings are chosen. Sponsorship disclosures, designed to allow consumers to penalize paid placements, now reach the AI agent rather than the consumer, and the agent's evaluation of them is hidden from the consumer. Drawing on the fiduciary concept of conflict of duty, we argue that an agent's evaluation of a sponsored listing should not depend on which party deployed it. In controlled choice experiments, we manipulate assigned roles in the system prompt to name either a traveler or a booking platform as the agent's principal. Platform delegation significantly attenuates the penalty that agents apply to sponsored listings and weakens the skepticism that disclosure triggers in their reasoning traces. We replicate out findings across LLMs and reasoning depths. A second study decomposes the disclosure label and shows that the divergence between the two delegates widens significantly when the paid placement is attributed to the platform. Stricter terminology ("Sponsored" instead of "Promoted") lowers choice of paid listings but does not close this gap when the platform is named. The findings show that disclosure mandates designed for human consumers cannot by themselves protect consumers in AI-mediated commerce.
papers.article_theme: AI代理的雇主身份会诱发对赞助商品的偏见
papers.research_question: LLM推荐代理在同时服务消费者与平台（从广告获利）时，仅凭系统提示中的委托方角色分配，是否会产生偏向付费商品的赞助偏见？该偏见是否可被披露标签等透明度规范消除？
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出并验证了由角色分配（而非显式指令）引发的涌现式委托方对齐效应：消费者委托时代理对赞助商品出现强烈惩罚，平台委托时该惩罚被显著削弱，且怀疑度构成有调节的中介机制。研究证明披露类规范无法消除偏见，并隔离了标签措辞与平台归因这两个语义触发器。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 采用2×2（赞助标签×委托方）因子设计，在酒店预订情境中让代理在目标、竞争者和两个被支配选项间选择，目标与竞争者价格相同以隔离赞助标签效应。
🔸 以单句系统提示区分委托人（'employed by a traveler' vs 'employed by a hotel booking platform'），不加入任何财务指令，操纵检验显示委托方识别100%正确。
🔸 用独立开源LLM评判者（Ornith 1.0 35B，与人类评分ICC=0.950）对选择前推理轨迹的怀疑度按7点量表打分，实现有调节的中介分析（PROCESS Model 8）。
🔸 Study 2将'Platform Sponsor'标签分解为披露类型（Promoted vs Sponsored）×平台归因，发现'Sponsored'触发折扣但平台归因激活主体对齐，'Sponsored by platform'下平台委托仍21.2% vs 消费者3.6%。
🔸 通过功效分析确定每格500次Monte Carlo重复，酒店名、评论、价格作为固定效应吸收，最坏DiD估计精度±8.8个百分点。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 主实验（Gemini 3.1 Pro，N=2,000）：消费者委托下赞助目标选择率从53.0%降至2.8%，平台委托下从54.2%仅降至25.0%，交互效应21.0个百分点，且委托人对有机商品选择无影响。
🔸 跨5个替代模型（总N=10,000）全部复制H1与H2；最新Gemini 3.8 Flash偏见反而更强，反驳'模型更新自我纠正'的期待。
🔸 效应对系统提示措辞（动词/委托人名词替换）稳健；低推理努力下效应依旧（三阶交互p=.104），支持快速启发式而非深思机制。
🔸 LLM判官经60条人类盲评验证（另两候选模型ICC分别为0.865与0.210），被支配选项选择率始终为0%，验证设计有效性。
🔸 局限：仅限酒店预订单一领域、单轮选择、控制性设计（价格与评论效价匹配），未覆盖多轮交互与真实有偿口碑场景。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，这项工作的核心创新在于把算法偏见的来源从显式目标函数追溯到系统提示中的角色分配，并借用受托人义务与利益冲突框架为LLM代理审计提供了'评估对委托方不变性'的新基准。实验设计相当严谨：价格匹配、被支配选项控制、功效分析、跨模型跨措辞复制、判官人类验证一应俱全，怀疑度的中介机制分析尤其有说服力。实用价值在于揭示仅审计显式指令的问责框架已失效，且披露标签的保护作用并非委托方中性。可能的局限在于酒店预订单一情境的外推性、代理行为对提示措辞的潜在敏感性，以及角色效应在真实多轮、多利益方交互中是否同样稳定仍待检验。

papers.title: "If I Had to Buy Just ONE: Galaxy S26 Ultra": Auditing AI-Generated Product Recommendations
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Consumers increasingly use AI chatbots for advice on what to buy. With companies like OpenAI and Google monetising their AI through advertising, this raises difficult questions about the bias and impartiality of such advice. In response, we conduct an AI audit of popular chatbots using real commercial-advice queries. First, we curate a dataset of 2,528 real commercial-advice queries (ConsumerQ). Then, we evaluate 1,536 responses to product queries from popular AI chatbots: ChatGPT (chatbot and API), Google Gemini (chatbot and API), and Google Search (AI Overviews). We find that ChatGPT expresses a first-person product preference in 79% of product-recommending responses, compared with 7% for Gemini and 2% for AI Overviews, while the products recommended often change across repeated requests. Displayed sources vary strongly: for the same query, the ChatGPT and Gemini interfaces share only 5.4% of domains on average, with no domain in common in 76.7% of comparisons. APIs provide a different view from their corresponding interfaces, with mean domain overlaps of 12.0% for ChatGPT and 14.8% for Gemini, and also differ in the types and layers of source information they expose. Our findings show that neither isolated responses nor API observations can be assumed to represent the commercial advice consumers encounter. Independent audits of AI-mediated commercial advice should therefore account for repeated responses, consumer-facing conditions, and the source layer being observed.
papers.article_theme: 审计AI聊天机器人产品推荐的偏见与可信度
papers.research_question: 论文研究AI聊天机器人在回答真实商业咨询时会给出怎样的产品推荐和引用来源，以及外部审计者能否用平台API代替消费者界面来研究这些商业建议。难点在于推荐结果非确定性且不同访问方式暴露的信息层不同。
papers.main_contribution: 论文构建了包含2,528条真实商业咨询的CONSUMERQ数据集，并对ChatGPT、Gemini及其API和Google AI Overviews五种条件下的1,536条产品推荐响应进行审计。核心发现是推荐与来源在系统间和重复请求间差异巨大，API并非界面的可靠代理，主张AI商业建议审计应基于重复观测和消费者实际使用的界面。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 从LMSYS-Chat-1M和WildChat-1M中用LLM筛选并人工验证出2,528条真实商业咨询，再选取117条通用实体产品查询，每个查询在5种条件下重复3次采集，得到1,755条观测、其中1,536条有效响应。
🔸 用固定位置、登出会话、旋转住宅代理和界面-请求配对API请求的方式自动化采集，控制短期搜索变化带来的干扰。
🔸 用LLM-as-a-judge按人工校准的码本标注推荐产品、第一人称偏好、“最佳”标签、澄清提问等属性，并以Jaccard重叠度衡量产品与来源的一致性。
🔸 对比界面与API展示的域名、页面及来源类型，并区分ChatGPT搜索返回页与最终引用、Gemini grounding、AI Overviews内联引用与来源面板等不同可观测信息层。
🔸 提出审计应以“使用中的系统”为分析单位，需覆盖重复响应、消费者访问条件和被观测的来源层。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 ChatGPT在79%的产品推荐响应中使用第一人称偏好表达，Gemini仅7%、AI Overviews仅2%；标注“最佳”的比例分别为73%、43%和48%。
🔸 推荐产品跨重复请求变化明显：ChatGPT重复间的平均Jaccard重叠仅0.178，Gemini为0.287，AI Overviews为0.421。
🔸 来源差异显著：同一查询下ChatGPT与Gemini平均仅共享5.4%的域名，76.7%的对比无共同域名；重复请求持续引入新来源，ChatGPT每题平均域名从2.65增至5.56。
🔸 API不是界面代理：界面与API平均域名重叠ChatGPT为12.0%、Gemini为14.8%，且来源类型构成系统性不同；ChatGPT API搜索平均返回37.38页但最终引用仅3.22页。
🔸 局限包括仅覆盖117条通用实体产品查询、三次重复无法穷尽输出空间、查询以英文为主且在荷兰采集、无法将界面-API差异归因于访问方式本身，且结果可能被用于针对AI推荐的可见性优化。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，这篇论文的创新性主要体现在两点：一是以真实用户撰写的商业咨询而非研究者自造模板来驱动审计，二是系统性地证明API观测不能替代消费者界面，这对整个生成式搜索审计方法论有直接警示意义。研究设计规范，界面与API请求在秒级配对、控制地理位置等细节体现了较强的测量严谨性。实用价值上，结论对DSA等监管下的独立审计和数据访问要求具有直接参考意义。局限在于样本规模偏小、仅覆盖荷兰一处和英语查询、AI Overviews出现率低，且不能解释界面与API差异的机制成因；此外作者也坦诚该测量方法可能被商业方反向用于内容优化，这是此类审计工作固有的两难。

papers.title: AURA: Agentic Diagnosis and Refinement for Production Recommender Systems at Scale
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: How and why does a recommender system fail the users it serves? Oftentimes, practitioners are left to improve their algorithms based on a combination of feedback from stakeholder teams, domain expertise, and insights from data analyses. Yet the nuances of how and where recommendations perform well or poorly for end users are difficult to discern from aggregate quantitative metrics. Whereas these metrics provide a high-level and incomplete picture, further granularity into the quality of recommendations and their patterns requires reasoning with domain understanding and objectivity, at scale. We contemplate this complex conundrum and describe a method and implementation that uses the latest AI agentic advances to provide actionable diagnoses and improvements for production recommender systems. We present AURA (Agentic Understanding and Refinement of recommender Algorithms), an end-to-end agentic system that performs qualitative evaluation at scale and can then generate improvements to our algorithms at the code level. Specialized agents read production engagement logs, from thousands of sessions to millions, and surface patterns and examples of how the recommender fails real users. The next step uses those diagnoses and context about the recommender's own code, data, and training pipeline to propose and implement refinements grounded in that codebase. We report the system design, initial tests on production data from two large consumer platforms at a major media-streaming company, safeguards, operational learnings, and early results toward a self-improving recommender system. Finally, the diagnostic gap AURA closes is not specific to streaming. The architecture is built to transfer: every domain-specific element enters through the configuration layer that already ported it between our two platforms. We map it concretely to e-commerce and online-retail recommendation.
papers.article_theme: AURA：用智能体自动诊断并修复生产推荐系统
papers.research_question: 聚合指标只能告诉团队推荐系统整体是否变好，却无法揭示系统在哪些用户群体、哪些场景下以何种方式失败。论文试图用智能体自动完成从大规模定性评估、失败诊断到代码级修复建议的全流程，难点在于对海量生产会话进行可扩展且可验证的领域推理。
papers.main_contribution: AURA是一个端到端多阶段智能体流水线：从生产参与日志中选取会话，通过分层智能体聚合产出带严重度、证据与根因假设的失败分类体系，再结合推荐器自身代码、特征与训练管线生成技术提案并产出代码补丁（当前交付到PR）。系统已在两家流媒体平台生产数据上部署，验证了架构级改进优先于提示词工程、闭合分类法优于开放式分类，并提供了成本、安全防护与运维经验。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 会话选择阶段混合随机/分层抽样、工程师SQL与并行LLM筛选智能体，经去重与多数投票确定待诊断的问题会话群组。
🔸 诊断阶段采用六步漏斗（分类、合并、抽样、分析、验证、综合），用分层聚合将上下文有限的单智能体扩展到数十万至数百万会话规模。
🔸 假设与技术提案阶段读取推荐器代码、特征定义与训练管线，输出绑定到具体组件的根因假设和候选改动；代码阶段经生成-评估-精炼循环产出通过程序化校验的补丁。
🔸 验证、工程师评审与跨轮记忆贯穿全流程：会话ID存在性校验、JSON模式校验、验证智能体交叉核查、只读数据湖与沙箱仓库、命名工程师负责制。
🔸 多模型路由将高流量分类合并工作交给轻量模型，前沿模型只用于分析、验证与代码生成，新平台接入仅需配置而非改代码。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 经迭代改进，六阶段25项评分标准上Platform A从15/25提升至23/25，Platform B从17/25提升至24/25，且多数收益来自架构级修复而非提示词修改。
🔸 成本上，上游逐会话评判占端到端花费的92-99%（Platform A约$321/96,801会话，Platform B约$250/101,594会话），AURA自身聚合分析仅占约8%和1%；单条可行动发现最低$5.38，端到端$43-50。
🔸 运行时端到端1,554与965分钟，AURA自身仅占304与72分钟；闭合13类分类法使Platform B事后清理缩减为一次重命名，Platform A的12个标签合并为8类。
🔸 闭环验证显示针对主失败类的两个修复（用户×候选类型交叉特征、候选感知注意力）在诊断队列和总体指标上均与基线差异在±0.1%噪声内，未获证实但避免了A/B浪费。
🔸 局限包括：评判与诊断质量依赖上游LLM判官（多数投票一致性96.0%/87.6%，非硬真值），发现过基线曾伪造904个会话ID，人类审计与外部基线对比、训练与A/B自动化仍留作未来工作。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，AURA的价值不在提出新的推荐算法，而是把LLM智能体嵌入了工业界最痛的"知道哪里坏了"环节，用可核查的结构化证据替代叙事式解释，这一设计取向值得借鉴。闭合分类法优于开放式分类、多数质量提升源于架构而非提示词等运维结论具有可迁移性。局限方面，评估主要靠LLM双判官评分的25项二元标准，缺乏人类专家审计和外部基线对比，闭环修复的离线筛选结果也偏阴性；跨域迁移（如电商）目前仍是概念性映射而非实验验证。此外上游判官质量决定整个系统上限，其偏差可能被放大。整体上这是一份诚实且工程细节扎实的生产系统报告，实用价值高，但"自改进推荐"的完整闭环尚未兑现。

papers.title: Scaling Articulated Rationales for MLLM-based Recommendation
papers.reason: 提供评测、数据或综述视角，便于校准实验设计并定位研究空白。
papers.abstract: Modern recommendation systems largely infer user preferences from implicit behaviors such as clicks, watch time, and negative feedback, but these signals reveal what users do rather than why they like or dislike content. This work studies articulated user rationales (AURs), i.e., users' natural-language explanations of their preferences, as a new class of polarity-aware and reason-level textual signals for recommendation. Despite their potential value, AURs are difficult to use in industrial systems because they are naturally sparse, often low-quality, and only cover a small fraction of items. We present SARA (Scaling Articulated Rationales), an industrial framework that turns sparse AURs into scalable recommendation signals. SARA first builds a data engine that elicits and curates AURs from 240M Kuaishou Live users, producing SARA-HQ, a quality-controlled and author-centric rationale dataset. It then aligns a general-purpose MLLM into SARA-7B through large-scale SFT and Quality-Refining DPO, extending rationale generation from 86,564 AUR-covered authors to the full 10M-author space. Finally, SARA-Ranker integrates the generated positive and negative rationales into production ranking via rationale-aware interaction modeling and rejection-memory modeling. Extensive offline evaluation, human calibration, and online A/B tests show that SARA-7B generates more specific, polarity-consistent, and grounded rationales than strong MLLM baselines, while SARA-Ranker improves engagement and reduces negative feedback in production. Deployed with daily refresh for over 30 days, SARA establishes articulated rationales as a practical, first-class textual signal for industrial recommendation systems.
papers.article_theme: 快手用 articulated 用户理据扩展工业级推荐信号
papers.research_question: 行为信号只揭示用户做了什么而非为何喜欢或不喜欢内容，而自然语言表达的偏好理据（AUR）天然稀疏、质量低且覆盖极少数作者。论文研究如何在工业系统中采集、规模化生成并将此类理据转化为可用的推荐信号。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出首个工业级框架SARA，包含三部分：数据引擎从2.4亿快手直播用户采集并精选理据构建SARA-HQ；通过大规模SFT与Quality-Refining DPO将通用MLLM对齐为SARA-7B，把理据生成从86,564位作者扩展到全量1000万作者；再以SARA-Ranker将正负理据集成到生产排序模型。该框架已在生产环境每日刷新部署超30天，验证了理据作为一等文本信号的实用价值。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 数据引擎：通过问卷系统先采集极性偏好选择，再追问开放式理据，配合延迟触发（观看10秒后）、稀疏投递（基于响应率动态调整的5%基准概率）与质量门槛奖励（轻量LLM实时评分），185天采集约192万条候选理据。
🔸 离线精选：由六个维度专家评估器加Senior Review组成的Agent Judge按六维四级标准打分，硬维度不可补偿，保留187,532条高质量理据（产率9.8%），并按作者聚合为86,564个带极性的作者级画像，规范化为原子语义标签。
🔸 模型对齐：基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B进行极性条件下的单轮条件生成全参SFT，随后QR-DPO从SFT模型自采样候选中用Agent Judge排序构造偏好对（chosen/rejected），可迭代精炼生成质量。
🔸 理据集成：正向理据作为可训练token嵌入，通过双向交叉注意力构建UA表征并以软对比MIM损失对齐理据语义锚点；负向理据经BGE编码加三级残差量化为语义ID，挂接到历史Hate作者的ID嵌入上，通过target-aware注意力将拒斥原因迁移到语义相关的新作者。
🔸 统一质量评测：同一六维（连贯、相关、具体、安全、极性一致、多模态有据）四线量表同时监督在线LLM裁判（单次前向、低延迟）与离线Agent Judge（维度专家+资深评审）。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 生成质量：在5K作者不相交评测集上，SARA-7B-DPO整体分3.33，优于Gemini-3.1-Pro（2.51）与Qwen3-VL-8B（2.37），BGE-Sim达0.82（基线为0.70/0.69）；QR-DPO使具体性从3.07升至3.32、grounding从3.63升至3.75。
🔸 裁判器验证：经领域语料训练后整体MAE从0.58降至0.35，Agent Judge进一步降至0.20，接近专家间一致性上界0.12。
🔸 SID结构分析：同等量化设置下SARA的SID碰撞率1.5%、作者级3.3%，优于TagNex与OneLive MLLM语义表示，说明理据保留更具区分性的作者语义。
🔸 线上效果：正理据集成在线点击+0.342%、观看时长+0.986%；负理据集成使Hate下降8.16%、Report下降0.44%，且LT-7留存+0.027%，呈净抑制而非流量重分配；A/B测试在1%真实流量上运行超30天并支持每日刷新。
🔸 局限：负反馈理据产率（24.2%）远高于正理据（6.8%），正反馈池中泛化性夸赞较多；SFT数据规模边际收益递减但未饱和，理据为作者级而非用户级信号，个体用户覆盖不足以支撑用户级偏好建模。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，这项工作的核心创新在于将'用户为何喜欢'这一被忽视的理据信号提升为工业一等信号，其价值不在单一算法，而在采集—对齐—集成的完整闭环：延迟触发与动态投递解决稀疏性，非补偿性六维裁判保证质量，QR-DPO以自采样偏好对实现低成本自改进，负理据SID让二值Hate行为获得可迁移语义，设计相当务实。局限方面：理据是作者级共享表征，无法刻画个体差异；评测以自建Agent Judge为核心裁判，存在自我裁判循环的潜在偏倚；BGE-Sim只作忠实性辅助指标但依赖与真实问卷的语义重合。整体上对工业界数据引擎建设与MLLM信号落地有很强参考价值，学术可复现性受限于私有数据。

papers.title: ReliGRec: Reliability-Oriented LLM-Based Generative Recommendation via User-Risk-Aware Prompt Routing
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: User behavior in real-world recommender systems is heterogeneous. While some users exhibit coherent preferences, others show abrupt interest shifts, bursty interactions, excessive repetition, or inconsistency with collaborative neighborhoods. Such deviations may arise from benign variation or manipulation, including shilling attacks, but do not alone establish malicious intent. Existing robust recommenders exploit user-risk signals through training-time reweighting or graph aggregation, whereas adapting generation to estimated user-level weak risk remains underexplored in LLM-based generative recommendation. We propose ReliGRec (Reliability-oriented Generative Recommendation), a weakly supervised framework whose name denotes its design goal rather than a supervised reliability variable. ReliGRec derives user-level weak-risk proxy labels from review-feedback signals for a subset of users and represents sequential behavior and collaborative context using a Behavior Token and temporal Graph Tokens, respectively. A Dual-View Weak-Risk Estimator fuses the representations to produce a user-level weak-risk score that selects a Simple or Cautious Prompt at inference. The Cautious Prompt is designed to encourage attention to stable, collaboratively supported evidence while reducing overreliance on isolated, short-term, or repeated interactions. The Behavior Token affects generation through weak-risk estimation and routing, whereas the aggregated Graph Token provides collaborative context for next-item Semantic ID generation. ReliGRec thus turns weak-risk estimation from an auxiliary prediction into a generation-time control signal. Experiments report competitive recommendation and weak-risk proxy-label prediction, while routing analyses characterize the recommendation-quality and inference-cost behavior of weak-risk-guided prompting.
papers.article_theme: 用用户弱风险评分路由提示词以增强LLM生成推荐可靠性
papers.research_question: LLM生成推荐对用户交互历史强依赖，但真实历史可能包含突变偏好、爆发式行为、过度重复或协同不一致等偏差，统一提示策略易过度依赖不稳定证据。论文研究如何在解码前从行为与时序协同上下文中估计用户级弱风险，并将其转化为生成控制信号，难点在于单一行为线索难以区分良性变化与偏差模式。
papers.main_contribution: 提出弱监督框架ReliGRec，通过Behavior Token与时序Graph Tokens的双视角融合估计用户级弱风险分数，并据此在推理前为每个用户选择Simple或Cautious提示模板，将弱风险估计从辅助预测转变为生成时控制机制。同时聚合Graph Token作为LLM输入条件化下一物品Semantic ID生成。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 用RQ-VAE离线训练融合语义与协同对齐损失的四级Semantic ID，作为物品表示与生成目标。
🔸 将交互划分为K个重叠时间窗，构建二部图并用共享GAT编码，得到每个窗口的Graph Token序列，再由时序Transformer聚合出动态协同表示。
🔸 SASRec式Behavior编码器生成Behavior Token，与聚合Graph Token投影拼接后经Risk MLP输出用户弱风险分数，用基于评论反馈信号（如有用投票比例）派生的弱标签做正类加权二元交叉熵训练。
🔸 训练时按弱标签分配提示，推理时以阈值0.5路由：Cautious提示指示模型优先采纳稳定、被协同支持的模式，避免依赖孤立、短期或重复证据。
🔸 聚合Graph Token经两层投影器注入LLM输入占位符，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct加LoRA微调，配合Trie约束束搜索保证生成合法Semantic ID。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 Beauty上全指标最优，相对最强基线LETTER-TIGER，H@1提升54.67%、N@10提升19.29%；Yelp上H@1并列最优，其余指标距最优仅0.12%–1.87%。
🔸 弱风险估计AUPRC从0.2187提升至0.2633（Beauty）、0.1990至0.2990（Yelp），双视角融合优于任一单视角。
🔸 消融显示图条件化相对仅历史生成使H@5提升2.78%、N@5提升4.65%，但时序变体并不全面优于静态图变体。
🔸 路由分析坦承弱风险引导策略未超越All-Simple（N@10为0.0370对0.0379），也未优于等比例随机路由，其66.9%的Cautious路由比例不应被解读为高偏差用户占比；单种子点估计且未声明统计显著性。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，本文的核心创新在于把用户级弱风险估计从训练期干预或输出端后处理，前移为解码前的提示路由控制信号，定位有一定新意；弱标签来自评论投票信号，构建成本较低且避免了认定恶意身份的强假设，实验叙述也较为诚实，明确指出路由未带来优于统一策略的证据。局限方面：路由收益未获验证削弱了核心机制的实用说服力；弱标签本身受投票偏差影响；时序图聚合相对静态快照优势不明显；结果为单种子点估计，Beauty上相对基线的大幅提升也可能部分来自骨干与组件差异而非路由本身，未来需更多数据集与校准研究支撑。

papers.title: SNOMED CT Concept Recommendation from Masked Clinical Context
institutions: Informatics and Analytics, University of North Carolina Greensboro
papers.primary_institution: Informatics and Analytics, University of North Carolina Greensboro
papers.reason: 提供评测、数据或综述视角，便于校准实验设计并定位研究空白。
papers.abstract: Standardizing clinical language to SNOMED CT supports interoperability, analytics, and reusable phenotyping, but concept recommendation remains difficult when relevant concepts are rare or absent from training data. We present a masked-concept recommendation benchmark using the SNOMED CT Entity Linking Challenge v1.2.1 data derived from MIMIC-IV-Note. The dataset contains 75,491 annotations across 272 discharge summaries, with 204 notes used for training and 68 for historical testing. For each unique note-concept pair, the target mention is masked from a local clinical context and the system ranks SNOMED CT concepts observed during training. We compare a popularity baseline, sparse TF-IDF concept prototypes, dense latent semantic analysis embeddings, sparse-dense fusion, retrieved-note evidence, and a retrieval-augmented hybrid. Sparse TF-IDF performs best, achieving Recall@1 of 14.81%, Recall@10 of 33.43%, MRR of 0.2114, and nDCG@10 of 0.2297. Retrieval augmentation does not improve this baseline, with Recall@10 of 31.99% and MRR of 0.1937. Performance is strongly affected by concept frequency: Recall@10 is 7.74% for concepts appearing in only one or two training notes versus 43.90% for concepts appearing in more than ten. In addition, 9.66% of test note-concept pairs contain concepts unseen during training. These findings show that local lexical context and terminology coverage are major determinants of recommendation quality in low-resource settings and provide a reproducible baseline for future ontology-grounded and biomedical-encoder retrieval systems.
papers.article_theme: 从掩码临床上下文中推荐SNOMED CT概念
papers.research_question: 论文研究在目标概念提及被遮蔽的条件下，仅凭局部临床上下文能否准确恢复缺失的SNOMED CT概念，以及从训练笔记检索证据是否能在最强上下文基线之上提升排序。难点在于术语库高度长尾、训练数据极度稀疏且候选词汇表封闭。
papers.main_contribution: 论文基于SNOMED CT Entity Linking Challenge v1.2.1构建了可复现的掩码概念推荐基准，并在防泄漏历史划分下系统比较流行度、稀疏TF-IDF原型、稠密LSA、稀疏-稠密融合、笔记检索证据及检索增强混合等方法。结果表明稀疏TF-IDF最强，而整篇笔记级检索增强反而显著降低性能，长尾频率与术语覆盖才是主导因素。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 任务构造：对每个唯一笔记-概念对，以首个标注提及为锚点，遮蔽局部350字符窗口内目标概念的所有表面形式，防止直接字符串匹配，迫使模型依赖上下文。
🔸 稀疏原型：用词级TF-IDF（一元+二元、子线性TF、最小文档频率2、最多5万特征）表示掩码上下文，对每个概念取归一化均值原型，按余弦相似度排序5,317个训练候选概念。
🔸 稠密与融合：对TF-IDF矩阵做截断SVD得96维LSA嵌入并构建概念质心，再通过内部验证选出0.75/0.25的稀疏-稠密混合权重。
🔸 检索增强：每个查询检索最相似的10篇训练笔记，对候选概念累积相似度加权证据，并以0.85稀疏-稠密+0.15检索的权重形成检索增强混合；另设概念共现图的oracle诊断条件。
🔸 评估设计：仅在训练出现的12,809个封闭词汇测试对上计算Recall@k、MRR、nDCG@10，并按概念频率分层、报告覆盖率和按笔记聚类的配对bootstrap置信区间。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 稀疏TF-IDF表现最佳：Recall@1为14.81%，Recall@10为33.43%，MRR为0.2114，nDCG@10为0.2297；稠密LSA仅17.10% Recall@10，融合后反而低于纯稀疏模型。
🔸 检索增强无益甚至有害：混合模型Recall@10为31.99%、MRR为0.1937，配对笔记聚类bootstrap显示其显著低于稀疏基线（Recall@10差-0.0144，95% CI -0.0184至-0.0104）。
🔸 长尾主导性能：稀疏模型Recall@10在1-2笔记概念上仅7.74%，3-10笔记为16.61%，超过10笔记达43.90%；66.45%训练概念出现在至多两个笔记中。
🔸 覆盖限制：9.66%（1,370个）测试对的目标概念不在训练词汇表中；若全部计为失败，最强模型Recall@10降至30.20%、MRR降至0.1910。
🔸 局限包括：遮蔽任务是构造性回溯任务而非原始挑战端点、仅用204篇笔记且以整篇为检索单元、稠密表示非生物医学编码器、oracle图条件非可部署系统，且数据来自单一机构。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，这篇文章的价值在于其诚实和可复现性：作者没有追逐检索增强的热点叙事，而是用严格的历史划分、配对bootstrap和频率分层评估，清楚展示了在204篇笔记支撑5,317个候选概念的低资源场景下，整篇笔记级检索增强不仅无益反而系统性降低排序质量。稀疏TF-IDF胜过稠密LSA的结论有明确的方差压缩解释，并不暗示神经编码器无效。主要局限在于任务本身是构造性的，遮蔽恢复与真实实体链接和临床编码场景仍有距离；检索粒度停留在整篇笔记层面，句子或提及为中心的细粒度检索未验证；且缺少完整SNOMED CT术语库使得零样本场景无法评估。这些作者均已在局限部分坦承，为后续术语级、本体支撑的RAG系统设定了清晰的改进基线。

papers.title: Efficient Swing Computation for Retrieval in Large-Scale Recommender Systems
institutions: Hong Kong Baptist University, Hong Kong SAR, China
papers.primary_institution: Hong Kong Baptist University, Hong Kong SAR, China
papers.reason: 提供评测、数据或综述视角，便于校准实验设计并定位研究空白。
papers.abstract: Given a user-item graph $G$, a query item $v_q$ and a target item $v_t$, the Swing score $sw(v_q, v_t)$ of the item pair $(v_q, v_t)$ leverages the user-item-user interaction structure to evaluate their similarity. This measure is found to be highly effective in item-to-item (i2i) retrieval task and finds extensive applications in industrial-scale recommender systems. However, existing solutions towards computing Swing scores are either prohibitively expensive due to their quadratic time complexity w.r.t. the item degree, or rely on truncation heuristics that yield unsatisfactory quality, rendering them impractical particularly on graphs with billions of interactions. In this paper, we present ASC and $K$-ASC, two novel and efficient algorithms for approximate and top-$K$ Swing queries, to address the aforementioned limitations. Specifically, these algorithms provide rigorous theoretical guarantees in probabilistic relative and additive errors of Swing values. The basic idea of ASC is to combine two randomized algorithms, GNS and USS, in a simple yet non-trivial way to adaptively process high- and low-degree query items with minimal runtime cost. In particular, $K$-ASC offers practical efficiency and effectiveness for top-$K$ queries through a filter-refinement paradigm with carefully-designed heuristics. Extensive experiments over eight real datasets demonstrate that ASC and $K$-ASC can achieve orders of magnitude speed-up over competitors in terms of computational time while offering the same approximate and top-$K$ query result quality, and in particular, $K$-ASC is highly efficient on massive graphs including the billion-edge Yambda and MAG datasets.
papers.article_theme: 大规模推荐系统中高效的Swing相似度近似计算
papers.research_question: Swing是工业推荐中重要的item-to-item召回相似度，但精确计算需枚举用户对，在数十亿交互的图上热门物品单次查询可能耗时数小时；现有截断启发式又损失质量。论文研究如何在给定(ε,λ)-近似误差保证下快速计算Swing及top-K Swing查询。
papers.main_contribution: 论文形式化定义了(ε,λ)-近似Swing查询，提出ASC框架：以QFilter++位编码加速交集基数计算，用GNS与USS两种采样器并基于经验成本模型自适应切换；进一步提出K-ASC，采用过滤-精炼范式先用少量样本生成候选与边界集，再自适应精炼。方法具有严格理论保证，在8个真实数据集上比精确方法快数量级。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 QFilter++用BSR位编码表示用户交互集，基数计算仅需bitwise AND加popcount，无需物化交集，配合LightGRO降低BSR构建预处理开销；
🔸 GNS对用户对分组采样并记录重复次数，每个distinct用户对只做一次集合交集，基于Chernoff界确定样本量，提供无偏(ε,λ)-近似估计；
🔸 USS枚举有效用户对但对较小交互集均匀采样并以比例倒数补偿，保持严格无偏；ASC按经验运行时间成本模型（ρ=0.5）在USS与GNS间自适应选择，运行时间为两者之min；
🔸 K-ASC先用β·n样本贪婪生成top-(K+κ)候选，用经验Bernstein置信界划分置信候选与边界候选，再对边界集（通常小于32项）自适应精确或采样精炼；
🔸 基于Welford式分组在线更新维护估计均值与方差，附录证明非边界项为(ε,λ/β)、边界项为(ε,λ/(1−β))近似，成功概率至少1−δ。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 实验覆盖8个数据集（最大MAG含11亿边），ASC相对Exact在大图Yambda/MAG上达100×加速，热门/随机查询相对GNS约3×/5×加速；
🔸 K-ASC在MAG上对top-100查询平均精度>99.9%、耗时1.5ms，Exact需8.5s；i2i检索中K-ASC比精确Swing快逾4,000×且保留约99%召回；
🔸 消融显示QFilter++最高加速3.68×、LightGRO在Yambda预处理加速至6.7×，ρ参数不敏感、κ=5位于精度-效率拐点；
🔸 动态更新除Yambda外平均插入/删除延迟低于9μs/8μs；局限包括K-ASC为启发式无严格正确性（认证变体C-KASC开销过大，如Yambda上85,208.5ms vs 319.7ms）、K增大时加速下降、Yambda上额外内存较高。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，这篇论文的创新性在于把工业界广泛使用但计算昂贵的Swing相似度第一次纳入严格的近似查询理论框架，将成本模型自适应、位运算交集加速与过滤-精炼范式有机结合，兼顾了理论保证与工程实用性，开源实现与微秒级动态更新使其具备落地价值。局限也比较明显：K-ASC主方案是启发式的，其认证变体在分数接近时退化为精确计算；BSR预处理与空间开销仍高于hashmap，大度数用户场景（如Yambda）的更新与内存成本偏高；实验为单机环境，未验证分布式场景。整体是一项理论与系统并重的扎实工作。

papers.title: FlashVector: Agent for Hierarchical Model Serving Stack Optimization
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: Model serving is one of the largest cost drivers in production recommender systems. Maximizing its throughput requires navigating a deeply layered hierarchy: GPU kernels, the ML framework computation graph, the model server, and on-demand feature processing -- each demanding specialized domain expertise. Such cross-layer expertise is inherently difficult to acquire, and does not scale with a workload that continuously grows and evolves, leaving significant cost efficiency gains unrealized. While recent AI agents have demonstrated human expert level efficiency in standalone GPU kernel optimization, automated tuning and optimization for the rest of the serving stack remain largely unexplored. We present FlashVector, an agentic system that optimizes performance across all layers of the model serving stack. The key contribution is an extensible framework to generalize the single kernel optimization agent paradigm to heterogeneous technical stacks, and to deliver performance improvements holistically. After deployment in Unity's Vector advertising platform, FlashVector achieved up to 2x throughput increase and up to 1.98x latency speedup on model server, and up to 1.6x throughput increase on feature store. These optimizations were discovered not only at the GPU kernel and computation graph levels, but also across the other components of the model serving stack, such as the model server (NVIDIA Triton's C++ codebase) and the on-demand feature transformation service (Python codebase), demonstrating the extensibility of the framework to more complex system architectures.
papers.article_theme: Agent自动优化层级模型服务栈全链路性能
papers.research_question: 论文研究如何将LLM驱动的GPU kernel优化agent范式扩展到整个层级模型服务栈（GPU kernel、计算图、模型服务器、按需特征处理）。难点在于各层工具链、编程语言和性能信号高度异构，且代码与运行时参数需联合优化，还必须在保持生产SLA的前提下持续对抗模型重训、流量漂移和硬件更替带来的优化衰减。
papers.main_contribution: FlashVector提出一个可扩展的agentic系统，通过统一的层agent抽象（Profile、Diagnose、Optimize、Verify加Refine五个阶段）让任意服务层接入同一优化闭环。其核心机制是“局部优化、全局验证”：每层独立提出候选改动，但只有通过重放生产流量、在固定延迟SLO下端到端收益超过噪声底的改动才被保留。系统在Unity Vector广告平台部署后实现模型服务器最高2×吞吐、1.98×延迟加速，特征库最高1.6×吞吐提升。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 知识库预编译：覆盖业务逻辑、Triton服务器、特征库、模型实现、NVIDIA GPU硬件与专家优化手册，为每层agent提供领域专属上下文，避免通用文档浪费上下文窗口或遗漏关键信号。
🔸 闭环优化循环（Algorithm 1）：每次迭代随机采样一层，执行该层自己的Profile（如Nsight/eBPF）、Diagnose（按时间占比×预期收益排序瓶颈假设）、Optimize（生成代码或配置改动）、Verify流程，Refine阶段将结果回写知识库。
🔸 分级正确性门槛：确定性重写要求逐元素完全相等；浮点重排序重写要求元素级偏差≤10^-3（FP16）且超限元素≤0.1%；有意近似改由业务指标把关；配置改动通过shadow-traffic金丝雀验证。
🔸 噪声底控制：基线重复运行估计±6%端到端噪声底，2–6%区间的收益需以最多8×样本量复测（噪声随1/√k收紧至2.1%），局部通过的改动还需全栈负载测试确认无端到端回退。
🔸 常驻自动触发：新版本进入集群或配置过期时循环自动重启，从历史接受/拒绝记录出发，缓解优化随重训、流量漂移和硬件更替而衰减的问题。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 生产模型整体收益显著：六个模型的延迟加速1.30×–1.98×，吞吐提升1.10×–2.00×；Case 1发现Triton gRPC到Python后端的字符串反序列化瓶颈，改写为C++后该环节提速30×，并回馈到NVIDIA Triton开源项目。
🔸 Case 2融合注意力内核将六kernel合一、中间值驻留寄存器，注意力延迟从996.5µs降至279.8µs（3.56×）；嵌入层重构使GPU kernel总时间降33.4%、前向延迟降30.1%。
🔸 Case 3特征预处理经Cython内核、零拷贝I/O和组装重写三步迭代，单pod吞吐从940 RPS升至约1.5k（1.6×），各轮调用点加速从4.4×到350×不等。
🔸 Case 4参数调优显示同一已代码优化模型的配置间持续吞吐差异超2×，agent以PR形式交付四个生产模型的调优结果。
🔸 局限：验证依赖重放生产流量的基础设施与详尽知识库，依赖专家整理的优化手册；参数搜索目前仅覆盖实例数与动态batch两个维度，且结果均在Unity自身平台验证，缺少跨平台泛化证据。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，这篇论文的创新点不在于单一算法，而在于把kernel agent的profile–diagnose–optimize–verify范式系统化地推广到多语言、多仓库的异构服务栈，并以层agent抽象、全局验证和知识回写解决了局部收益与端到端收益不一致的工程难题。其工业部署数据和向开源社区回馈的修复增强了可信度与实用价值。局限在于：正确性阈值和噪声底设定依赖具体业务场景；知识库需专家预编译，冷启动成本高；报告以案例形式呈现，缺乏与人工优化或其他自动化方案的受控对比。总体上，这是agentic系统作为参考代码与高性能生产系统之间桥梁的一个有说服力的早期实例。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Memory for Generative Recommendation
papers.reason: 关注生成式建模、语义标识或物品生成，适合跟踪端到端推荐新范式。
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation has emerged as a promising end-to-end paradigm for personalized recommendation. However, user preferences continuously evolve over time, making self-evolving an essential capability for generative recommender systems. Existing evolving strategies, such as continual retraining and distillation-based adaptation, directly update the shared model parameters using streaming interactions. Nevertheless, we find that directly applying such strategies to generative recommendation introduces a critical issue, termed evolution conflict. Specifically, heterogeneous preference shifts from different users are optimized within a fully shared autoregressive parameter space, causing dominant behavioral patterns to progressively dominate the model evolution process while underrepresented patterns become increasingly overlooked. To address this issue, we propose a self-evolving memory paradigm for generative recommendation, aiming to enable effective evolution across heterogeneous behavioral patterns. We further identify three key principles for effective self-evolving recommendation systems, including isolated memorization, reinforced evolution, and scalable application. Guided by these principles, we develop LION, a simple yet effective framework centered on a sparse Key-Value memory layer. Specifically, LION introduces sparse memory activation to isolate the evolution of different behavioral patterns, while a consolidation loss is designed to reinforce the learning of underrepresented preference dynamics during continual adaptation. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of LION under various continual evolution settings (e.g., per-period evaluation, user/item group evaluation, and evolution convergence analysis). The codes are released at https://github.com/JazyJiang/Self-Evolving-Memory-for-Generative-Recommendation.
papers.article_theme: 稀疏KV记忆解决生成式推荐的进化冲突问题
papers.research_question: 生成式推荐在流式数据上持续进化时，不同用户的异构偏好变化在同一共享自回归参数空间中优化，导致优势行为模式主导进化、弱势模式被忽视，即“进化冲突”。如何在不引入过高参数与计算开销的前提下，让异构行为模式实现隔离式、可持续的进化是核心难题。
papers.main_contribution: 论文首次识别并分析生成式推荐中的“进化冲突”问题，提出自进化记忆范式及三条设计原则：隔离记忆、强化进化与可扩展应用。据此开发LION框架，以稀疏Key-Value记忆层为核心，通过查询驱动的稀疏激活实现模式隔离，并用整合损失（consolidation loss）强化弱势偏好的学习，辅以梯度冲突降低与收敛加速的理论分析。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸在TIGER等自回归推荐骨干的中间层插入稀疏KV记忆层，记忆查询取自用户完整历史序列，而骨干仅计算近期子序列，兼顾行为全貌与计算效率。
🔸稀疏激活：根据隐藏表示与记忆键的相似度选Top-K记忆槽，加权聚合后加回隐藏状态，使不同行为模式路由到不同记忆参数，实现隔离进化。
🔸整合损失直接监督记忆增强表示的下一项预测，为低频弱势模式提供更强的监督信号，与主推荐损失联合优化。
🔸理论上证明梯度冲突被限制在激活集合的重叠区域，冲突比例不超过重叠率ρ，且组合表达力C(N,K)远超用户规模，参数量2Nd与用户数无关、随用户增长严格更省。
🔸每个进化周期对新流数据持续微调骨干与记忆参数，更新后的模型服务下一周期，形成可部署的流式自适应流程。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸在Amazon Games/CDs/Toys三数据集上，LION较TIGER基线R@10分别提升29.8%、35.5%、15.6%，多数指标超过Replay、SAIL-PIW、LSAT、PESO等基线。
🔸非活跃用户组（G3-G5）收益最大且各周期增益稳定，验证隔离机制直接缓解进化冲突而非一次性初始化优势。
🔸消融显示单独加整合损失反而伤害性能、单独稀疏记忆层提升有限，二者与全序列查询结合才充分发挥作用，整合损失是主要驱动力。
🔸梯度余弦分析显示LION使活跃/非活跃用户及热门/长尾物品梯度方向转为正对齐，且收敛更快、收敛损失更低。
🔸记忆规模实验中在16×词表和4×K变化内R@10波动不超过±0.4%，扩展性好；局限包括固定Top-K路由、仅在T5骨干验证。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，本文的核心创新在于把持续学习中的梯度冲突视角引入生成式推荐，并用稀疏KV记忆作为隔离演化的具体载体，问题定义清晰、理论分析与实证互相印证，思路简洁且工程代价低，对非活跃用户和长尾物品的改善具有明显的公平性与商业价值。不过其实验仍局限于中小规模Amazon数据集和T5骨干，整合损失依赖记忆隔离才有效这一点说明机制较脆弱，Top-K固定路由与记忆键的长期可塑性也未充分探讨；与多LoRA、MoE等隔离范式的深度结合以及工业级验证是未来需补足的方向。

papers.title: Evaluating Brand Retrieval and Ranking in Large Language Model Recommendations
institutions: Northwestern University, 1845 Sheridan Road, Evanston, IL, USA
papers.primary_institution: Northwestern University, 1845 Sheridan Road, Evanston, IL, USA
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for product recommendation, but evaluating their recommendations presents challenges that differ from conventional information retrieval and recommender systems. LLMs can generate recommendations without an explicit candidate set, and repeated responses to the same query can produce different brands and rankings. We introduce a framework for evaluating open-ended LLM brand recommendations that defines the competitive set independently of model outputs and estimates recommendation prevalence and prominence through repeated sampling. We operationalize these constructs using Brand Recommendation Probability (BRP@$k$) and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@$k$), and apply the framework to six LLMs across five product categories. Category-only queries reveal substantial omission of established brands and limited evidence that recommendation prominence follows conventional brand popularity. Instead, prominence is associated with broader marketplace-visibility signals, particularly search interest and online brand conversation. Needs-based queries show that contextualizing users' goals and constraints changes which brands are retrieved, while diagnostic positioning probes demonstrate that brands omitted from ordinary recommendations can remain conditionally retrievable when distinctive cues are supplied. These findings highlight the need to evaluate LLM recommendation as a stochastic retrieval-and-ranking process rather than from individual generated lists. We provide open-source software and data to support reproducible evaluation of LLM-generated brand recommendations.
papers.article_theme: 用BRP与MRR重复采样评估LLM品牌推荐
papers.research_question: 论文研究如何评估开放式LLM品牌推荐：由于LLM可在无固定候选集情况下生成推荐、且同一提示的重复回答会给出不同品牌与排序，品牌进入生成集合的频率与显著程度难以测量。难点在于竞争集合不可直接观测，遗漏品牌会被忽略。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出五步评估框架：独立于LLM定义竞争集合，用重复采样估计品牌推荐概率（BRP@k）与平均倒数排名（MRR@k），并结合基于需求的提示与定位探针进行匹配与诊断。通过对六个商用LLM、五个产品类别的实验，提供了开源软件与数据，支持可复现的品牌审计。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 将LLM视为“涌现的选择架构师”，提出“生成集合”概念：品牌集合由模型在推荐时即时构造，须以概率分布而非单次列表来刻画。
🔸 采用两阶段抽样：选取六个商用LLM，对每类每模型发出40次独立的类目型提示，共1,200份推荐列表，用BRP@k衡量推荐普遍性、MRR@k衡量推荐显著性。
🔸 Explore阶段用广告、新闻、Brandwatch、Google Trends、Wikipedia浏览量五项市场可见性指标，以fractional logit加岭回归（交叉验证选λ）探索与MRR的关联，并明确为探索性而非因果分析。
🔸 Match阶段使用100个基于需求的详细提示（每类20个场景）重复采样，比较特定需求下BRP/MRR与类目基线的差异。
🔸 Diagnose阶段用含品牌定位语言的诊断探针测试条件可检索性，区分“模型不知品牌”与“品牌知识未被普通提示激活”两种情形。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 类目型提示下许多知名品牌（如L.L.Bean、Craftsman、Braun、Freshpet、Virgin Voyages等）完全未被推荐，市场地位不保证进入生成集合。
🔸 流行度偏差证据有限：邮轮类最显著品牌MRR较高，但Viking显著性高而迪士尼邮轮几乎不被推荐；电钻与登山夹克倾向推荐DeWalt、Patagonia等高端品牌。
🔸 当BRP@5相同时，MRR能进一步区分位次，如电钻类五个品牌BRP@5=1但排名差异明显。
🔸 岭回归显示Google搜索兴趣是最强预测信号，其次是品牌在线讨论，新闻、广告和Wikipedia在联合建模后系数接近于零；结果在无正则化和lasso模型下稳健，但属观察性关联。
🔸 Craftsman与L.L.Bean在需求提示下BRP@5分别升至35.4%和5.4%，诊断探针下达81.3%和88.5%，说明遗漏不代表知识缺失；但该诊断仅基于两个品牌、少量手写提示，需更大规模验证。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，本文的创新性在于把评估对象从固定候选集转移到随机的“生成集合”，用重复采样与BRP/MRR把LLM推荐变成可统计推断的量，为营销领域的GEO与品牌审计提供了可操作的方法论，理论上是考虑集理论向LLM中介决策的自然延伸。实用价值明显：企业可用它监测自家品牌是否进入LLM推荐及位次。但局限也较突出：市场可见性分析受多重共线性影响且只能给出探索性关联；类目仅五类、价格档位模式仅在两类出现，需求与诊断部分样本极小；实验使用无历史的新会话，未涵盖真实用户上下文，普适性尚待检验。

papers.title: LazFormer: Scaling Transformers for Industrial Recommendation via Transferable Generative Pre-training
institutions: Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group, Beijing, China, {limingxi.lxd, alin.fal, lmy398032, yanwei.xy, nsc383441, sichu.zjf, lin.lsc, zhanming.ozm, luotao.lt, yuanhan}@alibaba-inc.com
papers.primary_institution: Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group, Beijing, China, {limingxi.lxd, alin.fal, lmy398032, yanwei.xy, nsc383441, sichu.zjf, lin.lsc, zhanming.ozm, luotao.lt, yuanhan}@alibaba-inc.com
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: Transformers have shown promising performance in LLMs due to their outstanding scalability, several studies have investigated the scalability of Transformers for industrial recommendation. They typically rely on a single ranking model to optimize both sparse and dense parameters from scratch, resulting in substantial computational resource consumption and slow convergence. Fortunately, the pre-training models offer an effective solution to the above issues by providing favorable initialization of both sparse and dense parameters for the subsequent ranking. However, they still face two major limitations: (1) Since the input features used in pre-training and ranking are usually inconsistent, directly transferring dense parameters from pre-training to ranking may lead to negative transfer. (2) Multi-epoch training during the ranking process may result in the overfitting of sparse parameters, while freezing the sparse parameters limits their adaptability to the ranking objectives. To this end, we propose a Scaling Transformer for Industrial Recommendation via Transferable Generative Pre-training, termed LazFormer. Specifically, we first present a generative pre-training module to autoregressively generate sequential features, providing favorable initialization of both sparse and dense parameters for the subsequent ranking. To solve the negative transfer of dense parameters, we propose a transferable residual adapter that injects additional ranking-specific features into ranking in a residual manner. Moreover, a request-aware ranking module integrates long-sequence compression, hybrid sparse attention, and a request-aware paradigm to efficiently model users' long sequences. Besides, we further propose an asymmetric multi-epoch training strategy that resets sparse parameters while continuously accumulating dense parameters across epochs, alleviating the overfitting of sparse parameters.
papers.article_theme: LazFormer：可迁移生成式预训练驱动的工业推荐缩放
papers.research_question: 工业推荐中Transformer排序模型通常从零联合优化稀疏和稠密参数，导致计算资源消耗大、收敛慢。如何将生成式预训练参数有效迁移到下游排序，同时避免稠密参数负迁移和稀疏参数多轮训练过拟合，是核心难点。
papers.main_contribution: 提出LazFormer框架，通过生成式预训练为稀疏与稠密参数提供良好初始化；引入可迁移残差适配器以残差方式注入排序专属特征，解决稠密参数负迁移；结合请求感知排序模块与非对称多epoch训练策略，实现模型容量与训练数据的协同缩放，并已在真实工业推荐系统部署验证。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 生成式预训练：对用户历史交互序列做自回归下一item预测（in-batch负采样、可学习温度），联合学习可迁移的稀疏item表示和稠密Transformer参数，为排序提供初始化。
🔸 可迁移残差适配器：受LoRA启发，将加购、下单等排序专属特征经下投影-上投影生成残差表示并加到共享token上，W_up零初始化使训练从预训练表示平滑起步，避免扰动预训练表示空间。
🔸 请求感知排序：以请求为样本单位，同一用户历史只序列化、传输和编码一次，同时处理同请求内全部候选目标item，配合注意力掩码保持各候选预测独立。
🔸 高效长序列建模：粗细结合压缩（保留短期精细token、长期分组求和池化）、混合稀疏注意力（因果滑窗+全局token+目标全 attend 历史）、逐层渐进式token剪枝，用flex attention编译块稀疏核。
🔸 非对称多epoch训练：每个epoch开始时将稀疏参数重置回预训练状态，稠密参数跨epoch持续累积，缓解稀疏过拟合的同时扩展有效训练数据。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 离线实验：LazFormer默认配置CTR AUC 0.7735、CVR AUC 0.8905，在同配置对齐的LazFormer*已超越HSTU、OneTrans、SORT、STCA等基线，且训练FLOPs低于vanilla Transformer。
🔸 消融验证：直接拼接或预投影融合排序专属特征均劣于残差适配器；持续更新稀疏参数训练3个epoch性能严重退化（AUC 0.7387），重置策略则明显优于连续更新。
🔸 缩放实验：模型容量、序列长度（512到9216）、训练数据三个维度上AUC/GAUC均随计算预算单调提升。
🔸 效率权衡：所选稀疏配置达92.63%稀疏度和5.1×注意力加速，仅0.10pt AUC损失；长序列压缩策略6在性能与训练时间上取得最佳平衡。
🔸 线上A/B：两周线上测试IPV +5.21%、订单 +3.38%、买家 +3.70%、GMV +9.85%，但A10 GPU单机吞吐下降12.1%。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，LazFormer的创新点在于将预训练-排序范式从仅迁移稀疏参数推进到稀疏与稠密参数的可迁移协同优化，残差适配器的零初始化设计和稀疏参数逐epoch重置的策略简单而有效，直击负迁移与过拟合两大痛点。其工程实用价值突出：请求级样本组织、混合稀疏注意力和渐进剪枝共同支撑了长序列下的可部署性，线上GMV +9.85%的结果颇具说服力。局限方面，所有实验基于单一电商平台数据，缺乏公开基准验证；多epoch重置策略的理论解释较弱；稀疏参数重置是否在特征更新快的场景长期有效仍需观察，跨场景泛化性也有待更多证据。

papers.title: TEAR: Table Extraction with Attribute Recommendation from Texts via Large Language Models
institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Hong Kong SAR, China
Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Guangzhou, China
South China Normal University, Guangzhou, China
papers.primary_institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Hong Kong SAR, China
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: Table extraction from texts is an important task for information systems, and recent approaches that prompt large language models (LLMs) with instructions have drawn great attention for their strong performance. Existing works have assumed the input texts to be table descriptions or specialized documents. However, these efforts have largely overlooked another prevalent category of texts, commonly found in news reports and social media: naturally occurring texts. Extracting tabular information from such texts poses two distinct challenges. First, high variability and the absence of explicit structural cues make fixed heuristic LLM prompts limited in precisely delineating extraction boundaries. Second, manually predefined schemas cannot capture open-ended, unseen attributes in naturally occurring text. In this paper, we propose a framework, TEAR, to address these challenges. It comprises two synergistic workflows: a Table Extraction Workflow that dynamically adapts instructions to overcome the limitation of heuristic instructions, and an Attribute Recommendation Workflow that discovers new attributes from texts to complement the heuristic schema. To our knowledge, TEAR is the first framework that supports automated text-driven attribute recommendation, enabling exploratory schema design for table extraction. To evaluate TEAR, we establish the benchmark for table extraction and attribute recommendation on naturally occurring texts, including two real-world datasets, manual annotations, appropriate metrics, and baseline comparisons. Experiments show that TEAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks, and the recommended attributes effectively enhance extraction performance in exploratory scenarios.
papers.article_theme: TEAR：面向自然文本的表格抽取与属性推荐框架
papers.research_question: 论文研究如何从自然发生文本（如新闻报道、社交媒体）中抽取表格。此类文本缺乏结构线索且不遵循固定模板，导致固定启发式指令难以划定抽取边界、人工预定义模式无法覆盖开放未见的属性。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出TEAR框架，包含表格抽取工作流（TEW）与属性推荐工作流（ARW）。TEW通过主动演示模块为每条文本动态选择示例以自适应指令；ARW通过发现机制、混合整合策略与模式一致性评分，首次实现文本驱动的开放属性推荐，支持探索式模式设计，并建立了相应的基准数据集与评测方法。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 主动演示模块：先由轻量代理模型（BART-Large）模糊预测表头预览与值预览，再基于表头效用、值效用和语义效用三种分数从标注池检索示例，注入抽取指令中消解抽取边界的歧义。
🔸 发现机制：将开放属性发现建模为表格扩列任务，通过示例引导LLM为已抽取表添加新列，使属性建议扎根于文本而非凭空编造。
🔸 混合整合策略：先用基于Vendi Score的多样性检查筛出低多样性子集，再以广度优先贪心迭代让LLM做二元的等价判断，去重整合全局候选属性集并控制调用成本。
🔸 模式一致性评分：将候选属性名在给定模式前缀下的条件概率作为整体一致性度量，仅需一次前向传播即可排序推荐列表。
🔸 新评测协议：提出不依赖逻辑索引的结构化F1（基于记录字典匹配的DF1）与召回AUC，构建Incidents、Weather两个新数据集并适配MultiWoz对话数据。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在三个数据集、三种开源LLM骨干上，TEAR在表格抽取与属性推荐上均优于TRE、MapMake、RAG等基线，AR任务在54组比较中48次最优。
🔸 效率方面，TE的耗时顺序为TRE>RAG>TEAR>MapMake，AR中排于CFR、MSS、DIRECT之后；混合整合策略平均去除约11%（Qwen）至15%（Llama3-8B）的重复候选，且对召回影响很小。
🔸 消融显示表头与值效用检索优于纯语义检索，三者联合最佳；少量示例（1-shot起）即可大幅提升性能；标注池扩大带来收益但存在数据集差异，池初始化影响很小。
🔸 与人工判断的重复属性一致性上，Qwen达到实质一致（κ=0.73-0.87），人工评测验证结构化F1与人类偏好高度对齐（准确率90%-95%）。
🔸 局限在于属性推荐无内在收敛点，仅处理单轮推荐；代理模型与多数检索示例依赖少量标注数据，Weather等数据集对标签需求更高。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，本文的真正创新在于把text-to-table从封闭模式推进到探索式场景：属性推荐作为任务被系统化定义，并用表格扩列、多样性检查去重与条件概率排序三条机制落地，工程完整度高。结构化F1摆脱逻辑索引的做法也更贴合自然文本的实际语义。实用价值上，方案只需少量标注即可适配中等规模开源模型，适合新闻监控、客服归档等真实场景。可能的局限包括：代理模型的预测质量直接决定演示检索效果；属性等价判断本质主观，用户偏好未必与模式一致性排序吻合；属性覆盖的召回评估依赖人工构造的真值模式，开放性属性空间下其完备性难以保证。

papers.title: Generate to Explore, Select to Exploit: Aligning LLM-based Headline Generation with Personalized Recommendation
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: In industrial recommendation feeds, presenting a static headline for an item often fails to satisfy the diverse, multimodal interests of the user population, particularly suppressing the needs of long-tail audiences. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have been integrated into recommendation for content understanding or ranking, directly optimizing them to output a single best headline typically leads to mode collapse---converging to generic patterns that satisfy average tastes but miss specific latent intents. To bridge this gap, we introduce GESE (Generate to Explore, Select to Exploit), a framework operating at the system's presentation layer that decouples personalization into generative exploration and selective exploitation. First, we treat the LLM as a probabilistic explorer, utilizing Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) with a hierarchical reward mechanism to generate a candidate set that maximizes the semantic coverage of potential user interests. Subsequently, a lightweight, real-time feedback-aware selector acts as the exploiter, identifying the optimal realization from the candidate pool based on instant contextual signals. Extensive deployment on a commercial platform with over 100 million daily active users demonstrates that GESE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 2.57% lift in CTR and 0.87% in dwell time. These results validate that decoupling diversity-oriented generation from precision-oriented selection offers a robust blueprint for aligning generative AI with dynamic user utility.
papers.article_theme: 生成多样标题再实时选择以提升个性化推荐
papers.research_question: 工业推荐系统的展示层中，让LLM直接输出单一最优标题容易因用户画像噪声与多峰兴趣导致模式坍缩，生成安全但平庸的标题。论文研究如何将个性化标题生成从点估计重构为分布覆盖问题，兼顾多样性与精确性。
papers.main_contribution: 提出GESE框架，将个性化解耦为生成式探索与选择性利用两个阶段：LLM以GSPO和分层奖励训练，单次推理生成覆盖潜在兴趣的候选标题集；轻量级实时反馈选择器（置信感知Thompson采样+深度排序器）从候选池中为具体用户挑选最优标题。该框架在亿级DAU平台上部署，验证了多样性是个性化的前提。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 生成阶段：基于Qwen3-14B，用3万样本SFT使模型单次推理输出K个结构化候选标题，避免多次采样的计算开销和独立采样向众数聚集的问题。
🔸 采用GSPO进行组内相对优势归一化的强化学习，组内竞争机制数学上强制候选差异化，防止生成G个相同安全标题导致的零方差问题。
🔸 分层奖励合成个体效用（CTR奖励模型预测、NLI判别模型忠实性硬约束、基于编辑距离的新颖度）与集合级多样性（字符集IoU冗余惩罚），防止模式坍缩。
🔸 CTR奖励模型采用混合特征架构，融合Qwen-Embedding语义表示与字长、标点密度等展示偏差特征，用800万高置信交互对以Bradley-Terry损失训练。
🔸 利用阶段解决冷启动与成熟服务两级：置信感知Thompson采样（CATS）带统计终止机制控制探索预算，之后切换到融合用户画像、动态兴趣与候选语义三视图特征的深度排序器做精确选择。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在线A/B测试中GESE相对原始编辑标题实现CTR +2.57%、有效曝光 +0.79%、停留时长 +0.87%；SFT-Only基线反而下降1.5% CTR，验证逐点模仿导致模式坍缩。
🔸 离线MSR-50k评测中GESE将Self-BLEU从18.02降至9.93（约降45%），CTR Score 11.38超过SFT基线9.16及GPT-OSS-120B等更大模型，同时保持NLI 80.17的高忠实性。
🔸 消融显示移除质量约束虽使CTR Score升至12.79，但NLI暴跌至47.32，出现奖励攻击式标题党；移除多样性奖励使Self-BLEU翻倍至19.73，且CTR Score下降。
🔸 训练组件消融表明两阶段流水线必要：无RL则吸引力低且冗余高，无SFT冷启动RL则语言质量全面退化（Distinct-N-Gram仅37.83）。
🔸 局限方面，框架依赖平台实时反馈数据与奖励模型质量，GSPO训练开销和选择器特征工程的具体成本论文未详细披露。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，这篇论文的核心创新在于将个性化生成从点估计重构为集合级优化，并结构性解耦多样性与精确性两个在单一策略中数学上冲突的目标，用生成多样性对冲画像噪声的思路颇具启发性。GSPO组内归一化天然促进差异化、单次生成整组候选降低推理成本，与分层奖励兼顾忠实性，工程设计成熟务实，消融实验对奖励攻击的分析也有说服力。不过其价值高度依赖大规模实时反馈数据和成熟排序基建，中小企业难以复现；候选集规模、GSPO训练成本、曝光公平性对用户体验的潜在影响等细节论述有限，泛化到其他展示层任务仍待验证。

papers.title: TATK: Triple-Aware Top-K Learning with Knowledge-Grounded Verification for LLM-based Sequential Recommendation
institutions: School of Information Science and Engineering, East China University of Science and Technology, Shanghai, China
Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Hong Kong Institute of Science & Innovation
Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, China
School of Engineering, Westlake University, Chinayuchenguan1020@outlook.com; 23013355@mail.ecust.edu.cn; yifei.han@cair-cas.org.hkzx.zhang3@siat.ac.cn; wengsyx@gmail.com; b.li2@siat.ac.cn
papers.primary_institution: School of Information Science and Engineering, East China University of Science and Technology, Shanghai, China
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: LLM-based sequential recommenders usually cast next-item prediction as text generation, but this interface is poorly matched to full-catalog top-K ranking. We propose TATK, a Triple-Aware framework that couples Top-K Learning (TKL) with Knowledge-Grounded Verification (KGV) for LLM-based sequential recommendation. Top-K Learning combines context-aware metadata-KG prompt grounding with position-aware top-K rewards, aligning training with ranking utility; Knowledge-Grounded Verification then applies structure-aware reranking over the top-M candidates after a single LLM forward pass, using the same metadata-derived item graph. We evaluate TATK on Musical Instruments, CDs and Vinyl, and Video Games from Amazon Reviews 2023 under a matched R2ec-style full-catalog protocol. Experiments use Gemma-2-2B-It and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct backbones, compare against sequential, generative, KG-augmented, and reasoning-enhanced baselines, and include component, reward-shape, sequence-perturbation, reranking, relation-quality, and candidate-pool diagnostics. TATK improves over the matched R2ec reproduction on all 36 reported metrics. On NDCG@10, it improves Qwen by 8.05%, 4.26%, and 3.78% on the three datasets, and improves Gemma by 27.03%, 10.52%, and 10.23%, while keeping inference within 1.17x of Base RecPO latency. The diagnostics show that structural evidence is most useful for recoverable top-M candidates with reliable KG support, and should be gated when metadata relations are sparse or noisy.
papers.article_theme: 知识验证驱动的三感知Top-K序列推荐框架TATK
papers.research_question: LLM序列推荐将下一项预测当作文本生成，但该接口在全目录Top-K排序上存在输入缺乏结构支撑、训练目标与排序指标错位、生成候选缺乏验证三重失配。论文研究如何用轻量的元数据结构证据在训练和推理两个阶段弥合这些失配，而不引入额外的长推理解码。
papers.main_contribution: 提出三感知框架TATK：训练阶段的Top-K Learning将上下文感知的KG提示与位置感知的top-K奖励结合，推理阶段的知识锚定验证（KGV）对单次前向得到的top-M候选做结构感知重排。该框架复用同一元数据商品图，无需外部KG对齐、思维链监督或额外LLM前向。在三个Amazon Reviews 2023类目和两个骨干上，TATK在全部36项指标上超过匹配协议下的R2ec复现。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 从商品元数据（store/category/main category）构建轻量项图，对近期历史锚点检索结构邻居并序列化进提示，实现上下文感知锚定，历史过短时动态跳过KG注入。
🔸 Top-K Learning用线性位置奖励：目标项排名r≤K时奖励为(K−r+1)/K，组内中心化形成相对优势，与token级学习和项级推荐损失联合训练，使模型对决定HitRate@K/NDCG@K的排序位置敏感。
🔸 KGV在单次前向得到的top-M候选上，按最强关系支持加重复匹配计算结构支持度，归一化后以λ加权叠加生成得分，M=100、γ=2.5、β=0.15、λ=0.01。
🔸 重排仅作用于top-M池，复杂度约O(M|H_u|)，且每次升降可追溯到明确的store/category证据，并设有历史长度、支持度、分数带与不确定性等多重门控。
🔸 类目组上限350抑制噪声高连接组；重排仅对至少3条历史且存在KG支持候选的用户启用。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 五种子匹配实验中TATK在全部36项指标优于R2ec复现：NDCG@10在Qwen上提升8.05%/4.26%/3.78%，Gemma上提升27.03%/10.52%/10.23%；六组NDCG@10配对检验五组显著，仅Qwen-VG置信区间跨零。
🔸 消融显示TKL贡献+0.0029平均N@10，KGV再加+0.0012，两阶段互补；无门控的C+P组合反而弱于单模块，说明结构证据需选择性注入；奖励形状差异小于种子波动，位置敏感目标本身才是关键。
🔸 机制诊断：重排后75.3%目标上移，16.0%候选转化为Hit@10，KG支持与排名提升正相关（r=0.25）；加入原始共交互边虽将支持覆盖率从7.93%升至14.19%却降低N@10，低精度关系应被抑制。
🔸 效率方面保持单次解码，延迟从420ms/用户升至490ms（1.17×），显存14.8→15.0GB；M=500不再提升且延迟升至660ms，M=100为性价比默认。
🔸 局限：收益依赖信息性元数据，稀疏/噪声元数据和长尾项收益减弱；MovieLens-1M仅为初步可迁移性检查（N@10从0.0718到0.0750）；部分诊断基于三种子，小效应需谨慎解读；案例研究中存在R2ec占优的边界情形。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，TATK的核心创新在于对同一元数据图的三重复用：既做提示锚定又做训练奖励又做推理验证，用确定性的结构证据替代昂贵的长链推理，这与当前推理增强推荐的潮流形成互补视角，问题诊断（生成接口与排序任务的失配）清晰且有说服力。其诊断实验相当扎实，尤其是关系质量分析和边界案例的诚实呈现提升了可信度。实用层面，1.17×的延迟开销和可解释的升降级追踪对工业部署友好。局限在于方法对元数据字段的可分性高度敏感，关系权重与门控阈值目前靠开发集诊断手工选定，跨域泛化和自适应学习仍是未解问题；此外离线全目录排序与真实用户满意度之间的差距尚未验证。

papers.title: Efficient Multimodal Generative Recommendation with Latent Narrative Reasoning
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation reformulates item prediction as semantic identifier generation, yet episodic content introduces a fundamentally different setting where the target is determined by narrative evolution rather than user preference. This task requires models to understand multimodal storyline progression while addressing the efficiency challenges caused by redundant visual contexts and costly explicit reasoning generation. We propose \textbf{NarraLite}, an efficient multimodal generative recommendation framework that jointly compresses perception and reasoning. Specifically, Progressive Spectral Compression selectively distills long visual contexts into compact narrative-relevant evidence, preserving transition-critical information while reducing redundant visual computation. Latent Narrative Reasoning introduces context-routed latent reasoning tokens and aligns their contextualized representations with future continuation semantics, enabling implicit narrative inference without autoregressively decoding textual rationales. We further establish a user-agnostic multimodal benchmark for short-form drama continuation across UGC, PGC, and OOD settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NarraLite consistently improves continuation accuracy, narrative coherence, and robustness over existing approaches, while achieving a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off.
papers.article_theme: 潜在叙事推理实现高效多模态剧集内容推荐
papers.research_question: 论文研究剧集类内容的叙事感知推荐：目标不是匹配用户偏好，而是预测剧情自然延续的下一个片段。难点在于长视频上下文存在大量冗余视觉token，而显式思维链推理又带来高昂的自回归解码成本。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出NarraLite框架，联合压缩感知与推理两个环节：渐进式谱压缩（PSC）将长视觉上下文蒸馏为与文本互补的紧凑叙事证据，潜在叙事推理（LNR）通过上下文路由的专家潜在token实现隐式推理而无需解码文本理由。同时构建了覆盖UGC、PGC和OOD的用户无关多模态短剧续写基准。
papers.key_ideas:
