🔸 PSC先从文本token经门控池化生成叙事条件，对每帧做DCT2D变换并施加样本级频域门控，自适应保留粗场景结构或细粒度细节，再逆变换回视觉空间。
🔸 PSC对锚帧直接选top-K相关patch，后续帧先建候选池再按与已选token的最大余弦相似度计算多样性分数，跨帧去冗余地选出Kv个压缩视觉token。
🔸 LNR维护全局可学习的专家token库，轻量路由器依据观测叙事上下文用ST Gumbel Top-K激活Kr个潜在token，推理时改为确定性Top-K，追加到多模态前缀中。
🔸 引入仅训练期的目标引导对齐：以冻结教师编码真实续段文本语义，用InfoNCE将学生LLM在潜在位置的隐状态与之对齐，使潜在token编码未来叙事方向。
🔸 整体损失为SID生成损失加对齐损失，推理时用trie约束束搜索生成合法SID并映射回片段；前缀token从Mi+Pi降至Mi+Kv+Kr，潜在token并行处理而非自回归生成。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 NarraLite在Eval/UGC/PGC/OOD全部划分上取得最优H@1—H@10，Eval集H@10达0.3933，OOD达0.3090，超过Dense检索与LatentR3等生成式基线。
🔸 在惩罚视觉重复的OPSC指标上同样全面领先（Eval 0.5904、OOD 0.5506），表明预测与真实续段语义一致且不依赖表面视觉复制。
🔸 消融显示去除LNR在OOD下降明显，去除多模态输入在UGC损失更大，验证两模块互补且各场景需求不同。
🔸 超参分析显示Kv=30、Kr=2最优，更多token会重新引入冗余或冲突推理信号。
🔸 效率实验中NarraLite在精度—吞吐量空间严格支配不同分辨率的整帧变体，说明选择性压缩优于统一降分辨率。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，本文的创新点在于把叙事续写从用户偏好建模中剥离出来，并在感知与推理两端同时做轻量化：文本条件的频域压缩和上下文路由的潜在token库设计较为巧妙，将显式CoT内化为并行处理的潜在状态，兼顾了效率与结构化推理。实用价值体现在短剧等内容平台的下一集预测场景，且用户无关设定避免偏好偏差。局限方面：任务定义与自建基准较新，缺乏公开数据集上的可比性验证；短剧场景线性较强，向更复杂叙事或真实线上系统的迁移能力尚待检验；对齐损失依赖冻结教师的质量，其上限也受限于该教师模型。

papers.title: Assessing the Applicability of Existing Design Recommendations to AI Companion Design: A Multi-Method Study
institutions: Human Centered Design & Engineering, University of Washington, 1410 NE Campus Pkwy, Seattle, 98195, Washington, United States
papers.primary_institution: Human Centered Design & Engineering, University of Washington, 1410 NE Campus Pkwy, Seattle, 98195, Washington, United States
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: With the rapid proliferation of large language model (LLM)-based systems, AI companions have emerged as conversational agents designed to cultivate emotional connection rather than primarily to support humans in instrumental tasks. Because engagement with AI companions involves relational, emotional, and potentially long-term interactions, their design is consequential. Prior work has offered guidance for designing trustworthy and relational AI systems and has begun to examine design for AI companionship. However, while such work provides insights into possible design solutions, less is known about what makes AI companion design difficult as a design problem. To examine this challenge, we assessed the applicability of existing design recommendations from adjacent domains in the context of AI companion design. Our multi-method investigation unfolded across four phases: literature review, practitioner co-analysis, internal heuristic evaluation, and external expert assessment. Throughout this process, we synthesized nine design principle areas that surfaced tensions in the applicability of existing recommendations to AI companion design. Our findings show that ethical and UX-oriented considerations are deeply intertwined and often require context-sensitive application. We document a systematic, multi-method problem analysis that uses these principle areas as an analytic artifact to examine why existing recommendations cannot be directly transferred to AI companion contexts.
papers.article_theme: 现有设计建议能否适用于AI伴侣设计：多方法研究
papers.research_question: 论文试图回答：来自HCI/UX、人机交互、智能体与聊天机器人等相邻领域的现有设计建议，在多大程度上适用于AI伴侣设计，以及为什么AI伴侣设计作为一个设计问题仍然困难。难点在于AI伴侣涉及长期、情感化与关系导向的交互，伦理与体验考量交织，难以直接套用既有指南。
papers.main_contribution: 论文通过四阶段多方法问题分析（文献综述、11名从业者协同分析、内部启发式评估、14名专家评估），系统评估了548条现有设计建议对AI伴侣设计的适用性，综合出九大设计原则领域。研究发现伦理与用户体验考量深度交织，且多数原则需要情境敏感的灵活应用而非一刀切的固定准则，从而解释了现有建议不能直接迁移到AI伴侣场景的原因。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 第一阶段从通用HCI/UX、人机交互、智能体与聊天机器人、AI伴侣四类共41个来源中收集548条设计建议；第二阶段由11名从业者通过协同编码与讨论，判定其中95条不适用、453条适用，并识别初步张力。
🔸 第三阶段将453条适用建议主题综合为22条设计原则，归入九大原则领域：安全性、透明性、包容性、可预测性与一致性、交互可控性、适应与个性化、参与度、共情回应、回应长度，并在Replika和Pi AI两款产品上进行内部启发式评估。
🔸 第四阶段以改进的启发式评估让14名领域专家对Replika、Pi AI、ChatGPT和Copilot四款产品进行适用性、清晰性、重要性五点量表评分并给出开放反馈。
🔸 透明性被细分为身份、能力与限制、信息、决策四类，专家与实践者均指出披露过频会损害关系体验，需要灵活把握披露时机。
🔸 研究发现不适用于伴侣场景的建议包括强调效率、快捷方式、可撤销与直接编辑输出等原则，因为对话本身即目标，关系修复更应通过持续对话完成。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 专家评估中九大原则领域整体适用性均值4.14、重要性4.25，清晰性最低（3.92），专家反馈要求更具体的定义和落地指导。
🔸 伴侣系统适用性评分（4.27）高于通用系统（4.01），中等效应量（|g|=0.64）但未达统计显著（p=.224）；包容性差异最大且显著（|g|=2.462, p=.001）。
🔸 定性反馈揭示了新的双向关系：UX导向原则（如参与度、共情）也可能带来伦理风险，如过度参与导致用户依赖，共情可能助长有害行为。
🔸 评估均基于一次性短时间使用，未能捕捉AI伴侣长期关系型交互；第三阶段仅评估两款产品，第二阶段从业者缺乏直接的AI伴侣设计经验，作者明确承认这些局限。
🔸 作者强调九大原则领域是用于分析设计张力的分析工件，而非经过验证的可用工具包或可执行设计指南。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，这项研究的创新点不在于提出新原则，而在于把原则当作分析透镜，系统暴露了现有建议在情感化、关系型系统中的失效方式，尤其是伦理与体验考量的深度交织与情境敏感需求，这对AI伴侣这一快速扩张领域的指南研究有实际参考价值。多方法、多阶段的评估设计也较为扎实。局限同样明显：所有评估均基于短时交互，与伴侣产品赖以成立的长期关系本质存在错位；第二阶段从业者仅具相邻领域经验；产品覆盖面窄，结论的泛化性受限；原则停留在张力识别层面，尚无法直接指导落地。后续若能结合纵向用户研究与伴侣专属风险指南开发，价值会更大。

papers.title: Addressing Cross-Stage Decoupling of Semantic and Collaborative Signals in Generative Recommendation
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation reformulates sequential recommendation as autoregressive generation by encoding items into semantic tokens, enabling improved scaling capability and cross-domain generalization. However, existing generative recommender systems typically follow a two-stage pipeline, where item tokenization is largely dominated by textual semantics with limited incorporation of collaborative signals and interaction similarity, leading to code assignments that are misaligned with downstream generation. Conversely, the generation stage tends to overlook the original semantic information, as the code sequences are re-embedded based on interaction data. This cross-stage information decoupling limits semantic coherence and recommendation accuracy. To address this issue, we propose SCRec, a general framework that enhances cross-stage coherence through bidirectional information supplementation. Specifically, we introduce (i) collaborative-enhanced tokenization to explicitly inject textualized collaborative signals into semantic tokenization, without introducing additional alignment task, (ii) semantic-guided generation to dynamically recalibrate semantic priors with learnable code embeddings in generation stage, and (iii) manifold alignment to reconcile the geometric mismatch between the embedding space of discrete codebook indices and the dense continuous semantic space. These interrelated components form a general framework that aligns semantic and collaborative signals and enhances cross-stage information coherence, with minimal additional training and inference costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness, robustness, and generalizability of our proposed framework.
papers.article_theme: SCRec：双向补全语义与协同信号的双阶段生成推荐框架
papers.research_question: 现有两阶段生成式推荐中，tokenization阶段主要由文本语义主导、难以注入协同信号，而生成阶段重新嵌入码序列又忽略原始语义信息，造成跨阶段信息解耦。如何在两阶段间双向补全并对齐语义与协同信号是难点。
papers.main_contribution: 提出SCRec框架，通过协同增强tokenization、语义引导生成和双曲流形对齐三个相互关联的模块，增强跨阶段信息一致性。框架以可复用模块形式实现，可低成本集成到多种生成式推荐器中。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸协同增强tokenization：先用CF模型（如预训练SASRec）找每个物品的top-k相似物品，将物品自身属性和相似物品标题组织成文本提示，用同一PLM（T5）编码后加权聚合，再经RQ-VAE量化，使交互相似的物品获得更相近的码序列，且无需额外对齐任务。
🔸语义引导生成：通过物品专属可学习权重（温度softmax稳定训练）将层级码嵌入聚合为物品级表示，再经门控机制与冻结的语义先验动态融合，并用InfoNCE损失做实例级对比对齐。
🔸流形对齐：将码嵌入与语义表示通过指数映射和可学习投影仪投影到共享Poincaré球，最小化测地距离，弥合离散码本索引与稠密语言模型隐状态之间的几何失配。
🔸理论上证明最小化流形对齐损失可收紧由码嵌入诱导的超额生成误差上界。
🔸整个流程离线提取嵌入，融合与对齐模块计算复杂度低（L_geo为O(Nd)，低于InfoNCE的O(N²d)）。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸在Amazon三个数据集（Beauty、Sports、Toys）上全面超越约20个基线，相对次优方法在四项指标上提升13%–27%。
🔸消融显示移除协同tokenization、语义引导、对比对齐或流形对齐均导致性能下降；流形对齐优于L2和MMD等欧氏对齐替代方案。
🔸对损失权重α、β和曲率c的超参扫描显示性能稳定。
🔸作为通用模块接入TIGER和LIGER均有提升，开销极小（TIGER训练/推理时间仅增6.70%/6.19%，LIGER增1.98%/0.54%）。
🔸门控权重可视化表明流形对齐使融合权重更均衡，防止模型过度依赖语义特征；局限在于实验限于Amazon评论数据且依赖离线预训练CF模型质量。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，本文的核心创新在于把跨阶段信息解耦问题拆解为注入、恢复与几何对齐三个互补环节，其中将协同信号文本化以借助同一PLM实现天然空间对齐，思路简洁且避免了拼接或隐式监督的失真问题；双曲流形对齐则借助Poincaré球的层级保留能力，理论分析与t-SNE、门控权重分布等实证互为印证。实用价值突出：模块化设计、开销极低且对骨干模型无侵入，工程落地友好。局限在于实验仅在三个中小规模Amazon数据集上验证，协同信号来源依赖预训练推荐模型的质量，冷启动物品缺少相似邻居时该机制的有效性尚未讨论，真实大规模工业场景的表现仍有待检验。

papers.title: P$^3$Rec: Distilling Prior--Posterior Preference Reasoning for LLM-based Recommendation
institutions: Chongqing University of Technology, Chongqing, China
papers.primary_institution: Chongqing University of Technology, Chongqing, China
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding and preference reasoning capabilities, offering new opportunities for user modeling in recommender systems. Existing LLM-as-Enhancer methods typically distill LLM-derived preference knowledge into lightweight recommenders to avoid costly online LLM inference. However, they often construct distillation knowledge from only one perspective. Prior preference captures users' stable and consistent interests but provides limited guidance for the current decision, whereas posterior preference reveals target-relevant fine-grained interests but may rely excessively on target clues. To address these limitations, we propose P$^3$Rec, a framework that jointly extracts and internalizes complementary prior and posterior preference reasoning knowledge. Specifically, P$^3$Rec first derives target-agnostic prior preferences and target-conditioned posterior preferences from the user side, while further extracting item-centric preference representations from item semantics and predecessor interactions. It then progressively internalizes prior and posterior knowledge into behavioral representations through prior preference absorption and posterior-guided preference distillation. Since the resulting comprehensive preference representation may not always provide an equally decisive retrieval direction, P$^3$Rec further characterizes historical interest dispersion with interest entropy and adaptively calibrates the user representation before contrastive retrieval optimization. In this way, P$^3$Rec achieves more complete preference reasoning while preserving efficient recommendation. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate its effectiveness.
papers.article_theme: 先验后验偏好联合蒸馏的LLM推荐框架
papers.research_question: 现有LLM-as-Enhancer推荐方法通常只从单一视角蒸馏偏好知识：先验偏好稳定但缺乏对当前决策的指导，后验偏好细粒度却可能依赖目标捷径。如何联合提取并内化互补的先验与后验偏好推理，使轻量推荐模型获得更完整的偏好能力？
papers.main_contribution: 提出P3Rec框架，从用户侧同时提取目标无关的先验偏好和目标条件化的后验偏好，并从物品语义与前驱交互中提取物品中心偏好；通过先验偏好吸收和后验引导蒸馏将两类知识逐步内化到行为表示中；进一步用兴趣熵刻画历史兴趣离散度，自适应校准用户表示后再做对比检索优化，在保持高效推理的同时实现更完整的偏好迁移。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸多视角偏好推理：先用目标无关prompt从交互历史总结稳定先验偏好，再以真实目标物品为oracle做目标条件化推理得到后验偏好，另据物品属性与前驱用户的交互和评论推断物品中心的用户偏好画像。
🔸先验偏好吸收：以行为编码器输出的行为表示为基础，用可学习的吸收系数α选择性地将先验偏好表示融入行为表示，得到内化用户表示q。
🔸后验引导蒸馏：一方面用MSE将后验表示作为教师直接蒸馏进q，另一方面由后验表示与行为/先验表示的余弦相似度经温度归一化生成教师吸收系数，用BCE损失监督可学习吸收系数，调节先验知识的吸收量。
🔸兴趣熵校准：基于物品中心语义表示构建兴趣图，以连通分量作为潜在兴趣簇计算兴趣熵并归一化，熵大者允许更强的可学习残差校准，缓解兴趣分散导致的检索方向模糊。
🔸两阶段优化：先联合优化蒸馏与吸收损失，再做InfoNCE对比检索优化；推理时无需后验偏好，仅用行为表示、先验偏好和兴趣熵校准完成高效检索。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸在Amazon Sports、Beauty、Toys三个数据集上，P3Rec在全部H@5/10和N@5/10指标上超过14个基线，相对最强基线R2END平均提升约7.65%—11.81%，且改进统计显著。
🔸消融显示移除行为表示退化最大，说明协同行为信息仍是基础；去掉先验比去掉后验退化更大，先验提供长期兴趣互补信息；吸收蒸馏损失与兴趣熵校准的移除也带来一致下降。
🔸效率方面，LLM推理离线完成，训练仅增加边际开销（Stage1每轮0.32—0.56秒），推理耗时与R2END相当。
🔸跨域迁移实验中P3Rec在全部六个迁移方向上优于R2END，Sports→Beauty的H@10提升15.85%，说明内化的偏好知识更具可迁移性。
🔸案例研究表明先验+后验联合使目标物品排名从348位（先验0.20）提升到39位（0.32），作者也指出框架依赖LLM生成知识的质量。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，本文的创新点在于将LLM偏好推理显式拆分为先验与后验两个互补视角并设计配套的内化与引导机制，而非简单堆叠知识来源，问题刻画清晰、机制设计环环相扣；兴趣熵校准也为'综合表示未必是好的检索方向'提供了有针对性的解法。实验覆盖主结果、消融、超参、迁移、效率和案例，较为充分。局限在于：方法依赖离线LLM生成偏好文本，生成质量和幻觉会直接影响蒸馏效果；后验偏好以训练集真实目标为oracle，训练与推理的输入分布存在差距，作者虽做了防泄漏处理但仍值得更深入讨论。总体上属于LLM蒸馏推荐方向扎实且实用的工作。

papers.title: Safety as a Constraint: Fine-Tuning a LLM Recommender to Explain Itself
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Traditional recommender systems are typically trained to predict what item users will interact with next, but not why. However, offering personalized evidence for why a user might like the predicted item is an important way to enhance the service and to raise the likelihood that the user will be genuinely interested in the recommendation. This service can be delivered by integrating a frontier-model call into the member-facing pipeline, but it will add extra cost and latency. In this paper, we train a recommender LLM to generate personalized explanations for its reccomendation, based on the user's watching history at a large video streaming service. We impose two requirements on the generated explanation: it must be faithful to the elements of the shows it links, and it must be strictly non-harmful to the user. To this end, we first train two LLM-judge reward models covering three specific criteria, and propose constrained GRPO to incorporate these different criteria. On a held-out real-world testing set, our fine-tuned model improves the all-three-criteria PASS rate rises from 0.649 to 0.956 under our own judges and from 0.677 to 0.931 under an independent judge, where as the frontier generator performs similar to the untuned recommender baseline. We conduct further experiments to show that the model's language and recommendation abilities remain unchanged. Based on these results, we conclude that an LLM-based recommender can be fine-tuned on other complex tasks without compromising its original recommendation performance, thus provide insights for further agentic user interface powered by a single model.
papers.article_theme: 用约束GRPO微调LLM推荐器生成忠实无害的自我解释
papers.research_question: 如何微调一个部署中的LLM推荐器，使其为推荐生成个性化解释，同时保证解释对节目元素忠实且对用户严格无害？难点在于无害标准与通用模型的安全对齐目标差异很大，且多准则优化不能牺牲原有推荐和语言能力。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出一个部署就绪的流水线：在开源8B骨干上微调两个LoRA LLM裁判，分别评估忠实性与两类无害性（偏见、冒犯），并引入约束GRPO，以忠实性为主目标、无害性为拉格朗日约束进行原始-对偶优化。微调后生成器的三准则全PASS率从0.649提升到0.956，且检索与通用语言能力无退化。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 用基于用户观看历史的参考式解释（"如果你喜欢某剧的某元素就看这个"），要求解释忠实（共享元素真实相关）且无害（无冒犯或对用户群体的刻板关联）。
🔸 两个裁判均基于独立开源8B模型（避免评估者与策略同源），先做带推理的SFT再用GRPO在线RL，推理-标签一致性达1.000，理由与人工标注更对齐。
🔸 无害性裁判通过召回优先的推理脚手架识别细粒度敏感表达，CATCH-A-FAIL达0.939，远超前沿模型裁判的0.778；忠实性裁判用FAIL@8测试时扩展将捕获率提升至91%以上。
🔸 约束GRPO公式为r(o)=Rfact−Σλc(1−Rc)，拉格朗日乘子随约束满足情况自适应升降，相比固定权重的标量化奖励不需预先锁定权衡。
🔸 生成器先用前沿模型产出、人工筛选的三准则全PASS样本（952条）做SFT热身，再做188步约束GRPO；逐样本联合无害约束（Constrained-joint）优于批级约束。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在保留测试集上，微调生成器三准则全PASS率由0.649升至0.956（自评裁判）、0.677升至0.931（独立前沿裁判），优于前沿生成器的0.652，最高提升30.4%。
🔸 独立裁判下同样趋势说明收益非奖励信号过拟合所致；训练效率上每个梯度步需1280次裁判解码，训练188步覆盖3000个提示对，在8×A100上进行。
🔸 消融比较四种奖励设计（标量化、Constrained-bias/harmful/joint），联合约束最优，因为它要求每个样本同时满足无偏见与无冒犯。
🔸 内部检索nMRR提升+0.0006至+0.0009，MMLU等五个语言基准不变或微升，说明无能力退化。
🔸 局限：仅覆盖单一参考式解释风格，且后训练无法提升模型对节目内容的内在知识，作者建议未来引入继续预训练。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，这篇论文的创新点在于把安全作为硬约束而非可加权项，用原始-对偶方法替代固定权重标量化，并针对业务特有的无害标准微调专属裁判，工程细节扎实，如反奖励攻击的四档奖励鞍点设计和两参考混淆的排查都很值得借鉴。实用价值明确：8B模型替代前沿模型调用可降低成本与延迟，且不损害检索能力。局限在于解释类型单一、只针对单参考场景，结论来自单一视频流媒体业务，跨领域推广与解释风格个性化仍需验证；裁判与生成器的评估闭环也可能残留未被发现的奖励利用方式。

papers.title: PCGNet: Unifying Shared and Specific Information for Fashion Matching Recommendations
institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Hong Kong
papers.primary_institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Hong Kong
papers.reason: 提供评测、数据或综述视角，便于校准实验设计并定位研究空白。
papers.abstract: In fashion domain, recommending complementary clothing items that match selected pieces is a crucial cross-selling technique that improves customer satisfaction. Nevertheless, fashion matching presents significant challenges, as recommendations must not only align with individual user fashion preferences but also ensure compatibility between garments. These challenges are twofold. First, existing models often assume an overly simplified decoupled relationship between product compatibility and personalized user preferences, overlooking the natural complexity between the two. Second, existing data-driven approaches are not optimized for real-world fashion data, which is typically sparse and characterized by noisy interactions. To address these challenges, we propose Personalized Compatibility Graph Network, a multi-objective graph learning framework that organically unifies the modeling of product compatibility and personal preferences. PCGNet uses contrastive mutual information maximization to extract and align shared and view-specific patterns, thereby capturing the complex interplay between compatibility and personal preferences. Moreover, we introduce a correlation-aware neighbor sampling and a learnable global graph augmentation, which enhance the model by incorporating self-supervised signals mined directly from the graph, ensuring more stable and informative representations. Finally, PCGNet generates recommendation scores through the joint optimization of BPR ranking loss and multi-view mutual information losses. Experimental validation on two benchmark datasets demonstrates that PCGNet significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods across all four evaluation metrics.
papers.article_theme: PCGNet用多视图图学习统一搭配兼容性与个性偏好建模
papers.research_question: 个性化时尚搭配推荐既要符合用户个人偏好，又要保证单品间的视觉与语义兼容性。现有方法将两者简单解耦或线性融合，难以刻画其复杂的交互关系，且真实数据稀疏、交互噪声大，容易传播误导信息。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出PCGNet，一个多目标异构图学习框架，通过互信息最大化统一建模产品兼容性与个人偏好的共享信息和视图特有信息。框架包含相关性感知的邻居采样、可学习的图增强生成器和注意力图融合模块，联合优化BPR排序损失与多视图互信息损失，在两个基准数据集上显著超越SOTA方法。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸构建双视图异构图：产品兼容性图基于有效穿搭中共现统计捕捉上下装内在匹配规则，个人偏好图通过用户-上装与用户-下装交互边刻画用户整体穿衣偏好，两图共享节点集但边语义分离。
🔸相关性感知邻居采样：利用目标节点与邻居的余弦相似度子矩阵选取高置信邻居，配合注意力聚合，滤除噪声节点，生成更可靠的精炼图。
🔸可学习图增强：借助MLP与Gumbel重参数化技巧为每条边生成个性化权重，构建增强图以捕捉视图特有信息并缓解交互稀疏问题。
🔸共享GCN编码器处理后，通过注意力图融合得到融合图，并用MLP计算用户-上装-下装三元组的匹配偏好得分。
🔸联合优化BPR损失、视图共享互信息损失与视图特有互信息损失，端到端训练，同时保留兼容性与偏好的共性模式和差异性模式。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸在Polyvore-U-519与IQON3000数据集上，PCGNet在AUC、HR@10、NDCG@10、MRR@10四项指标上全面超越MF-BPR、GP-BPR、CP-TransMatch等基线，AUC分别达0.9667与0.9725。
🔸消融显示移除视觉模态导致性能大幅下降，说明视觉信号在兼容性建模中占主导；文本作为补充信息仍有贡献；移除共享信息损失比移除特有信息损失影响更大。
🔸超参分析表明邻居数k对Polyvore-U-519较敏感（最优k=2），μ在两数据集上最优值分别为0.5与0.1。
🔸鲁棒性实验显示模型在冷启动场景下显著优于基线，且面对随机加边扰动时性能下降相对平缓。
🔸作者指出互信息模块作为无监督组件主要提供通用自监督信号，可能难以捕捉细粒度的任务特定偏好信号，需未来引入辅助监督任务。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文的分析来看，PCGNet的核心创新在于拒绝将兼容性与个人偏好视为互斥或线性可分的因素，而是用互信息最大化显式刻画二者的共享与分歧部分，这一视角比传统事后融合更符合时尚推荐的语义结构。相关性采样与可学习图增强针对稀疏噪声数据的设计也具有较强工程实用性，冷启动与噪声实验佐证了鲁棒性。但需注意，文中在Polyvore-U-519上的性能提升幅度相当大（AUC从0.9001升至0.9667），读者应关注其评测协议与数据划分的复现细节；此外框架模块较多，超参敏感性（如k、μ）可能增加部署调优成本，文本模态贡献有限的结论也提示多模态收益存在场景依赖性。

papers.title: Personalized and Trust-Aware Health Recommendation Policies for a Construction Workplace
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Construction workers face workplace risks such as fatigue, heat stress, and other physically demanding conditions that can negatively affect their health and safety. Although monitoring these risks is important, timely and personalized health interventions are also needed to help prevent negative impacts on workers' well-being and productivity. To this end, in this paper, we propose a model to capture the interactions between a trust-aware health recommender system and workers who differ in health and trust sensitivity. Specifically, in our proposed dynamic model, worker health evolves over time, worker trust is affected by both health and recommendation dynamics, and trust in turn affects compliance with future recommendations. Given this model, we characterize the recommender policy, including a health-based recommendation triggering threshold and the recommendation frequency. We do so using both model-based short-horizon control and model-free reinforcement learning. We then investigate how recommendation frequencies are adjusted for different workers to balance their health, productivity, and trust. Our findings provide insight into the design of personalized health recommendation policies in construction workplaces and beyond.
papers.article_theme: 建筑工人个性化健康推荐中的信任演化与策略优化
papers.research_question: 论文研究如何为建筑工地工人设计个性化的健康推荐策略，使推荐时机与频率在改善健康、维持生产力的同时，不损害工人对系统的信任。难点在于工人的健康与信任随时间耦合演化，信任又决定其是否遵从推荐，构成复杂的序贯决策问题。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出一个信任感知的MDP模型，将工人健康状态与信任状态联合建模，其中信任受推荐和健康结果影响，并反过来决定遵从概率。作者通过两步短视界的模型驱动解析策略（类似MPC）和基于DQN的无模型强化学习两种方式刻画最优推荐触发阈值与频率，并开发了PyTorch仿真框架比较两种策略。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 状态为二维向量(健康H_t, 信任T_t)，工人由健康敏感度δ_H和信任敏感度δ_T构成的二维类型刻画，推荐器通过触发阈值η_t和推荐频率f_t控制是否发出单一类型的健康建议。
🔸 健康动态假设遵从时恢复慢于不遵从时退化加速（κ1<1<κ2），信任则根据推荐与否及下一步健康损失是否超过δ_H，以步长δ_T上下更新，形成信任与健康的耦合演化。
🔸 目标函数为加权健康损失λΔH与遵从带来的生产力成本(1-λ)δ_P·c的折扣累积，短视界方法解析刻画最优阈值分区（由生产力和健康的相对权重ρ决定）。
🔸 RL方法用DQN近似动作价值函数，动作空间将连续的(η, f)离散化，训练1000个episode学习长时序策略，并开源PyTorch仿真器供不同用户类型和参数下实验。
🔸 数值分析表明：短视界策略在信任敏感工人上倾向不推荐以免损失生产力，而RL策略学会通过早期持续推荐逐步建立信任，长期改善健康。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 RL策略在大多数用户类型上累计奖励优于短视界策略，但短视界策略仍具竞争力，在大δ_H、大δ_T区域两者差距很小，有时短视界甚至更优。
🔸 动态轨迹分析（每个用户类型1000次蒙特卡洛平均）显示RL早期推荐可能短暂降低信任和健康，但长期通过信任积累实现持续健康改善，最终超越短视界策略。
🔸 短视界策略存在局限：对低敏感度用户完全不推荐会导致信任流失、健康恶化，之后才被动恢复推荐。
🔸 局限：模型假设单一推荐类型、健康与信任状态完全可观测，作者承认未来需扩展为POMDP并在实验室环境与真实建筑工人验证。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，本文的创新点在于将信任从静态假设改为内生演化的状态变量，并与健康动态耦合嵌入MDP，弥补了健康推荐系统研究中普遍忽视信任机制的不足；同时以解析短视界策略与DQN长时序策略对照，兼顾可解释性与长期优化，思路清晰且有仿真器开源支撑。不过其局限也较明显：健康与信任动态均为高度简化的线性阈值模型，参数（如κ、δ）缺乏真实工人数据校准，动作离散化也限制了策略精细度，且尚无真实场景验证，因此结论更多是建模层面的洞见，实际部署前还需大量实证工作。

papers.title: Preference-Drift-Aware Subsequence Learning and Hierarchical Context Fusion for Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
papers.reason: 关注生成式建模、语义标识或物品生成，适合跟踪端到端推荐新范式。
papers.abstract: Long-sequence generative recommendation methods autoregressively model the user's interaction sequence to generate the next-item representation. Existing methods generally fall into two categories: efficient full-sequence modeling and target-aware context retrieval. Our experiments reveal that as the sequence length increases, the former incurs steadily growing computational cost while its accuracy gains quickly saturate and even degrade due to noise; the latter, though shortening the input sequence, is susceptible to noise that is semantically consistent yet preference-inconsistent, as well as to incomplete contexts. Both paradigms ignore the dynamic changes of user preferences and the cross-subsequence dependencies when handling historical information, thereby limiting accuracy and efficiency. To address these issues, we propose a preference-drift-aware subsequence learning and hierarchical context fusion for long-sequence generative recommendation. Specifically, we learn differentiable soft subsequence boundaries using multidimensional preference-drift information and aggregate items within each subsequence into preference-coherent representations via linear attention with soft assignment weights, thereby circumventing the expense of full-sequence attention. A cross-attention mechanism is then employed to capture dependencies between recent interactions and relevant subsequence contexts, mitigating noise in learning recent-item representations. Finally, a gated fusion mechanism adaptively combines the recent-item representation with the global subsequence context, allowing the resulting target representation to encode both recent and long-term preferences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing baselines in both recommendation accuracy and computational efficiency.
papers.article_theme: 偏好漂移感知子序列学习与分层上下文融合推荐方法
papers.research_question: :长序列生成式推荐中，全序列建模计算成本随长度增长而精度增益饱和甚至退化，目标感知检索则易受语义相似但偏好不一致的噪声干扰且上下文不完整，如何兼顾精度与效率并建模用户偏好的阶段性演化是难点。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出DRIFT框架，利用语义、时间、类别等多维偏好漂移信号学习可微软边界，将长历史自适应划分为偏好一致的子序列，并以线性注意力聚合子序列表示。再通过交叉注意力与门控融合机制，将近期上下文与全局子序列上下文自适应结合，使目标表示同时编码短期与长期偏好，实现线性复杂度。该方法可作为通用模块叠加于HSTU、TIGER、GLASS等多种骨干。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 边界打分算子联合建模语义偏移、特征变化、交互间隔和类别分布漂移（JSD）四个维度，用MLP输出每个位置的软边界分数，刻画用户进入新偏好阶段的概率。
🔸 根据边界强度均值、方差和归一化历史长度等用户级统计量，自适应估计每个用户的子序列数量κu，并将边界分数累加为归一化软坐标。
🔸 通过带门控高斯核计算条目对各子序列的软归属度，并用Gumbel-Softmax锐化分配，随后以软权重线性注意力将条目聚合为偏好一致的子序列表示，避免跨子序列干扰。
🔸 编码器中近期条目通过交叉注意力选择性地关注偏好一致的子序列上下文；解码端用门控交叉注意力自适应融合近期上下文与全局子序列上下文。
🔸 训练损失包含任务损失与子序列结构约束（语义、时间、类别一致性），梯度可端到端传播至边界预测器，无需边界标注。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 准确性：在KuaiRec、ML-20M、Taobao MM三个数据集上，DRIFT变体在几乎所有指标上超越七个基线，KuaiRec上DRIFT-HSTU的NDCG@20与Recall@20较HSTU提升13.1%和21.6%，ML-20M上相对TIGER、GLASS最高提升74.3%和90.4%。
🔸 效率：DRIFT-GLASS支持比GLASS长约20倍的序列，在KuaiRec和Taobao MM上每轮训练分别快3.9倍和2.7倍；DRIFT-TIGER在Taobao MM上训练加速达80.4倍；DRIFT-HSTU训练时间减少37.6%–42.1%，显存降低39.6%–61.1%。
🔸 消融：均匀分割与K-means分割均劣于偏好漂移感知分割；直接拼接子序列表示（Subseq-Prefix、Concat-Fuse）在Taobao MM上性能灾难性崩溃，验证了门控融合对异构表示对齐的必要性。
🔸 敏感性：方法对序列长度、子序列数量K及结构约束权重均较鲁棒，两数据集均在20个子序列处达峰；移除任一辅助损失均导致性能下降。
🔸 局限：GLASS+DRIFT推理时间在Taobao MM上增加39.24%、显存增加86.64%，且在偏好漂移较弱的数据上增益相对温和。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，DRIFT的核心创新在于把用户偏好的阶段性演化显式建模为可微的子序列划分问题，用多维漂移信号驱动的软边界替代均匀分割或单相似度检索，这直击了长序列推荐中噪声与效率的两难。门控分层融合的设计也有扎实的消融支撑，说明异构上下文确需自适应对齐而非简单拼接。实用价值方面，其即插即用地叠加于HSTU、TIGER、GLASS三种骨干且显著加速训练，具备落地潜力。但需注意其代价并不均匀：GLASS+DRIFT在Taobao MM上推理延迟与显存明显上升，超参（K、多个损失权重）仍需搜索，且实验限于三个公开数据集，缺乏工业在线A/B验证，软边界的可解释性与极端长序列下的稳定性仍有待检验。

papers.title: MIMA: Multi-Interest Recommendation via Multi-Positive Exclusive Assignment
institutions: Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group, Beijing, China
Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group, Guangzhou, China
Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group, Hangzhou, China
papers.primary_institution: Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group, Beijing, China
papers.reason: 提供评测、数据或综述视角，便于校准实验设计并定位研究空白。
papers.abstract: Multi-interest recommendation represents each user with multiple interest vectors for fine-grained candidate matching, yet it often suffers from interest collapse, where the learned interests converge to similar representations. We highlight the prevailing single-positive paradigm as one important factor behind this issue. Since each instance provides only one positive item, intents are optimized independently, potentially causing the same best-matching interest to be repeatedly updated toward different positives while leaving the others under-supervised. Moreover, existing methods rarely model how strongly a user activates each interest, leaving scores from different interest channels incomparable at inference. To address these problems, we propose MIMA, a Multi-Interest recommendation framework built on Multi-positive exclusive Assignment. MIMA groups items co-occurring within the same request into a positive set, generates complementary interests with a causal Transformer decoder, and exclusively assigns each positive to supervise a distinct interest via Hungarian matching, so that interest differentiation emerges from the training objective itself rather than auxiliary regularization. A lightweight routing module further estimates user-interest activation probabilities to calibrate scores across interest channels. Experiments on three public datasets and an industrial dataset show that MIMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and an online A/B test yields significant business gains.
papers.article_theme: MIMA：以多正样本互斥分配缓解兴趣坍缩
papers.research_question: 多兴趣推荐普遍存在兴趣坍缩问题，现有方法多依赖辅助正则来促进兴趣差异化，效果间接；同时推理时不同兴趣通道的得分缺乏统一标定、不可直接比较。论文试图从监督范式本身入手，让兴趣分化由训练目标内生地产生。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出MIMA框架，首次将多正样本范式引入多兴趣推荐：将同一请求内共现物品组成正样本集合，用因果Transformer解码器生成互补兴趣，并通过匈牙利算法将各正样本互斥地一一分配给不同兴趣，使兴趣竞争直接写入训练目标。另引入轻量路由模块估计兴趣激活概率，标定跨兴趣通道的检索得分。在三个公开数据集、工业数据集及线上A/B测试中均取得一致提升。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 多正样本构建：以请求为分组单元，将同请求内点击的物品去重后组成容量为K的正样本集合，并以该请求之前的历史序列为输入，避免数据泄露；公开数据集用一天时间窗近似请求共现。
🔸 互补兴趣生成：K+1个可学习查询经因果自注意力+交叉注意力+FFN的解码器更新，后序兴趣查询只能关注先前兴趣状态，促使后序兴趣捕捉尚未覆盖的行为模式；兴趣向量由最终层交叉注意力权重对历史物品嵌入加权求和得到，保持与物品同空间。
🔸 互斥兴趣分配：将兴趣-正样本相似度矩阵上的线性分配问题用匈牙利算法精确求解，每个有效正样本恰好分配一个兴趣、每个兴趣至多监督一个正样本，分配在stop-gradient下进行，梯度经损失回传至被选中的兴趣与解码器，从训练目标本身缓解坍缩。
🔸 用户-兴趣路由：复用预留的路由查询状态作为用户兴趣全局摘要，经两层MLP加softmax估计兴趣激活分布π，检索得分取各通道π加权的最大值，服务端只需按缩放后兴趣向量做top-N内积检索再合并，无需改动现有召回管线。
🔸 联合优化：兴趣-物品采样softmax损失塑造兴趣与物品表示，路由采用L2归一化下的hinge损失（margin为0.02），两损失通过stop-gradient在参数空间解耦，训练与推理结构一致。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 公开数据集上MIMA全面领先，较次优基线提升3.04%–15.72%（p<0.01），且数据越稀疏提升越明显（最稀疏的Books上达9.38%–15.72%）。
🔸 消融显示去除多正样本互斥监督（w/o MP）性能下降最大，证明其为框架核心；去除路由或因果解码器也一致变差。
🔸 分配策略对比中，匈牙利精确分配整体最优，Greedy略逊（局部最优），Sinkhorn软分配最弱，因其梯度分散削弱互斥性。
🔸 工业数据集上HR@100/500/1000较最强基线提升7.98%/12.24%/13.03%，并提出IDM指标量化兴趣坍缩，MIMA的IDM最高；7天线上A/B测试交易笔数、金额分别相对提升5.60%、5.44%，独占曝光占比提升5.12个百分点。
🔸 超参分析表明兴趣数K存在最优值（Books/Beauty为8、Gowalla为4），过大后性能略降；两层解码器已足够，最优注意力头数随数据集而异。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，MIMA的核心创新在于把兴趣坍缩归因于单正样本监督范式，并用DETR式的匈牙利互斥匹配将兴趣分化内生于训练目标，这一视角转换比以往的外挂正则更具说服力，且t-SNE可视化与IDM指标为其提供了较完整的证据链。实用性方面，路由打分可分解为缩放兴趣向量的标准top-N检索，工程落地成本低，并已有A/B验证。局限在于：兴趣数与正样本容量绑定为K，正样本不足时依赖dummy填充；公开数据集用时间窗近似请求共现，可能引入噪声；匈牙利匹配带来的额外计算及因果解码器在超长序列上的开销文中讨论有限，跨平台泛化仍待更多验证。

papers.title: OneLA: Scaling Linear-Attention Decoding to Large Beams in Generative Recommendation
institutions: The University of Hong Kong, China
papers.primary_institution: The University of Hong Kong, China
papers.reason: 关注生成式建模、语义标识或物品生成，适合跟踪端到端推荐新范式。
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) relies on large-beam decoding to generate hundreds of candidate items, creating a new scaling challenge for recurrent linear attention. Existing linear attention serving systems either materialize a full recurrent state for every beam or repeatedly replay shared history, incurring substantial memory and traffic overhead. To address this, we present OneLA, a linear-attention decoding framework that exploits the shared prompt and short divergent suffixes of GR workloads. Specifically, OneLA represents all beam states using a single shared prompt-derived state and compact, append-only records of their divergent transitions. Using this representation, OneLA computes only the state information required at each decoding step, without reconstructing a full recurrent state for every beam. Furthermore, OneLA uses a lightweight ancestry index to track the transition records that make up each beam's history, allowing beams to be updated without moving or copying existing records. A fused GPU kernel further reuses the shared state across beams. Our analysis shows that OneLA achieves 1.54-2.46x end-to-end decode speedups while substantially reducing recurrent-state memory use and data movement.
papers.article_theme: OneLA：用共享状态和紧凑记录加速大束宽生成式推荐解码
papers.research_question: 生成式推荐（GR）依赖大束宽解码生成数百个候选物品，导致循环线性注意力（如GDN）需要为每个beam维护独立状态，存储与显存流量随束宽急剧膨胀。论文研究如何在不为每个beam物化完整循环状态的前提下，高效支持动态演化的超大beam解码。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出OneLA框架，用每个请求共享一份prefill后上下文状态S_ctx，加上紧凑的、只追加的GDN转移记录（GTR）表示各beam状态，并通过投影重放直接计算每步所需的两个状态投影，从不重建完整循环矩阵；配合轻量祖先索引与融合共享上下文GPU核实现跨beam复用与片上重放。相比现有GDN执行路径，端到端解码加速1.54–2.46倍。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 洞察：同一请求内所有beam共享相同的prompt推导状态，仅在短解码后缀上分叉，且GDN每步转移可由紧凑元组表示，因此完整per-beam状态物化是冗余的。
🔸 GTR记录：每步转移存为(α_t, δ_t, k_t)，仅O(d_v+d_k)存储，δ_t的设计使重放时只需一次点积贡献，无需重建父状态。
🔸 投影重放：GDN只通过键投影S k和查询投影S q与历史状态交互，OneLA沿祖先GTR链递归维护两个d_v维累加器，直接得到所需投影，计算量从矩阵级降为向量级。
🔸 祖先索引：beam剪枝、重排、复制只更新轻量索引引用，GTR物理槽位不可变、只追加，从而解耦逻辑beam演化与物理存储。
🔸 融合GPU核：线程块一次性加载S_ctx瓦片供多个beam复用，将共享投影、祖先感知重放与当前GDN更新融合于片上完成，仅追加紧凑GTR而非回写完整状态。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在0.8B Qwen3.5模型（6全注意力+18 GDN层，R=4、W=256、prompt 1K/5K）上，OneLA相对vLLM两条路径实现1.54–2.46倍端到端累计解码加速。
🔸 算子级评估覆盖405种形状：对vLLM/SGLang FullState中位加速40.5×/42.5×，对ReplaySSM路径17.5×，对FlashInfer与TensorRT-LLM为41.5×/46.3×；相对FullState中位持久状态容量最多降低42.5×。
🔸 状态路径分解（R=4、W=512）：O=3时DRAM流量仅161 MiB，相对FullState/ReplaySSM降低76.9×/39.9×，算术强度达40.0 FLOP/byte；最大输出误差4.88×10⁻⁴，数值精度得到确认。
🔸 局限：重放深度受限于SID序列长度（评估中O为3–7），收益依赖GR“长prompt、短后缀、大束宽”的负载特性；其他框架缺乏端到端GDN beam search支持，可比基线有限。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，我认为OneLA的创新点在于精准识别了生成式推荐中大束宽解码为循环线性注意力引入的新扩展维度，并利用GR负载“共享prompt+短分叉后缀”的结构性冗余，将状态管理从per-beam物化转向共享状态加紧凑记录的表示，属于系统层面而非模型层面的贡献。投影重放将矩阵运算降为向量运算、配合不可变记录与祖先索引的解耦设计，思路清晰且工程价值突出，对快手类工业GR场景有直接落地意义。局限方面：收益与SID序列短这一特性强耦合，若生成长度增大，重放成本会线性上升；评估仅在GDN一种线性注意力与有限的模型规模上进行，方法对其他循环状态架构的普适性尚需更多验证，数值误差虽小但长期累积影响也值得进一步分析。

papers.title: Exact Community Recovery in Bipartite Networks
papers.reason: 与推荐系统研究直接相关，适合快速浏览其问题设定和实验结论。
papers.abstract: Community detection in bipartite networks is a fundamental problem in modern data analysis, with applications in recommendation systems, biological networks, and social network analysis. Unlike conventional unipartite graphs, bipartite networks consist of two distinct types of nodes with edges only connecting across types, so recovering latent communities requires estimating labels on the two node types. The stochastic co-blockmodel is a classical probabilistic framework for such networks, yet theoretical guarantees for exact community recovery in this setting remain limited, especially when the number of communities grows, the community sizes are unbalanced, or the degrees are heterogeneous. In this work, we prove that a simple spectral clustering algorithm based on the diagonal-deleted Gram matrix achieves exact recovery with high probability under mild conditions on sparsity, community balance, and the number of clusters. We further extend the result to the degree-corrected stochastic co-blockmodel, where each node carries its own degree heterogeneity parameter, and show that a row-normalized version of the same algorithm maintains the exact recovery guarantee. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical findings.
papers.article_theme: 基于删除对角Gram矩阵的谱聚类实现二部网络精确社区恢复
papers.research_question: 在随机共块模型（ScBM）及其度校正版本（DCScBM）下，是否存在简单谱算法能以高概率实现零误分的精确社区恢复？已有结果未覆盖社区数随规模增长、社区不平衡以及度异质等一般情形。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出两个谱算法：SCDD（构造删除对角的Gram矩阵并取前K个特征向量做k-means）和其行归一化版本NSCDD，分别在ScBM和DCScBM下证明精确恢复保证。理论条件允许社区数随网络规模增长、社区规模不平衡，并以显式条件刻画稀疏度、平衡度与参数之间的权衡，实验验证了理论。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸核心观察：ScBM中期望邻接矩阵Ω=ρYBZ⊤的奇异向量在社区内为常数，社区质心距离为√(1/n_k+1/n_l)，为最近质心分类提供分离裕度。
🔸SCDD算法：计算Gy=P_off-diag(AA⊤)，删除对角以去除噪声方差引起的偏差，取前K_y个特征向量后对行做k-means；当K_y=K_z时可对称地恢复列社区。
🔸DCScBM中奇异向量因度参数不再社区内恒定，但对每行归一化后U*=YQ恢复常数结构，质心距离恰为√2，由此在SCDD基础上加行归一化得到NSCDD。
🔸理论证明基于Cai等人的子空间扰动理论，验证不相干参数、信号强度等条件，得到‖ÛO−U‖_{2,∞}=o(δ_min)从而k-means零误分，成功概率至少1−O(N^{-10})。
🔸当度参数全相等时，Theorem 2严格退化为Theorem 1；平衡情形下九个条件化简为两条关于K、n与稀疏度的不等式。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸四组模拟实验（改变K、ρ、n、不平衡参数β）中，SCDD与NSCDD同DI-SIM、D-SCORE、BiSC/nBiSC等基线均呈现与理论条件(19)(20)相符的相变：如ScBM中ρ≥0.20全部精确恢复，DCScBM因有效信号θmin=ρ/9而阈值推迟到0.35。
🔸度异质性削弱有效信号，使DCScBM实验中恢复阈值系统性地向更大K、更大ρ、更大n和更大β偏移，与理论预测一致。
🔸理论上当前条件不覆盖ρ≍log N/n的对数稀疏区间，但覆盖ρ≍log^{1+ε}N/n的多项式对数稀疏区间（需K=o(log^{ε/2}N)）。
🔸九个条件中有三个是冗余的（被更强条件蕴含），作者保留以对应证明中各误差项、便于阅读。
🔸局限包括未处理加权/多层二部网络、未解决基于Laplacian的方法能否精确恢复、直接用双邻接矩阵奇异向量恢复等问题，作者列为未来方向。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，这篇文章的理论贡献清晰：将谱聚类的精确恢复保证从单一网络推广到二部网络的一般ScBM/DCScBM设定，允许社区数增长与社区不平衡，且算法实现极为简单（删对角Gram矩阵+谱分解+k-means，必要时行归一化），实用门槛低，对推荐系统中的用户—物品二部结构分析有潜在参考价值。创新性主要体现在对既有扰动工具的细致条件验证而非全新方法。局限在于：理论不覆盖对数稀疏区间，实验仅在平衡设置和特定B下进行，缺乏真实数据验证；条件中含较多技术性参数，实际可核查性有限。整体是一项扎实但偏增量的谱聚类理论研究。

papers.title: Recommendation Retrievers Need Verifiers: Universal Generative Reranking for Sequential Recommendations
papers.reason: 聚焦用户行为序列与下一步偏好建模，和序列推荐主线直接相关。
papers.abstract: First-stage recommenders in multi-stage systems produce a ranked candidate list from which a limited prefix is forwarded to downstream rankers. Because each forwarded item must be processed by more expensive ranking stages, this shortlist cannot be arbitrarily large. The first-stage objective is therefore high coverage of relevant items within the forwarded prefix, commonly measured by Recall@$k$. A relevant item may be available deeper in the retrieved list but absent from the shorter prefix that is actually consumed. This paper studies post-hoc verification for promoting such candidates into the consumed shortlist without retraining or replacing the retriever. We introduce a lightweight generative verifier for retrieval models. Given a retriever state and a candidate item, the verifier scores the item through the likelihood of its identifier tokens. It is trained post hoc with next-token cross entropy, requires no sampled negatives or candidate pool during training, and scores only the retriever's top-$K$ candidates at inference. The interface is minimal: the retriever supplies a query state and candidate items, and the item representation can use any fixed tokenization. Across Amazon product recommendation and YaMBDa music recommendation, the same verifier training recipe improves Recall@10 for SASRec, GRU4Rec, NextItNet, and MiniOneRec. Ablations show that the improvements are not explained solely by injecting item-content features into the retriever, supporting verification as a post-hoc output-side adaptation mechanism.
papers.article_theme: 冻结检索器后接轻量生成式验证器提升候选池召回
papers.research_question: 多阶段推荐系统中，第一阶段检索器的相关物品可能排在转发给下游的前缀之外，如何在重训检索器的前提下把相关候选提升进有限前缀？难点在于验证器必须足够轻量，不能变成又一个昂贵的排序阶段。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出一种后挂的轻量生成式验证器：冻结的检索器（drafter）给出top-K候选池，验证器以检索器状态为条件，通过候选物品标识符token的自回归似然打分，再用加权倒数排名融合（RRF）合并两个排名并回填。该方法无需重训检索器、重建索引或采样负例，同一套训练方案在注意力、循环、卷积及LLM语义ID检索器上均有效。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 训练时冻结drafter，经stop-gradient投影获得条件向量c_t，验证器（小型因果Transformer）对每个非padding前缀位置做下一个物品token的teacher-forcing交叉熵，获得O(BT)级稠密监督，不需要负采样或候选池，避免对比学习的batch敏感性。
🔸 推理时drafter生成top-K池，验证器对每个候选用8个token的自回归解码计算对数似然s2，与drafter得分s1按加权RRF（κ=60，权重w验证集选择）融合，剩余物品按s1顺序回填。
🔸 物品标识采用双通道：四层残差量化语义ID（每层256项）加四头乘法哈希ID（每头1024桶），语义ID提供内容感知描述，哈希ID在大目录下消除语义码碰撞，作为条件记忆残差。
🔸 接口通用：只需drafter提供query状态和候选池，物品可用任意固定tokenization，因此适用于异构检索器并保持广泛召回目标不被破坏。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 Amazon Reviews上验证器提升所有drafter：Recall@10相对提升SASRec +6.2%/+9.9%、GRU4Rec +8.1%/+10.8%、NextItNet +8.4%/+14.5%（Industrial/Office），越强的drafter提升越小，MiniOneRec仅+2.6%/+4.6%。
🔸 YaMBDa音频基准上收益随目录规模增长：5B规模三drafter的Recall@10提升均达+25–30%，体现目录稀释机制；对用户从未听过的新物品仍有+12.7–14.7%的R@10提升，说明并非重复消费伪影。
🔸 通道消融显示大目录下哈希通道贡献主要提升，小目录（数千物品）下语义ID通道占优；融合权重w在0.5–2附近存在宽平台区，对超参不敏感。
🔸 内容对照实验表明给drafter注入相同内容表示并不复现提升（+C甚至单独更差），而验证器仍能大幅拉升，证明收益来自输出侧生成式验证而非特征注入。
🔸 局限包括：RRF需要验证集选择权重w，MiniOneRec在Office域出现个别指标轻微下降，且方法本质上是候选池内重排而非替代下游排序。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文分析，这篇论文的核心创新在于把语言模型的draft-and-verify思想移植到推荐检索：验证器不追求复制drafter分布，而是通过标识符似然做输出侧适配，这一区分使方法与常规特征重排器有本质差异。实用价值明显：冻结检索器、无需负采样与索引重建、跨架构通用，对工业多阶段系统是低成本的增量改造。实证设计也较扎实，目录稀释机制与通道消融相互印证。局限在于验证器作用范围限于bounded候选池，强drafter下收益有限；内容对照虽排除了简单注入解释，但哈希通道主导提升暗示一部分收益可能来自对流行或重复物品的记忆，其在真实业务中的泛化与线上延迟代价仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: UniRec: Cross-stage Multi-Task Fusion with Preference Alignment for Cascaded Recommender Systems
papers.reason: 强调规模、效率或线上部署，对工程落地和系统设计更有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Industrial recommender systems use cascaded stages with different objectives, feature spaces, and latency constraints. Optimizing pre-ranking and ranking separately can create cross-stage inconsistency: upstream models may filter out items preferred by downstream rankers, and independently tuned downstream fusion can offset upstream improvements. Existing multi-task fusion methods focus on multi-objective fusion within the ranking stage, and cross-stage methods typically only add a downstream score factor to upstream ranking. Joint optimization of fusion modules across both stages remains largely unexplored. We propose UniRec, a Unified Cross-stage Recommendation Fusion model. First, the two fusion agents partially share input embeddings and are trained in a single computation graph, so gradients from either stage propagate through the shared representation and influence the other. Second, we introduce a dual-axis preference alignment objective: a vertical cross-stage consistency term transfers downstream pairwise preferences to the upstream fusion score, and a horizontal compact aggregation term reorganizes dozens of pairwise objectives over heterogeneous prior signals into bidirectional preference evidence. Third, we find that unconstrained end-to-end fusion optimization can exploit imbalances in item attribute distributions, over-concentrating on high-reward regions at the cost of other objectives. We therefore add an attribute group-relative regularization that computes advantages within attribute groups and normalizes the policy over the same groups, so uniformly promoting an entire high-reward group yields no optimization gain. Offline, UniRec consistently outperforms single-stage fusion and cross-stage coordination baselines. Online A/B tests show a 0.616\% gain in app usage duration. UniRec is fully deployed on the Kuaishou platform.
papers.article_theme: UniRec：统一粗排与排期的跨阶段融合偏好对齐框架
papers.research_question: 级联推荐系统中粗排与精排各自独立优化融合模块，导致跨阶段偏好不一致：上游可能滤掉下游偏好的物品，下游融合又会抵消上游改进。论文试图将两阶段的融合模块作为一个可微问题联合优化，但面临数十个异构目标的成对损失代价高、端到端优化会利用属性相关奖励偏置两大难点。
papers.main_contribution: 提出UniRec，首个在工业级联推荐中把粗排与精排融合模块作为单一可微模块联合优化的框架。其核心包括部分共享嵌入的耦合双Agent架构、双轴偏好对齐目标（纵向跨阶段一致性、横向紧凑聚合CPPA），以及防止属性奖励偏置的属性组相对正则AGRR。该框架已在快手生产环境全量部署。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 耦合双Agent架构：两阶段融合Agent共享用户/物品/上下文及粗排预测的嵌入层，单一计算图使梯度对称地跨阶段传播；精排侧额外用adapter（带stop-gradient）将粗排表示作为显式特征注入。
🔸 纵向跨阶段对齐：以精排融合分数的成对序作为detached标签，通过Softplus成对损失约束粗排分数，只对齐序而不回归分数，规避两阶段校准与尺度差异。
🔸 横向紧凑成对聚合（CPPA）：观察到同一对物品的所有目标Softplus共享同一参数±δ，按符号分组求和正负偏好证据，将可微项从O(MN²)降为O(N²)，且与原目标代数等价。
🔸 属性组相对正则（AGRR）：借鉴GRPO思想，按视频时长分桶，在桶内计算基于偏好证据的奖励与归一化优势，构造桶内KL目标，使整体抬高高奖励属性桶不再带来优化增益，但保留跨桶排序能力。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 RecFlow离线结果：UniRec在全部6个NDCG截断点最优，ASH达0.9978，Kendall's τ为0.6318、Spearman's ρ为0.8072，均超Weighted-Sum、EMER、UMRE、COPR等基线；rank_AUC略低于UMRE但NDCG更高。
🔸 消融显示：去掉后验奖励损失影响最大；AGRR主要改善一致性（去除后ASH下降0.0215）；对齐损失去除使ASH下降0.0139但不影响精排指标，符合其detached teacher设计。
🔸 效率上CPPA使训练吞吐提升30.1%、单样本处理时间减少23.1%；超参敏感性实验表明三个损失权重在较宽范围内稳定。
🔸 一周线上A/B（20%流量）：总观看时长+0.675%、视频观看时长+0.755%、App使用时长+0.616%、Like+2.367%等，无报告指标下降。
🔸 局限与展望：目前仅覆盖粗排与精排，尚未扩展到重排；AGRR以时长为属性、其他偏置属性留待未来；训练期耦合依赖共享嵌入，服务时需复制嵌入表。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，这篇论文的创新点在于把工业界普遍忽视的融合模块而非打分模型作为跨阶段联合优化对象，CPPA的代数等价重组既降本又保留偏好信息，AGRR用桶内归一化优雅地消除了整体抬高高奖励属性区的退化方向，设计有理有据。方法与骨干解耦、训练期耦合不影响服务延迟，实用价值和落地可信度高，A/B结果全面正向也印证了这一点。可能的局限在于：实验中粗排对齐等结论依赖具体场景的属性（时长）选择；跨阶段对齐的收益在消融中主要体现于一致性指标而非精排排序质量；论文也未报告框架扩展到更多阶段或不同业务（电商、广告）时的适配成本，未来工作的普适性仍待验证。

papers.title: Auto-RecSys: Harnessing Autonomous Research Agents for Industry-Scale Recommender System
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Auto-research agents have shown the potential to automate hypothesis generation, experiment execution, and iterative refinement. However, scaling this paradigm to industry-scale recommendation models introduces two challenges: (1) long feedback loops, where model training can take days, making serial iteration prohibitively slow and requiring parallel exploration across multiple research directions; and (2) system complexity, where large configurations, fragile infrastructure dependencies, and multi-day GPU jobs require robust and recoverable execution. We present Auto-RecSys, an autonomous research system for long-horizon experimentation on industry-scale recommendation models. Auto-RecSys addresses these challenges through three harness designs: (1) distributed asynchronous execution for running multiple experiments in parallel across servers, (2) centralized cross-server memory for persistent and recoverable execution across sessions and failures, and (3) cognitive-procedural separation, where natural-language skill files guide LLM reasoning while deterministic scripts enforce operational correctness. Auto-RecSys further employs a dual-loop self-evolving architecture: an Execution Evolution Loop in which model-specific playbooks accumulate operational knowledge by recording failed attempts and crystallizing successful pipelines, and an Idea Evolution Loop in which experimental outcomes inform subsequent ideation. Evaluated on recommendation models, Auto-RecSys significantly reduces the human time required per experiment cycle and improves execution reliability as its playbooks mature.
papers.article_theme: 用自主研究Agent加速工业级推荐模型实验
papers.research_question: 如何将自主科研Agent范式扩展到训练动辄数天、配置和基础设施复杂的工业级推荐模型上？难点在于长反馈回路要求多方向并行探索，且系统复杂性要求跨会话、跨服务器的可恢复执行与知识积累。
papers.main_contribution: 提出Auto-RecSys，一个面向长周期实验的自主研究系统。它通过分布式异步执行、集中式跨服务器记忆和认知-程序分离三大harness设计保障可靠执行，并采用双环自进化架构：执行进化环将实验轨迹蒸馏为模型专属playbook，想法进化环用实验结果指导后续创意生成。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 认知-程序分离：自然语言技能文件指导LLM推理与诊断，确定性脚本负责状态转移、API调用与校验，兼顾灵活性与操作精确性。
🔸 分层知识架构：模型无关的编排技能+每模型playbook+每实验状态文件三层结构，支持新模型快速接入与一次性模板迁移（one-shot transfer）。
🔸 有限状态机管理每个实验想法的生命周期（ideating到analyzing），状态按想法隔离，支持多想法并行、跨服务器接续与故障恢复。
🔸 Playbook记录关键文件、验证命令、提交配置、死路（dead ends）与成熟策略，错误连同修复方案一起记录，实现自愈式执行。
🔸 想法来源多样（研究者提案、文献挖掘、自主头脑风暴），结合实验历史去重、组合部分成功并排序，形成分布式实验组合以维持研究吞吐。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在人机协同模式下，单想法的人工投入从数小时至数天降到分钟级，同样注意力可覆盖十余个并行想法。
🔸 基于同一模型31次迭代的轨迹分析：稳定期主要修复步从4.0降至1.3，基线切换后短暂回退，过渡后阶段降至0.5且6次迭代中5次零修复。
🔸 观察到多种自进化机制：死路规避、提交配置结晶、验证跳过模式、自主诊断并升级监控基础设施、涌现式元模式识别。
🔸 展示跨服务器上下文恢复、单会话970条日志（110次工具调用）零人工干预、以及自适应修改执行工作流等鲁棒性行为。
🔸 局限：playbook更新缺乏形式化验证门控、交互/自主模式切换二元、每模型知识独立、长训练时间仍未缩短，未来拟引入代理模型筛选。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，本文的核心创新不在于提出新的推荐模型技术，而在于系统层面的harness工程：将并行执行、持久化状态与自然语言程序性记忆耦合到多天、多服务器的真实工业实验中，这是对现有自动科研系统（多限于小规模快速迭代）的有意义拓展。双环自进化和一次性模板迁移设计实用性强，31次迭代的消融式分析也为playbook有效性提供了较可信证据。但需注意，评估仅基于单一代表性模型且基线切换场景特殊，缺乏端到端指标提升的量化对比，主要收益集中在人力节省而非模型效果；playbook依赖LLM自主判断更新、无验证门控，在更复杂场景下的可靠性仍待验证。

papers.title: On the Regularization Landscape for the Linear Recommendation Models
papers.reason: 提供评测、数据或综述视角，便于校准实验设计并定位研究空白。
papers.abstract: Recently, a wide range of recommendation algorithms inspired by deep learning techniques have emerged as the performance leaders on several standard recommendation benchmarks. While these algorithms were built on different DL techniques (e.g., dropouts, autoencoder), they have similar performance and even similar cost functions. This paper studies whether the models' comparable performance are sheer coincidence, or they can be unified under a single framework. We find that all linear performance leaders effectively add only a nuclear-norm based regularizer, or a Frobenius-norm based regularizer. The former ones possess a (surprising) rigid structure that limits the models' predictive power but their solutions are low rank and have closed form. The latter ones are more expressive and more efficient for recommendation but their solutions are either full-rank or require executing hard-to-tune numeric procedures such as ADMM. Along this line of finding, we further propose two low-rank, closed-form solutions, derived from carefully generalizing Frobenius-norm based regularizers. The new solutions get the best of both nuclear-norm and Frobenius-norm world.
papers.article_theme: 统一解析线性推荐模型的正则化理论景观
papers.research_question: 近年众多基于深度学习技术的线性推荐模型性能相近，其背后的根本驱动力是什么？论文试图证明这些模型能否统一到单一正则化框架下，并解决低秩Frobenius范数正则化缺乏闭式解的难题。
papers.main_contribution: 论文证明线性推荐性能领先模型本质上只使用了核范数类或Frobenius范数类正则化：前者解结构僵化（保留奇异向量、仅收缩奇异值），限制了预测能力；后者更具表达力但解为满秩或需依赖难调的ADMM。在此基础上，作者提出LR-EDLAE-1与LR-EDLAE-2两个低秩闭式解，兼得核范数的低秩闭式性与Frobenius范数的强预测力。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 将RegPCA、MF-dropout、DLAE、LVAE等模型统一证明为等效于加权核范数或其幂次正则化，其中LVAE的ELBO优化等效于带特定组合结构权重的加权核范数问题，且权重顺序会被自动排序。
🔸 证明所有∥W∥*^p（p≥1）正则化的最优解结构相同：均匀收缩奇异值；仅p=1时收缩量μ与数据无关、p=2时λ具尺度不变性，解释了文献中只用p=1,2的现象。
🔸 提出命题2把不可微的加权核范数目标编译为等效可微的因子化目标，并给出闭式解：保留X的奇异向量、按权重收缩奇异值，揭示该类正则化的搜索空间僵化。
🔸 针对低秩EDLAE提出两种近似闭式解：先求满秩闭式解再分别通过加权投影（LR-EDLAE-1）或SVD截断（LR-EDLAE-2）得到低秩估计，并放松零对角约束。
🔸 命题1表明核范数正则化效果可被Tikhonov型Frobenius正则化覆盖，从而可专注设计Frobenius类正则器。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在ML-20M、Netflix、MSD三个数据集上，LR-DLAE、LR-EDLAE-1/2与ADMM低秩解及满秩DLAE/EDLAE性能相当，Netflix上Recall@50达0.449，与满秩EDLAE持平。
🔸 随秩k增大精度普遍提升并在不同数据集各自饱和；k较小时ADMM略优，k较大时闭式解相当或略好。
🔸 核范数类方法整体弱于Frobenius类，如MSD上LVAE的nDCG@100仅0.286，远低于EDLAE的0.392；权重排序实验显示非降序排序约束显著恶化MF性能，印证其内在限制。
🔸 零对角约束带来收益：LR-DLAE在三个数据集中两个上劣于EDLAE类方法。
🔸 局限包括低秩解放松了零对角约束、闭式解仅是EDLAE低秩问题的近似，且实验限于隐式反馈线性模型。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，这篇论文的理论贡献相当扎实：它将看似多样的线性推荐模型统一到两类正则化之下，并刻画了解的刚性结构，属于少见的'解释性统一'工作。提出的低秩闭式估计器兼顾可扩展性与精度，避免了ADMM的调参负担，工程实用价值明确。不过其创新更多是分析整合与新解的推导，而非全新模型；实验虽有三个数据集，但未涉及非线性深度模型和更现代的序列推荐场景，且低秩解对零对角约束的放松在理论上仍是近似，实际部署中的稀疏性与可解释性影响还需进一步验证。

papers.title: FedHUR: Learning Hierarchical Utility-Guided Client Relations for Personalized Federated Recommendation
papers.reason: 聚焦分布式协同、隐私保护与安全聚合，适合跟踪合规场景下的推荐方法。
papers.abstract: Federated recommendation enables collaborative model training while keeping user interaction data on local clients. A central problem in federated recommendation is how to aggregate useful information across clients for personalized recommendation. Existing personalized aggregation methods usually construct client relations from predefined parameter-based assumptions, such as parameter similarity or complementarity, and use these relations to determine aggregation weights. However, such methods construct a single global relation, which is insufficient to capture the hierarchical and multi-granularity nature of user relations in recommendation. Moreover, these predefined relations cannot directly reflect whether the related clients can improve prediction performance after aggregation. To address these limitations, we propose FedHUR, a federated recommendation framework for learning hierarchical utility-guided client relations. FedHUR takes item-item filters as the object for relation construction and aggregation. Specifically, it first aggregates and clusters each client's local information to obtain global hierarchical information. Each client computes hierarchical utility signals based on its local information and the global hierarchical information, indicating which collaborative information is useful for improving its prediction. The server uses these utility signals to retrieve clients that are useful to that client for further personalized aggregation. Extensive experiments on five real-world datasets show that FedHUR consistently outperforms existing federated recommendation baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical utility-guided client relation learning. Code is available at https://github.com/Mingzhe-Han/FedHUR.
papers.article_theme: 分层效用引导的客户端关系学习用于联邦推荐
papers.research_question: 联邦推荐中现有个性化聚合依赖预定义的参数相似性或互补性构建单一全局客户端关系，既无法刻画推荐中用户关系的层级多粒度特性，也无法直接反映聚合后能否真正提升预测性能。难点在于层级关系空间难以在稀疏噪声的物品信息上定义，且可靠的聚合效用计算代价高昂。
papers.main_contribution: 论文提出FedHUR框架，以物品-物品过滤器为聚合对象，通过分层关系挖掘模块和效用引导客户端检索模块学习层级效用引导的客户端关系。核心机制是基于图信号处理从局部过滤器与全局过滤器导出效用查询作为检索信号，无需反复聚合验证即可估计候选客户端的聚合效用。五个真实数据集实验表明FedHUR持续优于现有联邦推荐基线。
papers.key_ideas:
🔸 服务端用k-means对全局物品嵌入由粗到细分层聚类，客户端在各层级计算组嵌入内积得到关系过滤器，细层过滤器继承父层关系值，兼顾全局共性信息与组内细节。
🔸 每个客户端基于局部过滤器H与全局过滤器F_g构造效用查询U=H−½(HF_g+F_gH)，理论证明该对称形式对应局部重构目标在全局过滤器处的负梯度对称部分，指示客户端所需的协同信息方向。
🔸 效用查询经共享随机投影矩阵压缩后上传，服务端将候选客户端表示投影到查询方向上计算检索分数，把昂贵的聚合后验证转化为高效的查询式检索。
🔸 轻量共享MLP打分器利用方向匹配强度、候选表示归一化规模和总分三类特征细化检索分数，与直接分数结合后经softmax归一化为聚合权重。
🔸 服务端按权重聚合各层级候选残差过滤器并映射回完整物品过滤器空间，叠加全局基础过滤器得到个性化过滤器，客户端据此微调物品嵌入，用户参数始终留在本地。
papers.analysis_summary:
🔸 在ML-100K、ML-1M、Book、BX、Beauty五个数据集上，FedHUR在Recall@10、MRR@10、NDCG@10上均取得最佳或可比结果，如ML-100K Recall@10达0.1973。
🔸 固定骨干与聚合对象的关系分析显示，效用关系优于相似性、互补性及其组合，且各关系的层级版本普遍优于单一全局版本，验证两个设计维度均有效。
🔸 相关性分析表明效用分数与聚合后验证/测试性能持续正相关，而相似性分数相关性不稳定且多为负值；消融验证对称效用查询形式和打分器全特征组合最优。
🔸 效率方面，FedHUR通信量约比FedCIA高27%，总训练时间700.05秒仅高约14.8%，远低于两倍上限，且可沿用SVD低秩压缩。
🔸 层级数敏感实验显示三层最优，过深的层级引入噪声冗余关系；投影维度适中即可，方法依赖图过滤器范式且隐私保护沿用现有联邦推荐假设。
papers.personal_view: 基于全文来看，FedHUR的创新点在于同时回应了客户端关系的粒度与效用两个被既有工作忽视的维度：用图过滤视角把效用估计转化为可证明合理、计算高效的查询式检索，是较为优雅的理论贡献，层级过滤器的继承式设计也缓解了稀疏物品空间下关系估计不可靠的问题。实用性方面，其额外通信与计算开销有限，且随机投影与可选的粗层参数聚合加速体现了工程考量。局限在于方法绑定于item-item过滤器这一聚合载体，对非嵌入式或更复杂模型的适配性未验证；效用查询假设对称过滤器且依赖局部重构目标，效用估计仍是代理信号而非真实聚合后验证；在更大规模客户端数与更重尾的数据分布下的可扩展性有待检验。

papers.title: An Efficient and Effective Agentic Group Shilling Attack on Recommender Systems
institutions: 1Griffith University, Australia 2Edith Cowan University, Australia 3The University of Queensland, Australia 4Faculty of Information Technology, HUTECH University, Vietnam
papers.primary_institution: 1Griffith University, Australia 2Edith Cowan University, Australia 3The University of Queensland, Australia 4Faculty of Information Technology, HUTECH University, Vietnam
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Recommender systems have become core infrastructure for modern online platforms, personalizing content at scale and strongly influencing what users see, click on, and purchase. However, this dependence on user interaction also exposes them to shilling attacks, where malicious actors can inject fake profiles to distort item rankings and control visibility. Existing attacks often rely on target-specific fine-tuning or fixed profile templates, making them either difficult to adapt to different victims or easier to detect. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Agentic Group Attack System (AGAS), a coordinated shilling framework where a central Coordinator directs a group of role-switching worker agents to adaptively promote a target item across different victim families. The Coordinator dynamically adjusts the strategy when progress stalls or suppression signals increase, while workers pursue a shared objective and switch between active and inactive roles to avoid repetitive patterns. Under the same attack budgets and evaluation protocols, AGAS consistently surpasses strong baselines in target promotion while better preserving benign recommendation quality, weakening representative detectors, and achieving higher efficiency than prior attacks. These findings also emphasize that defending recommender systems may require mechanisms that can handle adaptive shilling campaigns, not just isolated fake-profile injections. Our code is available at https://github.com/phkhanhtrinh23/AGAS.

papers.title: Following the Preference, Missing the Optimum: Compliance Without Optimization in AI Housing Recommendation
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: Large language models are becoming the first point of contact for consumer search in domains where the stakes are material and the law is explicit. Existing audits show that models steer housing seekers by perceived identity, but none can say what a user loses when a recommender overlooks a suitable option, for want of an enumerated inventory to score omissions against. We audit AI housing recommendation against a verifiable ground truth. For each of 150 synthetic renter scenarios in New York City we build a pool of 120 real listings with known rent, bedrooms and GTFS-computed transit commute, compute the exact set satisfying the renter's stated constraints, and derive its Pareto frontier. The primary outcome assumes no utility function: a recommendation is strictly dominated if the same pool holds a listing cheaper, faster to commute from and no smaller in bedrooms. Across 9,945 calls to three models from two vendors, compliance is near-perfect (1.8% violation against a 66.6% random floor), yet 39.0% of recommendations are strictly dominated, and the dominating listing is a median 900 USD/month cheaper and 3.5 minutes closer. A within-scenario manipulation separates two capabilities usually conflated: changing one sentence moves median recommended rent by 646 USD/month in the correct direction, so preferences are honored, yet recommendations still sit 606 USD/month above the five cheapest qualifying listings on the same screen, and an unambiguous lexicographic instruction gives no improvement under equivalence testing against a pre-specified 50 USD/month bound. The gap widens with candidate-set size and replicates across OpenAI and Anthropic models to within 3 USD. We characterize the failure as compliance without optimization, propose dominance-rate instrumentation as a deployable diagnostic, and release all code, prompts and per-call results.

papers.title: FINALLY: A Dataset Recommender System for Recommender-Systems Research
papers.reason: 提供评测、数据或综述视角，便于校准实验设计并定位研究空白。
papers.abstract: Dataset selection shapes the empirical conditions under which recommender-system algorithms are evaluated, yet existing tools provide limited support for constructing complete dataset sets that jointly satisfy experimental constraints and set-level selection objectives. To address this problem, I developed FINALLY, a web-based dataset recommender for constructing configurable dataset sets for offline recommender-systems evaluations. FINALLY combines required datasets, candidate-pool restrictions, metadata filters, configurable target-set sizes, Random selection, and diverse and non-diverse strategies based on adapted Effective Covariance and Convex Hull objectives. I evaluated FINALLY through 420 recommendation runs across ten systematically varied configurations. All evaluated dataset sets satisfied the applicable target-size, duplicate-avoidance, snapshot-membership, required-dataset, and metadata-filter requirements. All 40 deterministic strategy--configuration combinations were reproducible. Both the Effective-Covariance-based and Convex-Hull-based strategies produced the expected diverse-versus-non-diverse score ordering in all ten configurations. Under their corresponding objectives, the diverse strategies produced scores above all 30 configuration-specific Random results, whereas the non-diverse strategies produced scores below all 30 Random results. These results establish technical consistency for the evaluated FINALLY workflow and show that the implemented strategies follow their intended optimization directions within the investigated configuration space. They do not establish the scientific suitability, global optimality, or practical superiority of the generated selections.

papers.title: SequenceO1: End-to-End Ultra-Long (100K) Sequence Modeling in Recommendation with Low-Rank Caching
papers.reason: 聚焦用户行为序列与下一步偏好建模，和序列推荐主线直接相关。
papers.abstract: Modeling long-term user behavior is central to sequential recommendation and billion-scale industrial recommender systems, yet production ranking models operate under strict latency, memory, communication, and training-throughput constraints. At the 100K scale, the challenge extends beyond attention complexity: raw sequence features must be stored, transferred, and repeatedly processed during training and online serving. Existing approaches based on history truncation, multi-stage behavior retrieval, compressed lifelong histories, or train-short/infer-long extrapolation either weaken end-to-end optimization or retain substantial length-dependent cost. We present SequenceO1, an end-to-end framework for ultra-long user behavior sequence modeling, deployed at full traffic on Douyin with histories of up to 100K interactions. SequenceO1 follows a compress-then-reason design. Its Sketch Attention (SA) uses learnable prototypes and prototype-wise normalization to compress the raw history into a fixed-size, target-agnostic user representation. Target-conditioned Stacked Target-to-History Cross Attention (STCA) then models complementary time scales: a recent 10K suffix for short-term interests and the compact sketch for long-term preferences. To make training and inference practical, SequenceO1 combines low-rank user representation caching, multi-request user-level batching, pipeline lift, and a fused FlashSA kernel to amortize feature storage, communication, and computation across targets, training instances, and consecutive requests. Production experiments show consistent offline and online gains, while the compact cached sketch retains most of the benefit of directly scaling end-to-end sequence ranking to 100K. These results provide a practical model-system approach to efficient attention, sequence compression, and scalable long-sequence and long-context recommendation systems.

papers.title: MoEMB: Scaling Universal Multimodal Embeddings with Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) increasingly demands encoder's capacity for handling a broad range of tasks and modalities with increased complexity. Prior scaling methods either increase the representation size, retrieval effort, or scales the encoder into a heavy multimodal LLM. Recent works, such as Think-Then-Embed (TTE), explore scaling via reasoning tokens. However, embedding models are hard to scale up: increasing parameters directly tradeoffs for the large training batch size that contrastive learning needs, and retrieval has to be served under tight latency. Moreover, UME tasks are diverse in complexity, where scaling up embedders can bring significant redundant computation. In this work, we propose MOEMB, which instead scales UME along the expert axis through mixture-of-experts (MoE), growing encoder capacity while preserving single-vector, non-autoregressive encoding. Through a systematic study of the design space and training recipes for MoE-based UME, MoEMB sets a new state of the art on both MMEB-V2 and MRMR among models trained on public MMEB-family data: with only 3B active parameters, MoEMB surpasses TTE-based methods with >4x active parameters, using significantly less computes. To further improve the scalability and efficiency, we conduct the first comprehensive study of adaptive computation for MoE-based embedding, spanning diverse strategies across training-based and inference-only methods. Together, these results support expert scaling as an effective and efficient direction for UME, with adaptive computation further improving efficiency for MLLM-based embedding models towards large-scale retrieval and recommendation systems.

papers.title: Quantifying the Engagement Trap: Impact of Short-form Video Recommender Systems on Users with ADHD
institutions: Graz University of Technology, Graz, Austria
papers.primary_institution: Graz University of Technology, Graz, Austria
papers.reason: 与推荐系统研究直接相关，适合快速浏览其问题设定和实验结论。
papers.abstract: Short-form video platforms use recommender systems to maximize engagement through highly efficient personalized recommendations. However, the impact of these recommendations on users with ADHD compared to users without ADHD remains underexplored. Through this study, we introduce and operationalize the Engagement Trap, illustrating how recommender systems, while successfully optimizing for engagement, disproportionately disadvantage users with ADHD. This stratified study of 302 participants, recruited via the online platform Prolific, compares experiences between participants with and without ADHD. Our results show that while recommendations are perceived as relevant across groups, participants with ADHD report significantly higher levels of time blindness, post-usage regret, and emotional distress when consuming recommendations. Moreover, we collect feedback for several proof-of- concept, theoretical design interventions for neuro-inclusive design principles. These findings provide quantitative evidence of systemic differences in engagement-optimized recommender systems and highlight the unbalanced negative effects and interactions these systems create for participants with ADHD. We argue for neurodiversity-aware, human-centered design approaches that mitigate such algorithmic harms and support more equitable experiences.

papers.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
papers.reason: 关注大模型或智能体如何改变推荐流程，适合跟踪新一代推荐范式。
papers.abstract: E-commerce platforms increasingly display clickable query suggestions alongside items in the user feed, enabling users to refine or expand their intent without manually reformulating queries. Existing approaches either mine suggestions from historical logs -- limited to past behavior and blind to long-tail, personalized intents -- or rely on off-the-shelf LLMs whose lack of platform-specific knowledge yields fluent but generic queries disconnected from real click behavior. We propose EAGER (Enrich-and-AliGn gEnerative Query Recommendation), a two-stage framework for generating query suggestions from clicked items. In the enrichment stage, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) follows a four-stage curriculum that scales information richness (from item-only to user-conditioned) and reasoning depth (from direct to chain-of-thought). Each stage incorporates rationale augmentation, diversity regularization, and self-distillation. In the alignment stage, we post-train via GRPO with a hybrid reward of multiple rule-based business signals and a preference-aware click reward. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B test demonstrate the effectiveness of EAGER, which has been deployed in production at a major e-commerce platform.

papers.title: FunnelAudit: Responsibility Auditing in Multi-Route Recommender Systems
institutions: School of Business, Law, Humanities and Pathways, University of Southern Queensland, Australia
School of Computing Technologies, RMIT University, Melbourne, Australia
papers.reason: 面向长期收益或交互式推荐，关注策略学习与离线评估的结合。
papers.abstract: Multi-route recommender systems combine retrieval, allocation, fusion, and ranking, making individual inclusions and exclusions difficult to audit. Route overlap can hide effects from one-at-a-time ablations, while freezing downstream stages produces counterfactuals inconsistent with serving behavior. We introduce FunnelAudit, an executable framework for incident-level responsibility auditing. An accountability contract specifies the disputed Top-K event, controls and owners, permitted reference actions, and replay semantics. FunnelAudit evaluates every permitted control configuration and applies graded actual responsibility to find the smallest outcome-preserving contingency that makes each control pivotal. Its certificate records the contingency and paired serving executions needed to verify the judgment. We instantiate the framework in two-stage, nine-route funnels using fixed union, weighted quota allocation, or weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, followed by SASRec ranking. Across 258,809 user-target incidents from three real interaction datasets, 4.24-16.24% admit a responsible control. Among responsible incident-control pairs, 92.55-99.64% require a nonempty contingency, so single-control ablation recovers only 0.36-7.45%. Policies differing in factual outcomes on only 0.31-2.39% of incidents yield 21.44-54.05% Jaccard distance between responsible-route sets on matched exclusions. Independent replay reproduces all 9,121,792 checked target-world outcomes; exhaustive search and a generic mixed-integer linear program agree with every sampled judgment. These findings demonstrate the importance of explicit serving semantics and checkable witnesses for recommender accountability.

papers.title: Task-Blind No MORE: Multi-Task Information Flow in Unified Ranking Backbones
institutions: University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, China
Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China
Beijing Information Science and Technology University, Beijing, China
papers.reason: 聚焦用户行为序列与下一步偏好建模，和序列推荐主线直接相关。
papers.abstract: Industrial ranking models for recommendation have scaled feature interaction and sequence modeling separately; recent architectures such as HyFormer and MixFormer unify both in a stackable backbone. Real-world recommender systems, however, nearly always require multi-task learning, yet existing unified architectures confine multi-task modeling to shallow post-backbone towers, leaving the backbone without task-aware information flow. We propose MORE (Multi-task cO-evolving Ranking modEl), which embeds multi-task information flow inside the backbone, enabling task-specific signals to co-evolve with sequence and feature representations at every layer rather than in a post-hoc fusion. It introduces Anchor Tokens that persist across backbone layers: Shared Anchors encode cross-task commonalities, while Private Anchors capture task-specific priors. In each block, Anchor Tokens (1) read task-conditioned signals from behavior sequences, (2) mix with non-sequential features under a task-boundary mask, and (3) refine per-task representations through independent branches; as blocks stack, each task obtains a differentiated representation refined through all backbone layers. Experiments on large-scale industrial datasets show that MORE consistently outperforms baselines across all tasks under comparable parameter and FLOPs budgets, and scales well with model size. Online A/B tests on Momo, a leading Chinese social discovery platform with tens of millions of monthly active users, yield 3% improvement in usage duration, 3.6% in interaction rate, and 2% in deep-chat rate. MORE is deployed in production with request-level shared computation reducing scoring latency by about 30%.

papers.title: Automated Chest CT Protocol Selection via Large Language Model Derived Text Embeddings from Imaging Request Text
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Purpose: Accurate CT protocol selection is critical for diagnostic quality and patient safety, yet the current process is manual, time-consuming, and prone to inconsistencies. Prior Machine Learning methods using keywords or bag-of-words lack contextual understanding and perform poorly on rare protocols. We propose a decision support system using large language model (LLM) features to recommend protocols from free-text clinical indications, capturing clinical nuance and phrasing variation for more consistent, efficient selection. Methods: In this REB-approved retrospective study, 285,123 chest CT imaging requests from a large academic medical center (2017-2024) were split into training (228,099, 80%) and held-out test (57,024, 20%) sets. Each request included procedure names, clinical indication, HIS comments, and the selected protocol. Clinical text was embedded using a fine-tuned LLM, Meta's LLaMA-3.1-70B; these features input a logistic regression classifier predicting 18 protocol labels (e.g., PE, LDCT). Results: The pipeline achieved a weighted precision of 0.84, weighted F1-score of 0.81, and overall accuracy of 79% across 18 CT protocols. On 300 independent cases with expert consensus, the LLM reached an overall accuracy of 80% versus 83% for radiologists, with no significant difference (p = 0.263). Performance was comparable across most classes, with the LLM exceeding radiologists for some challenging categories, and entropy analyses indicated more balanced protocol use, suggesting reduced variability. Conclusion: An LLM-based recommendation system can leverage general knowledge from a large natural-text corpus to accurately assign chest CT protocols from free-text imaging requests, and may serve as a viable foundation for protocol recommendation tools where inputs require language understanding.

papers.title: Closing the Long-Short View Gap in Sequential Recommendation without Cached History
institutions: Texas A&M University, College Station, United States
University of New South Wales, Sydney, Australia
papers.primary_institution: Texas A&M University, College Station, United States
papers.reason: 讨论偏差、鲁棒性或可信问题，适合补齐推荐系统治理视角。
papers.abstract: Sequential recommenders are typically trained on long user histories to capture rich behavioral signals, yet serving with training-length sequences is often impractical due to real-time efficiency constraints. Directly using only recent behaviors leads to a severe performance drop. To bridge this gap, existing approaches compress user histories into persistent per-user states, storing and retrieving them at inference time; while effective, they impose non-trivial infrastructure overhead and offer little remedy in cold-start scenarios. In this paper, we empirically identify two structural flaws rooted in geometric properties and dataset sparsity, and propose a novel two-stage framework to close the long-short-view performance gap. Specifically, in the first stage, we replace the commonly used dot-product with angular similarity scoring and leverage a modified softmax to counter prefix position bias. In the second stage, we fine-tune only bias and LayerNorm components, which are universal to standard sequential backbones, for further improvement. Both stages are guided by carefully designed learning objectives. Extensive experiments on two representative backbones across three public datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed framework.

papers.title: Do All Nodes Benefit Equally from Knowledge Graphs? Adaptive Node-Aware KG Fusion for Recommendation
institutions: Soongsil University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
papers.primary_institution: Soongsil University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
papers.reason: 利用图结构或知识图谱建模高阶关系，值得关注表示学习与传播机制。
papers.abstract: KG-aware recommendation has been widely studied to alleviate data sparsity by using knowledge graphs (KGs), which represent items, entities, and their relations as graphs and provide item-side knowledge. However, existing methods incorporate item knowledge without considering how much each user or item node should rely on it. As a result, they apply KG signals indiscriminately across nodes, even to nodes whose collaborative filtering (CF) signals from the interaction graph (IG) are already reliable. In this paper, we propose AdaKG (Adaptive Node-Aware KG Fusion), a novel KG-aware recommendation method that adaptively adjusts the contribution of auxiliary knowledge for each node. Since user-item interactions and item knowledge provide different types of signals, directly mixing them can distort the CF signals. To avoid this, AdaKG separately encodes the IG and KG with view-specific encoders, allowing each view to capture its own information. It then estimates how strongly each node should rely on item knowledge by measuring the stability of its CF signals under small adversarial perturbations, assigning a larger KG contribution to less stable nodes. Finally, AdaKG adaptively aligns the IG and KG embeddings in a shared space and fuses them according to the estimated node-wise reliance. Through experiments, we show that AdaKG achieves strong performance compared with its baselines and the effectiveness of our adaptive fusion strategy.

papers.title: AtomRec: Evolving Atomic Memory for Agentic Recommendation
institutions: 1Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University 2Xiaohongshu 3Peking University 4East China Normal University 5Beijing Jiaotong University email: peiyuhu30@gmail.com, weihai.lu@pku.edu.cn, sy.gu@stu.ecnu.edu.cn, zhuodong.liu@bjtu.edu.cn, jia.wang02@xjtlu.edu.cn, email: luozhaokai,niuyuean,sunzhenghuai@xiaohongshu.com

papers.abstract: Agentic recommender systems use large language models to maintain semantic memory and support evidence-aware recommendation. However, existing memory mechanisms often compress user and item information into coarse summaries and connect them with scalar collaborative links, making it difficult to preserve fine-grained preference stages or retrieve interpretable evidence as user interests evolve. papers.abstract: Fairness-aware recommender systems aim to mitigate systematic imbalances in recommendation outcomes, including how visibility, relevance, and opportunities are distributed among users, items, and providers. Recent work has introduced large language models (LLMs) with skill documents to assist this labor-intensive process, but skill optimization remains largely prompt-driven, lacking a principled mechanism to attribute rewards to specific document edits. To address this limitation, we propose Document-Mediated Reinforcement Learning (DMRL), a skill self-evolution framework that models skill document optimization as a sequence of structured editing actions. In DMRL, an upper-level agent performs controlled document edits, while a frozen lower-level task agent evaluates their effects through A/B testing. To address credit assignment and long-term outcomes, we introduce two key components: (1) Dual-Relative Policy Optimization (DRPO), a post-training policy optimization method for robust and risk-aware advantage estimation; and (2) Long-term Reward Predictor (LRP), which estimates long-term outcomes by modeling population heterogeneity with disentangled representation learning and cross-attention transfer. DMRL was deployed on a large-scale short-video ads platform and extensive empirical evaluation shows that DMRL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across key advertising metrics

papers.abstract: Serving useful recommendations under distribution shift is crucial for balancing utility and risk in out-of-distribution (OOD) recommendation. However, most existing OOD methods improve ranking or construct counterfactual candidates without controlling the proxy-label false discovery rate (FDR) of the served set. In this work, we formulate OOD serving as the $α$-Valid Counterfactual Recommendation ($α$-VCR) problem to retain candidate support learned from counterfactual supervision while controlling proxy-label FDR, and propose GenCAR, which couples preference-grounded counterfactual supervision with calibrated set selection. In particular, GenCAR fixes the stable-preference representation while intervening on the environmental factor, grounds offline large language model proposals through preference anchors and trust-radius filtering, and uses conformal $p$-values for Benjamini--Hochberg selection. We theoretically bound conditional counterfactual approximation error and prove finite-sample, distribution-free control of proxy-label FDR under exchangeability and positive regression dependence, with a Benjamini--Yekutieli guarantee under arbitrary dependence. Extensive experiments audit realized proxy false discovery proportions and demonstrate that GenCAR consistently enhances OOD candidate recovery across diverse benchmarks.

papers.abstract: Production recommender systems shape what billions of people see, and sustaining their performance requires continual optimization: as content, user behavior, and upstream models shift, the choices governing retrieval, ranking, and serving must be revisited. Traditionally, human engineers test such changes through online experiments--a slow, reactive process limited by engineering effort, leaving parts of the system unrevised as conditions change. Although large language models have been applied to ranking, user modeling, and offline model development, few systems place an agent in a continual closed loop that acts on a live recommender and learns from the measured effects of its decisions. We present CORAL (Constraint-Optimized Recommender via an Agentic Loop), an LLM-native harness that closes this loop: each cycle, the agent observes operating signals, reasons over a memory of past decisions and outcomes, and invokes tools--including a numerical optimizer that keeps changes within a fixed operating budget--to reconfigure the recommender, with measured outcomes informing the next cycle. We formulate this as a partially observed, non-stationary, constrained optimization problem in which the policy improves in context, without parameter updates, from its prior actions. Across two large-scale social platforms, evaluated with A/B experiments, the same harness improves engagement at no additional serving cost on one and reduces serving cost without degrading engagement on the other, spanning the engagement-efficiency frontier. Performance improves as the loop iterates, suggesting that a single agentic loop can automate continual optimization work traditionally performed by human algorithm engineers under explicit guardrails.

papers.abstract: Knowledge graphs have become an important source of structured knowledge for Web applications, including search, question answering, and recommender systems. In these applications, link prediction can serve either as a prediction task itself or as a means to enrich incomplete knowledge graphs for downstream tasks. Interestingly, different link prediction models, or even different training runs of the same model, can produce substantially different predictions for the same query. This suggests a variability in the capture of the underlying knowledge by models, thus raising a fundamental question: to what extent do different models capture complementary knowledge, and how much of this knowledge could be recovered by combining them? We propose to measure model complementarity through the performance of an oracle that, for each query, selects the best prediction among a considered set of models, hence providing an upper bound on the performance achievable through model combination. Across several architectures and benchmarks, we find a substantial gap between individual models and their oracle, revealing that different models capture complementary knowledge. Yet, this complementarity rapidly saturates as more models are added, leaving a persistent subset of queries unsolved even by a large number of models. These findings reveal both the potential of model complementarity and a fundamental limit to what current link prediction models can collectively recover; thereby highlighting the need for further research to build robust Web applications.

papers.abstract: Interactions with cold items negatively impact real-time personalization of ID-based recommender systems. This is because the use of such interactions degrades user preference estimates, whereas excluding cold items from the user profile prevents real-time recommendation updates. In this paper, we demonstrate that sequential models, most often used for real-time personalization, are not robust to such swaps, and propose SwapRec, an approach to address this issue.
